article.articleHeadline: 东莞体彩开展虫媒传染病防控专项排查整治__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dongguan Sports Lottery conducts a special inspection and rectification of vector-borne infectious disease prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Dongguan Sports Lottery Center conducts a focused vector-borne disease prevention inspection aimed at reducing dengue fever and chikungunya risk amid nearby dense vegetation and hillside mosquito habitats near East City Sports Park. The center integrates vector control into daily administration, implementing grid-based management of water-accumulation areas (restrooms, greenery), boosting professional disinfection, and provisioning repellent liquids and mosquito lamps. It enforces front‑door sanitation duties and mobilizes staff to routinely remove indoor/outdoor clutter to eliminate breeding sites at the source. An on-site verification of lottery shops targets hidden risk points such as plant trays, discarded bottles, and indoor aquatic containers, requiring dealers to drain standing water and follow a “one day, two cleanups” rule. Plans extend the three-pronged defense—human, environmental, and technical defenses—across all city lottery shops, combining online/offline publicity to strengthen prevention awareness and public health protections.

triage.headline_ja: 東莞体彩、虫媒介感染症の予防・防止に関する特別点検と是正措置を実施

triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、東莞市のスポーツくじ販売施設における蚊媒介感染症の予防的点検・環境整備活動を伝えるもの。具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Lorenzo Corradin muore di West Nile, la figlia: "Il giorno prima stava bene, poi la febbre altissima e i sintomi del contagio". È la prima vittima dell'estate 2026 in Veneto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lorenzo Corradin dies of West Nile virus, his daughter: "The day before he was fine, then an extremely high fever and the symptoms of infection." He is the first victim of the summer of 2026 in Veneto.
article.articleSummary: 84-year-old Lorenzo Corradin of Presina, Piazzola sul Brenta, in Padova province, Veneto, died from West Nile virus, the first Veneto summer 2026 death and the first Padovan victim this season. He developed high fever, vomiting and diarrhea on August 6 and was hospitalised in Cittadella; bone marrow analyses later confirmed West Nile virus as the cause, with no specific treatment available. He died the following Sunday. Incubation is estimated at two weeks or more from bite; prophylaxis and disinfestation measures were not pursued. Funeral set for August 20 at 16:00 in the parish church of Presina. In Padova, a July case involved a man returning from Thailand; in 2025 Padova province reported West Nile cases in Ulss 6 Euganea. The 2022 season was particularly critical, with many infected mosquitoes, driven by drought and heavy rainfall.

triage.headline_ja: ロレンツォ・コッラディンさんがウエストナイル熱で死亡、娘は「前日まで元気だったのに、その後高熱と感染症状が出た」と証言。2026年夏のヴェネト州における最初の死亡例。

article.articleHeadline: Flu remains city's most reported infectious disease in July
article.articleSummary: Macau logged 2,936 notifiable-disease cases in July, with influenza remaining the most reported infection (2,457 cases). Enterovirus infections were 344 and chickenpox 32; dengue fever accounted for 3 cases. Salmonella enteritis rose to 27, a 58.8% increase from June and about 1.5 times the July figure last year, linked to hot weather from July to October and primarily transmitted by raw or undercooked foods. Authorities urge food safety, including proper cooking and storage. Scarlet fever declined to 14 in July, down about 55% from June. Norovirus infections dropped sharply to 1 case, a 92.3% monthly decrease. The Macau SSM disease surveillance system monitors 45 notifiable diseases to identify potential outbreaks and limit spread in residential homes, schools, and the wider community, per Health Bureau data.

triage.headline_ja: 7月の香港市内の感染症、インフルエンザが依然最多
triage.triage_reason: マカオの月次感染症サーベイランス報告であり、季節性インフルエンザが例年通り最多を占めるなど、異常な増加や新規病原体の出現は見られず、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマカオ衛生局による定例の届出感染症サーベイランス報告であり、サルモネラ菌の一時的増加（前月比58.8%増）が言及されているが、いずれも季節的変動の範囲内でアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo se convierte en el más letal de su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo becomes the deadliest in its history.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak is the deadliest in the country’s history, with at least 2,325 deaths and 4,945 confirmed cases as of the Aug 16, 2026 update; 101 new cases were reported in the prior 24 hours. Globally, it remains the second deadliest Ebola event after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which produced 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment exists, though investigational candidates are being evaluated; care is primarily supportive. It began in Ituri in northeast DRC and has spread to six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé—with Ituri accounting for about 85% of cases as of Aug 12. Conflict, displacement, weak health infrastructure, and cross-border movement hinder detection and contact tracing; the case fatality rate among confirmed cases is about 46%.

triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で、致死率約46%、6州に拡大しワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。

article.articleHeadline: Border health teams on alert after dengue surge in B'desh
article.articleSummary: Meghalaya directed district health teams along its 443-km border with Bangladesh to remain on high alert after a dengue surge was reported in Bangladesh. On Aug 18, 2026, Health and Family Welfare Minister Wailadmiki Shylla said no dengue cases have been reported in Meghalaya’s border areas so far, and a surveillance team is monitoring the situation. The precautionary move aims to detect and respond swiftly if cases are imported from the neighboring country, given ongoing dengue activity in Bangladesh. Meghalaya shares a 443-km border with Bangladesh; there have been no locally transmitted cases in border areas to date.

article.articleHeadline: बरसात में बढ़ा टाइफाइड का खतरा, इन लक्षणों को बिल्कुल न करें नजरअंदाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of typhoid fever increases during the monsoon season; do not ignore these symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever risk rises during the monsoon season due to contaminated water and poor hygiene. The infection is caused by Salmonella Typhi. Key symptoms include high or persistent fever, loss of appetite, vomiting, and diarrhea, with fatigue common. The article stresses not to start treatment without a medical consultation and a blood test, as confirmation is needed. In rainy periods, cases surge; a possible complication is liver swelling. Recovery typically takes about two weeks with appropriate management. Prevention emphasizes safe water and food: drink filtered water, avoid dirty water, eat cautiously, and maintain cleanliness around the home. If symptoms appear, seek prompt medical testing to confirm diagnosis before treatment. The guidance is attributed to Dr. Mohammed Arshad of Prema Multi-Speciality Hospital, illustrating the local clinical perspective in this monsoon-associated outbreak context.

article.articleHeadline: How Ebola became the deadliest outbreak in DR Congo's history
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province with Bunia and Mongbwalu General Hospital. By August 2026, three months after declared on May 15, 2026, the outbreak recorded >4,900 confirmed cases and >2,300 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, surpassing 2018–2020's 2,299 deaths from the Zaire strain. There are no licensed vaccines or specific therapies for BVD; response relies on early detection, supportive care, infection prevention, and community engagement. Initial spread began before official declaration, with transmission linked to movement of people, including those who are ill, between localities; it has spread from Mongbwalu Health Zone to other provinces. Health authorities note challenges from armed conflict, insecurity, mistrust, and access limitations; laboratory capacity in Ituri has expanded to more than 12 labs to aid confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはいかにしてコンゴ民主共和国史上最悪の流行になったか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で発生したブンディブギョウイルス病（エボラ関連株）が4,900例超・死者2,300人超に達し、同国史上最悪の流行となっている。武力紛争下での対応困難や他州への拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 本疾患はブンディブギョウウイルス病（BVD）であり、ザイール株とは異なる株だが、エボラウイルス病の一種としてWHO監視対象。ワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認である点、武力紛争による対応制約が大きなリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Is the outbreak out of control?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Three months after declaration, about 5,000 confirmed cases and more than 2,300 deaths across six provinces and 55 health zones, with roughly a 46% fatality rate. The outbreak is the second-largest on record and the fastest-growing since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic; many contacts remain unidentified or untracked, hindering the response. Scaling up the response requires more and better-resourced personnel to cover additional areas and monitor contacts, but funding is constrained as international attention is absorbed by Ukraine and the Middle East. Domestic challenges include armed conflict causing displacement and cross-border movement linked to mining; some communities resist testing or flee health workers, potentially spreading the virus. A regionalization risk exists, with cases reported in Uganda, underscoring the need for urgent international mobilization.

article.articleHeadline: 多种呼吸道病毒叠加医生支招 重点人群及时检测
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors advise on the co-circulation of multiple respiratory viruses; timely testing for high-risk groups.
article.articleSummary: China's CDC weekly surveillance (Aug 3–9, 2026) shows the SARS-CoV-2 positive rate has declined to a mid-level level. Summer remains a high season for respiratory viruses, and symptoms overlap among COVID-19, influenza A/B, rhinovirus, adenovirus, RSV, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae, making testing essential to identify the pathogen. Pharmacy supplies of COVID-19 and influenza antigen tests are ample; however, antigen tests can yield false negatives and are less sensitive than nucleic acid tests. In Hunan, some hospitals offer 24-hour PCR capable laboratories that can perform multiplex nucleic acid testing for seven pathogens, enabling precise treatment decisions. High-risk individuals and households with vulnerable members should seek prompt medical advice and testing if fever, cough, or sputum production occurs. Home antigen testing is convenient for screening but negative results do not completely exclude infection.

article.articleHeadline: RDC: déjà à court d'ambulances, la riposte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola fragilisée par les violences
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: already short of ambulances, the Ebola outbreak response is weakened by violence.
article.articleSummary: Violence against Ebola response teams in the Democratic Republic of Congo is hampering outbreak control. On Sunday, Aug 17, in Aru, Ituri, a mob attacked Kandoy Hospital as an ambulance attempted to pick up two suspected Ebola cases; the ambulance driver was severely injured and remains in a coma, the hospital looted, and the two suspected cases reportedly disappeared along with other patients after the assault. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warns that vehicles are already too few, and vandalism erodes a vital service. The incident follows broader disruptions on Aug 15: only 21 of 171 planned rings were opened to contain cases, and a secure burial could not be performed in Epulu-Zunguluka, Mambasa health zone. Across provinces, attacks in Haut-Uele, Isiro/Tuluba, and ambulance shortages persist: Ituri has two ambulances out of service; Nord-Kivu has five; Haut-Uele requests ten more.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：すでに救急車不足、エボラ流行対応が暴力により脆弱化

triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の既知の流行（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Haut-Uele、Mambasaなど複数州）が、地域住民による対応チームへの暴力・病院襲撃・患者拉致等により制御困難化。UNエボラ調整官が救急車不足と対応体制の脆弱性を警告しており、外部支援の必要性が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱、コンゴ民主共和国で感染5000人超え　死者2300人以上
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 5,000 infections, with more than 2,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,021 infections and 2,378 deaths (case fatality ≈47%), with the eastern outbreak now spanning six provinces, including Ituri and Bas-Uele. A new Bas-Uele infection confirms ongoing spread. The WHO emergency declaration marked three months without a clear end in sight. To curb transmission, WHO is boosting field capacity by about 100 epidemiologists and seeking funding; $115 million is needed, with around $70 million secured. There is no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo virus strain; two vaccine candidates are in clinical trials. The outbreak's sustained transmission underscores the urgent need for vaccines and increased funding.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6州に拡大、感染5000人超・死者2300人超・致死率約47%で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、WHOが緊急事態を宣言し国際支援（資金・専門家派遣）を要請しているためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: മ്യാൻമറിൽ കോളറ വ്യാപനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Cholera in Myanmar
article.articleSummary: Naypyidaw — Cholera is spreading in Myanmar, with the outbreak centered in Yangon and Rakhine regions. As of August 9, 2026, three deaths have been reported and more than 500 people have been hospitalised. The surge follows severe internal conflict and economic crisis that have strained Myanmar’s health system, complicating outbreak response. Water contamination and mass displacement resulting from fighting between the military and ethnic rebel groups have left crowded living conditions that facilitate transmission. The report does not detail laboratory confirmation or vaccination, and there is no information on imported or exported cases. Urgent public health measures are needed to address sanitation, drinking-water safety, and access to care in affected areas.

article.articleHeadline: 医生回应女子逗流浪猫眼部检出弓形虫 长期接触风险高
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor responds to a woman who played with stray cats; Toxoplasma gondii detected in the eye; long-term exposure carries high risk.
article.articleSummary: A woman in her 60s in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, developed ocular toxoplasmosis after long-term close contact with stray cats she fed. Over about a month her left eye became blurred, with rapid vision loss; ophthalmic imaging and metagenomic sequencing confirmed Toxoplasma gondii infection in the eye, with up to 5,400 parasites detected, causing retinochoroiditis and near-blindness. Toxoplasma gondii is an intracellular parasite that can infect brain, eye, liver, heart, and lungs; although most infections are asymptomatic in immunocompetent individuals, severe disease can occur with immune suppression. Infections are congenital or acquired; congenital occurs via transplacental transmission, while acquired infection occurs mainly through ingestion, damaged skin contact, transfusion, or organ transplantation. The report highlights long-term stray-cat exposure as a clear infection source and its serious ophthalmic consequences.

article.articleHeadline: Lễ giỗ chung 14 người mất vì Covid-19 trong con hẻm TP HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Joint memorial service for 14 people who died of COVID-19 in a Ho Chi Minh City alley.
article.articleSummary: Fourteen residents of alley 68/17 Tran Quang Khai in Ho Chi Minh City’s Tan Dinh ward died of COVID-19 during the 2021 surge, now remembered at a joint memorial in August 2026, five years after the outbreak. The alley, with about 80 households, gathered at Miếu Ông Trà, placing 14 candles labeled with each deceased’s name, age and address, while a TV replayed footage from 2021 of lockdowns, truck-delivered supplies, and neighbors receiving food and oxygen. Residents formed a support group; some family members died after care facilities were overwhelmed. The memorial honored a mother, a doctor and her husband who worked in electricity, and their daughter with developmental delays, all affected in July 2021. Donors contributed over 10 million dong; about 4 million financed offerings, the rest a communal fund for streetlights, notice boards, and aid for the sick. The ceremony underscored enduring COVID-19 hardship and neighborly solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の路地で新型コロナウイルス感染症により死亡した14人の合同追悼式
triage.triage_reason: 2021年の過去の流行に関する追悼記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生イベントではないため、シグナルとしての新規性・緊急性がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2021年のCOVID-19流行で死亡した住民を偲ぶ2026年8月の追悼式に関するもので、現在の感染症発生や新規事例を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 코로나 '대동란' 겪은 北...에볼라 유행국 방문 외국인 입국금지
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Korea, which endured the COVID-19 'pandemonium,' bans entry of foreigners who have visited Ebola-affected countries.
article.articleSummary: North Korea has expanded bans on foreign entry by suspending visa issuance for travelers who have visited Ebola-affected countries since May, affecting 12 African nations: Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, and Burundi. Citing the Russian travel company Vostok Into, Radio Free Asia reported that Pyongyang regards these regions as current Ebola zones. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, officially declared on May 15, had surpassed 2,300 deaths by Aug 15, 2026, with WHO warning that regional spread could rival or exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. North Korea’s state media have repeatedly stressed vigilance and preemptive measures to block virus importation, reflecting lessons learned during the initial COVID-19 border closure and vaccine rejection in 2022.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ『大混乱』を経験した北朝鮮、エボラ流行国を訪問した外国人の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生したエボラ出血熱が2026年8月15日までに2,300人以上の死者を出し、WHOが2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る地域的拡大の可能性を警告している。北朝鮮による渡航制限措置も取られており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生したエボラ出血熱の流行であり、北朝鮮が渡航禁止対象とした12か国（ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、ザンビア、中央アフリカ共和国、タンザニア、エチオピア、アンゴラ、コンゴ共和国、ブルンジを含む）は実際の発生国ではなく予防的措置の対象国であるため、ザンビア等は verified_locations に含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Advierte OMS que brote de ébola "dista de estar bajo control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak is far from being under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains far from under control. As of August 18–19, 2026, nearly 5,000 confirmed cases and over 2,300 deaths are reported, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak. Six provinces in the DRC are affected, with transmission driven by population movements and ongoing insecurity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the epidemic has had an advantage and continues to spread nationally and internationally. Initial cases appeared in Uganda, and last month a traveler carried the virus to France. Public health risk is very high in the DRC, high in Uganda and neighboring countries, and low elsewhere. Ebola hemorrhagic fever spreads via bodily fluids; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo, though development is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ出血熱の流行が「制御下にあるとは言い難い」と警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約5,000人の確定症例、2,300人超の死亡者を伴う大規模エボラ流行が続き、ウガンダやフランスへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダとフランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生地であり、国際的拡大の懸念が明確に記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية لا يزال بعيدا عن السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains far from under control.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains far from under control as of August 16, 2026: 5,021 confirmed cases across 55 health zones in six provinces, with 2,378 deaths (case fatality rate 47.4%). The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned transmission remains unabated and could spread domestically and internationally, speaking at the WHO Emergency Committee meeting reviewing the PHEIC declared on May 17. The outbreak is the largest of its kind for this strain and the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally. The African CDC warned it could become the worst outbreak on record unless reversed, noting about one death every 30 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は依然として制御が困難な状況にある
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言されているエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、致死率47.4%と極めて高く、国際的拡大の懸念もWHO事務局長が明言しており、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の複数該当が確認される。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済み、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種としては史上最大規模、全体でも過去2番目に大きいエボラ流行。African CDCは史上最悪の流行になる可能性を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: 3 cán bộ thú y bị bắt trong vụ heo bệnh bán ra chợ ở Cần Thơ: Một, hai con sâu làm rầu cả nồi canh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three veterinary officers were arrested in the case of diseased pigs being sold at markets in Can Tho: One or two worms spoil the entire pot of soup.
article.articleSummary: Three veterinary officers in Can Tho were arrested in a case of diseased pigs being sold at markets, with police indictments on August 17. The scheme involved buying diseased or dead pigs, sending them to slaughterhouses, and selling the meat. Trương Văn Công and Hứa Hoàng Khởi were jailed and restricted from travel; Lưu Văn Nam and Thị Hồng Cam were previously detained; Phan Ngọc Toại, Lê Quốc Nhiên, and Phạm Hồng Phúc were charged with abusing power in slaughterhouse oversight. Can Tho authorities oversee 93 slaughterhouses and intensified checks on pig origin, health, and documentation, including import papers and pre-slaughter health exams. The probe linked to an ASF-positive sample from Đặng Phú Tỷ slaughterhouse in Vĩnh Viễn. Separately, nearly 1 ton of pork suspected of ASF is being investigated, with 7 of 9 samples testing positive.

triage.headline_ja: カントーで病気の豚が市場に流通した事件で獣医officer3名逮捕：一匹二匹の害虫がスープ全体を台無しにする
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)陽性サンプルに関連した豚肉の不正流通・汚職事件が中心で、公衆衛生への直接的な影響や感染拡大の詳細は不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はASF陽性の豚肉流通に関わる汚職・法執行事件であり、動物衛生（豚）カテゴリのイベントで、人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは限定的。ASF自体はベトナムで既知の家畜疫病であり、今回の焦点は取締り強化と汚職捜査。

article.articleHeadline: Vaksinasi Rabies Sasar 50 Ribu Ekor di Denpasar Bali, 7 Anjing Positif Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Vaccination Targets 50,000 Animals in Denpasar, Bali: 7 Dogs Test Positive for Rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination drive in Denpasar, Bali targets 92.7% coverage of the estimated dog population (~84,369). By 18 August 2026, 50,934 dogs had been vaccinated, equal to 60.37% of the population, as officials strive to reach the stated target. Since January–August 2026, seven dogs tested positive for rabies. Denpasar's Animal Husbandry and Health Office emphasizes vaccination as critical to rabies control and reducing human risk, while stray dogs pose a challenge due to mobility and potential spread. To improve reach, the district intensified door-to-door vaccination and enhanced public education to encourage responsible ownership and routine vaccination of pets. Authorities urged rapid reporting of any animal bite cases to enable immediate treatment for victims and containment of the biting animal. Citizens were advised not to feed dogs in public areas to minimize clustering and contact.

triage.headline_ja: デンパサール、バリ島でのワクチン接種活動、5万頭を対象に:7匹の犬が狂犬病陽性
triage.triage_reason: バリ島デンパサールでの狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する定例報道で、7匹の犬の陽性事例は確認されているが、人への感染や重症例の報告はなく、既存の地域的流行対策の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: バリ島は狂犬病流行地域であり、野良犬対策とワクチン接種率向上が課題。人への感染例は記事内で明示されていないため、現時点ではRRAには進めず継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا في الكونغو يحقق أعلى حصيلة وفيات محلية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo records the highest local death toll.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths as of August 18, 2026, with 101 new infections in the last 24 hours. The current outbreak is the seventeenth EVD event in the DRC and is now the country’s largest by both cases and deaths. Globally, it ranks second-largest after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone: 28,616 cases; 11,310 deaths). Deaths have surpassed 2,000 in under three months, faster than the roughly five months to 1,000 during West Africa. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for this Bundibugyo strain; limited vaccines and experimental treatments are under evaluation, with efficacy evidence mostly from animal studies. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected persons, alive or dead; early symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, with severe cases possibly bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、国内最多の死者数を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、死者数が急増し国際的拡大・対応支援の必要性が高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事に記載された発生地域のうちシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは過去の西アフリカ流行との比較対象として言及されており、現行アウトブレイクの発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: West and Central Africa: Latest Events at a glance (11-17 August 2026) - Cameroon
article.articleSummary: Cameroon: cholera in Far North; as of 12 August, 1,252 cases and 31 deaths across nine districts. CERF allocated $1 million to cholera prevention, treatment and WASH for 230,000 people; floods affected 742 residents, damaging homes and water points; Minawao refugee camp reports 80 cholera cases among over 81,000 refugees; 2026 humanitarian plan just over 25% funded. Central African Republic: no Ebola cases; UN supports preparedness with WHO-led inter-agency coordination, surveillance, risk communication and capacity-building; health messages in Sango via radio; transport of health experts and supplies. Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola outbreak outpacing response; by 14 August, more than 2,000 deaths, about one death every 30 minutes; CERF added $30.5 million (on top of $24 million earlier) and 20 more personnel; scale-up targets safe burials, tripling treatment capacity, improved contact tracing and WASH; donor support near $300 million. Central Sahel: Ouagadougou Declaration; 12.6 million people in need; funding levels: Burkina Faso 28%, Mali 20%, Niger 16%.

triage.headline_ja: 西・中央アフリカ:最新情勢概況（2026年8月11日～17日）- カメルーン
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は死者2,000人超・対応が追いつかず深刻化しており、国際的な資金・人員支援が急増している。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: カメルーンのコレラ流行（1,252例・31死亡）も報告されているが、カメルーンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中央アフリカ共和国はエボラ症例なし（予防的対応のみ）で対象国リストにも非該当。DRCのエボラ流行が本イベントの主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: DOH urges floodwater-exposed people to get checked for leptospirosis within 24 to 48 hours
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Philippines: The Department of Health (DOH) urges floodwater- and mud-exposed residents to seek medical check within 24–48 hours, even without symptoms, to assess infection risk and receive preventive treatment or care. Leptospira infection can occur from wading through dirty floodwaters, contaminated food or water, or contact with infected urine; symptoms include fever, chills, headache, back or leg pain, red eyes, or jaundice, with onset 2–30 days post-exposure. Under habagat conditions, exposure risk rises. As of Aug. 8, 2026, the country recorded 3,440 leptospirosis cases, 35% lower than last year’s 5,318, though the latest two-week period (July 12–25) rose to 348 cases, up 27% from 275 (June 28–July 11). Preparedness includes Code White Alert, 3.1 million doxycycline capsules prepositioned, DOH Leptospirosis Fast Lanes, 3,000 GAMOT providers, and PhilHealth benefits increased from 21,450 to 63,000 for regular hospitalization (potentially 170,000–411,000 for intensive care), with Zero Balance Billing for DOH hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、洪水被害地域の住民に24〜48時間以内のレプトスピラ症検査を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の洪水関連レプトスピラ症だが、直近2週間で症例数が27%増加し、DOHが医療対応強化（Code White Alert、抗生剤配布、保険適用拡大）を行うなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 季節性（habagat/雨季）による洪水関連の感染症で、フィリピン国内で例年発生している事象。直近の症例増加傾向とDOHの対応強化が報道されているため経過観察の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO's Tedros says Ebola outbreak remains global emergency
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo remains a global emergency. The Bundibugyo variant outbreak was first declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) on May 17. Updated recommendations will be issued in coming days to the Democratic Republic of Congo and other at-risk nations, Tedros said. The UN health agency announced this designation on Tuesday from Geneva. The article does not provide case or death counts. The PHEIC declaration signals the need for intensified international coordination and monitoring to curb transmission and protect neighboring regions. This follows the initial May 17 declaration and underscores continued risk in at-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのテドロス事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行は依然として世界的緊急事態にあると発言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）の流行がPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として継続宣言されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO本部の所在地であり実際の発生国ではないため除外。感染発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : l'épidémie constitue une urgence sanitaire mondiale avec plus de 5.000 cas confirmés (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: The outbreak constitutes a global health emergency with more than 5,000 confirmed cases (General Article).
article.articleSummary: WHO designates the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as confirmed cases exceed 5,000. By August 16, DRC reported 5,021 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths across 55 health zones in six provinces, with a 47.4% case-fatality rate and 1,061 recoveries. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, accounting for 84.8% of cases, while transmission accelerates in neighboring provinces, yielding a more dispersed geographic pattern. After 95 days since notification, the seven-day moving average surpassed 90 cases daily, and the outbreak is not yet in a clearly declining phase. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; no licensed vaccine or approved treatment specific to this strain exists. Experimental tools are expanding: two strain-specific vaccines are in human trials; the PARTNERS trial tests remdesivir + MBP134, with results in ~3–4 weeks. ERVEBO, a Zaïre-strain vaccine, is being considered for frontline workers under strict oversight to assess potential cross-protection.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ出血熱：感染確認者5,000人超で世界的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCのエボラ流行を国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)と認定し、確認例5,000人超・死者2,378人・致死率47.4%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み、感染は95日間継続し明確な減少傾向なし。Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、実験的治療（remdesivir+MBP134、ERVEBOのクロス防御検討）が進行中。感染はイトゥリ州が中心だが近隣州へ拡大しつつあり、国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: KKN-PK Unhas 69 Hadirkan KLIK SEHAT, Petakan Persebaran Penyakit di Rijang Pittu Sidrap Berbasis GIS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hasanuddin University's 69th KKN-PK presents KLIK SEHAT, GIS-based mapping of disease distribution in Rijang Pittu, Sidrap.
article.articleSummary: Kelurahan Rijang Pittu, Maritengngae District, Sidrap Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, hosts Hasanuddin University’s 69th KKN-PK project launching KLIK SEHAT, a GIS-based health mapping initiative. Using January–June 2026 data from Puskesmas Pangkajene and Ina-Geoportal for administrative boundaries, four health categories were mapped, totaling 731 cases. Non-communicable diseases account for 252 cases (diabetes mellitus type 1: 40; type 2: 73; hypertension: 139). Communicable diseases total 227 (pulmonary tuberculosis: 12; acute respiratory infections: 64; common cold: 128; dengue-related: 23 across Dengue Fever (DBD) and Dengue Fever (DD)). Musculoskeletal and gastrointestinal disorders number 147 (myalgia: 82; dyspepsia: 65). Dental/oral diseases total 105 (retained deciduous teeth: 46; pulpitis: 59). The mapping visualizes spatial patterns to help local government and health facilities target high-need areas.

triage.headline_ja: ハサヌディン大学の第69回KKN-PK、GISに基づく疾病分布マッピング「KLIK SEHAT」をリジャン・ピットゥ・シドラップで発表
triage.triage_reason: 大学の地域保健マッピングプロジェクトに関する報告であり、通常の疾病統計を紹介するもので、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は大学プロジェクトによる地域の疾病データの地理情報マッピングを紹介する内容で、結核・デング熱を含む既知の一般的な症例数の統計を示すのみであり、アウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 數小時內恐致死！緬甸爆發大規模霍亂　500人送醫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Myanmar could be fatal within hours; 500 people hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Yangon, Myanmar reports a cholera outbreak with 500 people hospitalized for severe diarrhea since Aug 9, including 149 rapid-test positives and 9 laboratory-confirmed Vibrio cholerae infections. This is the first official confirmation that the surge involves cholera after patients hospitalized for more than a week. The daily toll peaked on Aug 13 with over 100 admissions; numbers have since fallen as authorities continue epidemiological surveillance and control in affected areas. A 92-year-old man died after diarrhea, but officials say death was likely related to pre-existing heart and lung disease, not directly caused by cholera. Cholera spreads via contaminated food or water, causing copious watery diarrhea and rapid dehydration if untreated. WHO regards cholera as a global public health threat, highlighting water/sanitation gaps. Myanmar’s health system remains fragile amid prolonged conflict, with an estimated over 100,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 数時間で死に至る恐れも！ミャンマーで大規模コレラ発生　500人が病院搬送
triage.triage_reason: 500人が入院し、検査確定例もあるコレラ集団発生で、脆弱な医療体制下での拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 水・衛生インフラの不足と長期化する紛争により医療体制が脆弱化しているため、感染拡大や医療支援の必要性が高い。死亡例1件は基礎疾患によるものとされているが、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Vết thương do gà mổ, cụ bà 86 tuổi nhập viện vì uốn ván
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wound from a chicken peck; an 86-year-old grandmother admitted to hospital for tetanus.
article.articleSummary: An 86-year-old woman in Uông Bí, Vietnam, developed tetanus about 10 days after a chicken-related wound. She presented with jaw stiffness (trismus), dysphagia, and difficulty swallowing, with evolving muscle rigidity. Tetanus is caused by Clostridium tetani entering through contaminated skin wounds, and can progress to generalized spasms and life-threatening respiratory compromise. The case treated at Viet Nam-Sweden Uông Bí Hospital underscores that small wounds can harbor tetanus if contaminated and not properly managed, especially in older adults. Management hinges on wound assessment, vaccination history, and appropriate prophylaxis, including tetanus vaccination and/or tetanus immune globulin when indicated. Public guidance urges immediate wound cleaning, removal of debris, and prompt medical evaluation after animal-related injuries. If trismus, difficulty swallowing, rigidity, or spasms occur after a wound, seek urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: 鶏に噛まれた傷から破傷風、86歳女性が入院
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例であり、破傷風はヒト-ヒト感染せず、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 破傷風は感染症の伝播性がなく、単発の高齢者症例報告であるため公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: "Dista mucho de estar controlado": OMS emite nueva alerta por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Far from being under control": WHO issues a new alert about an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirms that, three months after the first Ebola case, the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In remarks to the WHO Emergency Committee, Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized that the epidemic is far from under control. The outbreak has nearly 5,000 infected and over 2,300 deaths, illustrating ongoing transmission. Officials cited considerable difficulties in identifying transmission chains, hindering containment. The declaration signals sustained international concern and the need for continued surveillance and tracing efforts to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 「制御にはほど遠い」：WHOがエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについて新たな警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続宣言し、感染者約5,000人・死者2,300人超と深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、伝播経路の特定が困難で国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを継続宣言している点から国際的な政治・社会的関心が高いと判断。感染者数・死者数の規模から重大な公衆衛生上の脅威と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Tưởng zona ngoài da, cụ ông 78 tuổi bất ngờ mắc viêm màng não
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thinking it was shingles, a 78-year-old man unexpectedly develops meningitis.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-19, a 78-year-old man in Uong Bi, Vietnam, presented at Vietnam-Sweden Uong Bi Hospital with a four-day vesicular rash in the buttocks and groin, diagnosed as herpes zoster (shingles). By day 2 he developed fever and severe headache, prompting a neurological workup. Lumbar puncture confirmed meningitis attributed to Varicella-zoster virus reactivation. This rare complication can occur when zoster involves the nervous system. The patient was treated for viral meningitis and recovered after 10 days and was discharged. The report urges caution for elderly or immunocompromised individuals and advises prompt care for neurological symptoms. Early antiviral therapy within 72 hours of skin lesions is recommended. Herpes zoster vaccine exists and is advised for people aged 50+ or 18+ with immunocompromising conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 帯状疱疹と思っていた78歳男性、突然髄膜炎を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単一の高齢患者における帯状疱疹（水痘・帯状疱疹ウイルス再活性化）による髄膜炎の個別症例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 個人の医療症例報告であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての性質はない。VZV再活性化による髄膜炎は既知の稀な合併症であり、感染症危機管理上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: د. مهند النسور : عودة الإيبولا و السيطرة على الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Mohannad Al-Nasour: The re-emergence of Ebola and containment of the outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading rapidly, with 4,945 confirmed cases and about 2,325 deaths (case fatality ~47%) reported by mid‑August 2026 across dozens of health zones. The United Nations calls it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date. A notable share of new infections are in people not on initial contact lists, and many deaths occur in communities rather than health facilities, signaling transmission chains escaping surveillance. Core control measures—surveillance, rapid diagnosis, contact tracing, timely isolation, safe and dignified burials, and robust risk communication—are essential, as outbreak control starts before patients reach care centers. Complicating factors include ongoing conflict, displacement, weak health services, and distrust between communities and health authorities. Vaccines and therapies for other Ebola types may not be automatically effective against Bundibugyo, underscoring the need for targeted research, trials, and tool development. Proactive health-system strengthening is critical for global health security.

triage.headline_ja: モハンナド・アル=ナスール博士：エボラの再流行と流行の抑制
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブジョ型エボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し、致死率約47%、感染追跡網を逃れる伝播が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 国連が『史上最速の拡大』と評するエボラ流行であり、紛争・避難民・医療体制の脆弱性・コミュニティの不信感が対応を複雑化させている。既存のワクチン・治療薬がブンディブジョ型に有効か不明であり、専門的研究が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies Injections : मुंबईत यापुढे एकही रुग्ण रेबीज इंजेक्शन नसल्याने परत जाणार नाही
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Injections: From now on, no patient in Mumbai will be sent back due to the unavailability of rabies injections.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination access in Mumbai is safeguarded as the municipal public health department states no patient will be turned away due to vaccine shortages. From December 2025 to May 2026, 12,078 stray dogs were sterilized and 30,055 vaccinated, with NGO-driven programs contributing to ongoing efforts. Since 1994 through June 2026, 454,982 stray dogs have been sterilized, with eight NGOs operating centers. Surveys in 2014 and 2024 indicate street-dog density in Mumbai declined by 22–28%. Between 2023 and 2026, 150,235 stray dogs were vaccinated. Humane Society International India–led census puts Mumbai’s stray dog population at 90,075. Shelter homes will be established in Mulund, Airoli Zakat Naka, Mahul, Malwani, Mumbai Port Trust areas, and other sites. Per Supreme Court directions, AI-based identification of institutionalized stray dogs covers 2,356 institutions and 7,850 dogs.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病ワクチン注射：今後、ムンバイでワクチン不足を理由に患者が帰されることはない
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ワクチンの供給確保や野良犬の避妊・ワクチン接種プログラムに関する行政広報であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ市当局による狂犬病予防・野良犬管理プログラム（避妊・ワクチン接種・シェルター整備）の実施報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。Pakistan関連の地域タグはBluedotの誤検出と判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Keracunan Ikan: Kenali Gejala, Penyebab, dan Cara Mencegahnya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fish Poisoning: Recognize the Symptoms, Causes, and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, the article highlights fish poisoning in Indonesia, focusing on histamine fish poisoning (scombroid) and bacterial poisoning from spoiled fish. Histamine poisoning arises when red-fleshed fish such as tuna, skipjack (cakalang), tongkol, kembung, or marlin, including pufferfish in some contexts, are stored improperly, leading to high histamine levels. Symptoms typically begin 10–60 minutes after eating (up to 2 hours) and include facial flushing, upper-body rash, headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal cramps, palpitations, and possible shortness of breath or hypotension; recovery usually occurs within 12–48 hours. Bacterial poisoning (e.g., Salmonella, Vibrio) from spoiled fish presents about 2–8 hours post-ingestion, with nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, cramps, fever, and potential dehydration or more severe infections. The article also mentions rare natural toxins like ciguatera (reef fish) and tetrodotoxin (pufferfish). No case counts are provided; emphasis is on awareness and proper storage to prevent illness in Medan, Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 魚の食中毒:症状、原因、予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒（ヒスタミン中毒・細菌性食中毒）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の報告はなく、感染症の異常発生を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の集団発生事例ではなく、魚介類による食中毒の一般的な症状・原因・予防法に関する健康教育記事である。具体的な感染者数や地域的アウトブレイクの記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says DR Congo Ebola outbreak far from under control
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains far from under control. As of Aug 16, 2026, the DRC reports 5,021 confirmed cases across 55 health zones in six provinces, with 2,378 deaths (case fatality rate 47.4%). Transmission outpaces response, sustaining high risk of domestic and international spread. The outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment and has prompted the May 17 WHO declaration of a public health emergency of international concern, after the May 15 notification by DRC authorities. It is the largest Ebola outbreak on record and the second-largest globally, with transmission described as intense and not yet in decline. Africa CDC warns it could become the deadliest Ebola epidemic if trajectory is not reversed, estimating about one death every 30 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRコンゴのエボラ流行は依然として制御下にないと発表
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みかつ史上最大規模のエボラ流行で、致死率47.4%、感染拡大が継続しており国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC(国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態)を宣言済みであり、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない。Africa CDCは最悪の場合史上最悪のエボラ流行になる可能性を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: 不只流感新冠！醫示警「這疾病」恐腦膜炎　今年已釀19死 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not only influenza and COVID-19! A doctor warns that 'this disease' could cause meningitis; 19 deaths this year.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) and meningitis risk rising alongside influenza and COVID-19 waves. By Aug 5, IPD had 161 cases with 19 deaths, with the 0–4 and ≥75 age groups most affected. Public health officials warn that Streptococcus pneumoniae can cause bacteremia, meningitis, and death. In late July–August, influenza-like visits reached 95,011 (week 32) and COVID-19-related ED visits 26,214, with 84 new severe COVID-19 cases—the high point of this wave, expected to plateau soon. Since Jan 15, 2026, Taiwan’s adult public-funded pneumococcal vaccination shifted to PCV20 for eligible 65+ and 55–64 Indigenous and 19–64 high-risk IPD groups, replacing PCV13+PPV23; from Aug 10, PCV21 is also available, with one dose providing full protection. 65+ vaccination completion is about 36.4%; targets are 40% by year-end and 45% by next year. Vaccination is advised for adults with risk factors and travelers to Japan, China, Hong Kong, and the United States.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザと新型コロナだけじゃない！医師が「この病気」による髄膜炎リスクを警告　今年すでに19人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性のインフルエンザ・COVID-19・肺炎球菌感染症（IPD）の流行状況に関する定期的な公衆衛生報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではない。異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）における季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告。中国・香港・米国・日本は海外渡航者へのワクチン接種勧奨の文脈でのみ言及されており、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: สธ. สั่งคุมเข้มด่านพรมแดน รับมือ "อหิวาตกโรค" ระบาดในย่างกุ้ง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health tightens border controls at border checkpoints to tackle the cholera outbreak in Yangon.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Yangon, Myanmar prompts tightened border controls at checkpoints by Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health. Since 9 August 2026, Yangon has admitted 500 diarrheal cases; 149 screened positive for cholera and 9 cases confirmed as Vibrio cholerae by Myanmar’s National Health Laboratory; one death occurred in an elderly patient with underlying heart and lung disease, though officials have not confirmed cholera as the cause. Most cases cluster in central Yangon around street-food markets. Authorities are inspecting food and water quality, disinfecting water supplies, increasing chlorine use, sanitizing homes, and suspending high-risk street foods. New cases appear to be easing, but surveillance continues. Travelers to affected areas face higher risk; pre-travel vaccination is advised two weeks before departure, and returning travelers with profuse watery diarrhea or vomiting should seek medical care and report travel history promptly. No serogroup/serotype/biotype disclosed. Risk of imported cases exists due to Thai-Myanmar travel.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、ヤンゴンでのコレラ流行を受け国境検問所での管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: ミャンマー・ヤンゴンで500例の下痢症例中149例がコレラ陽性、9例が確定、死亡例も発生。タイが国境管理を強化するなど国際的対応が生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生国はミャンマー（ヤンゴン）。タイは国境管理強化などの対応措置を取っているのみで、コレラ発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。死亡例はコレラが直接死因と未確定のため重症度評価には留意が必要。血清群・血清型・生物型は非公開。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh: Xuất hiện thêm ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết mới với 8 ca mắc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh: Another dengue fever outbreak with 8 cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Ky Hoa commune, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, with 8 new cases in the border area between Văn Miếu and Trung Thượng hamlets. Earlier on 7 Aug, 5 cases were reported in Tan Duc hamlet; Tan Duc outbreak now totals 9. Including 4 scattered cases elsewhere, total infections reach 21. Hà Tĩnh CDC, led by Director Nguyen Chi Thanh, inspected the area and found dense population, poor sanitation, uncollected waste, and water containers not regularly emptied, creating favorable conditions for transmission. Local health authorities had conducted environmental cleanup and fogging for 172 nearby households, but some residents remain lax. Officials warn the outbreak could escalate and urge intensified community mobilization, door-to-door vector control, and continued dissemination of preventive measures. For treatment, Ky Hoa Health Station will triage; mild cases managed locally, severe cases referred. CDC Hà Tĩnh will provide 7 liters of insecticide for perimeter spraying and deploy staff to guide control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省：新たなデング熱の感染集団が発生、8例確認
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省での季節性デング熱の小規模アウトブレイク（累計21例）であり、地元当局が対応中で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られないが、衛生状態不良によるベクター増加が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地元CDCが環境清掃・殺虫剤噴霧など対応中で、外部支援の必要性は記事からは示されていない。デング熱は東南アジアで季節性に発生するため異常性は低いが、衛生状態不良によりベクター増加・感染拡大の可能性があり注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Meghalaya Health Department on High Alert Along Bangladesh Border Amid Dengue Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Meghalaya's Health Department places medical teams along the Bangladesh border on high alert as a dengue outbreak rises in neighboring Bangladesh. Health Minister Wailadmiki Shylla stated border districts must maintain heightened vigilance and closely monitor the situation, though Meghalaya reports no significant surge in dengue or other vector-borne diseases so far. Mobile surveillance teams have been deployed across vulnerable border areas for early detection of suspected cases. The state’s frontline network—Sub-Centres, Primary Health Centres (PHCs) and Community Health Centres (CHCs)—is on alert, with health workers instructed to promptly report any sudden increase in symptoms linked to vector-borne diseases. The government has not yet found indications of a sharp rise warranting formal administrative notifications or additional directives. Monitoring teams will continue across key border areas to prevent spillover of the dengue outbreak from Bangladesh into Meghalaya.

triage.headline_ja: メガラヤ州保健局、バングラデシュ国境沿いでデング熱アウトブレイクを受けて厳重警戒
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュでのデング熱流行に対し、インド・メガラヤ州が国境地域で監視体制を強化しているが、州内では大きな症例増加は確認されておらず、実際のアウトブレイクは対象国外（バングラデシュ）で発生しているため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 実際のデング熱アウトブレイクはバングラデシュ（対象国リスト外）で発生しており、インド・メガラヤ州では予防的な国境監視強化にとどまり、州内での顕著な症例増加は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: एचआयव्हीचा विळखा! रायगडात चार महिन्यांत १०३ रुग्ण सापडले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The HIV net widens! 103 patients detected in Raigad in four months.
article.articleSummary: Raigad district, Maharashtra, reports a sharp HIV uptick: 103 HIV-positive cases detected from April to July 2026 after screening 61,833 people. Among positives, eight are pregnant women. Immediate counseling and initiation of antiretroviral therapy (ART) are underway, with Nevirapine syrup provided to newborns to prevent mother-to-child transmission. A total of 8,321 people have started ART, including more than 4,000 Raigad residents currently under treatment. Pre-ART registrations number 399 across three ART centers and eleven link ART centers. The Raigad District AIDS Control Committee notes unsafe sex, sharing injection needles, and HIV-contaminated blood transfusions as transmission sources. The report underscores ongoing public health measures to curb spread, including enhanced maternal treatment and neonatal prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: HIVの網が広がる！ラーイガドで4か月間に103人の患者が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるHIVの地域レベルの症例報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的なローカルニュースの範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地方自治体のAIDS対策委員会による既存の保健プログラムの一環としての定例報告であり、既知の性感染症・血液媒介感染症の管理状況を示すもの。新興・再興感染症の緊急性は認められない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: क्या हर बुखार में डेंगू या स्वाइन फ्लू का टेस्ट करवाना चाहिए? AIIMS के डॉक्टर ने बताया कब है जरूरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Should you get tested for dengue or swine flu for every fever? AIIMS doctors explain when it is necessary.
article.articleSummary: Delhi AIIMS Medicine Department Professor Dr. Neeraj Nishchal explains that fever does not automatically require dengue or swine flu tests. In Delhi, testing decisions depend on symptom profile, duration of fever, local transmission, and individual risk factors. Do not self-diagnose or self-medicate; avoid starting antibiotics or pain relievers without a clinician’s guidance. If fever is high, persistent, or accompanied by vomiting, dizziness, or other serious signs, consult a doctor promptly for appropriate tests. When dengue is suspected, avoid NSAIDs such as aspirin, ibuprofen, and diclofenac. For fever management, rest, adequate fluids, and paracetamol are recommended. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, good home ventilation, avoiding crowded places, and wearing a mask. The article emphasizes careful evaluation for dengue or swine flu testing rather than universal testing, with no case counts provided.

triage.headline_ja: 毎回の発熱でデング熱や豚インフルエンザの検査を受けるべきか？AIIMSの医師が必要なタイミングを解説
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、医師による発熱時の検査・対処に関する一般的な健康アドバイス記事であり、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な患者数や発生状況を報告するものではなく、デング熱・豚インフルエンザの検査適否に関する医療専門家の一般的な助言記事である。デリーでの流行状況や患者数データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS avisa que el brot congolès d'Ebola no està sota control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Congolese Ebola outbreak is not under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains far from controlled. As of 19 August 2026, the outbreak has nearly 5,000 cases and over 2,300 deaths, the second-worst on record. Cases have been detected in six provinces and 55 health zones in eastern DRC, with population movement and insecurity fueling transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak is not under control, citing deaths that occur at home and in communities outside treatment centers and contact lists, indicating an ongoing, unidentified transmission chain. The outbreak remains confined to DRC, but the risk of national and international spread is high, with a traveler reportedly bringing the virus to France last month. The WHO Emergency Committee met three months after declaring an international emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴのエボラ流行が制御下にないと警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約5000例・2300人超の死亡という史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、フランスへの越境例も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例は渡航者による輸入例であり、フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC国内の6州55保健区で継続的な未特定の感染連鎖が指摘されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh viện 19-8 cứu sống bệnh nhân mắc COVID-19 bên bờ "cửa tử"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital 19-8 saves a COVID-19 patient at death's door.
article.articleSummary: On 19 August 2026, a 43-year-old Vietnamese police officer (CAND) with severe COVID-19 progressed to ARDS, septic shock, and multiorgan failure. After initial pneumonia treatment failed, he was transported hundreds of kilometers to Hospital 19-8 in Hanoi for advanced care. A multidisciplinary team provided aggressive ICU support, including invasive ventilation via ARDSnet strategy, prone positioning, vasopressors, antibiotics, corticosteroids, anticoagulation, and meticulous fluid-electrolyte management, plus renal support. Antiviral drugs were urgently arranged through the Ministry of Public Security’s health authorities, and VV-ECMO was prepared as a rescue option if needed. In the first 72 hours, high-level therapies included dual cytokine adsorption with continuous renal replacement therapy. After nearly 30 days, lung and organ function improved; he was weaned from the ventilator and discharged on 19 August. COVID-19 is now Class B in Vietnam; ongoing vigilance remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 19-8病院、死の淵にあったCOVID-19患者を救命
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者の集中治療による回復を報じる医療エピソードであり、COVID-19は既にベトナムでクラスB（既知の流行性疾患）に分類されている。異常なクラスターや新規変異株、公衆衛生上の異常事象を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個別患者の治療成功例を紹介する医療ニュースであり、感染症サーベイランス上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。COVID-19は既に季節性・endemicな疾患としてベトナムで管理されている。

article.articleHeadline: 港男猴痘潜伏期与多男子高风险接触 疫苗接种建议
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox incubation period in a Hong Kong man and high-risk exposures to multiple men: vaccination recommendations.
article.articleSummary: On 17 August 2026, Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reported one confirmed mpox case in a 32-year-old man. He developed fever and myalgia on 11 August, with a rash by 14 August. He sought care on 15 August and was isolated at Princess Margaret Hospital; laboratory tests were positive and he is stable. He reported high-risk exposure to multiple unfamiliar men during the incubation period and was unvaccinated. No epidemiologic link to other cases identified; CHP is conducting contact tracing and has informed the WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 95 mpox cases: 76 locally acquired and 19 imported, all male. Most infections involve high-risk sexual behavior with multiple partners or unprotected sex. Vaccination is free at designated Department of Health Social Hygiene Clinics and Integrated Treatment Centres without appointment for high-risk groups. Public should avoid close contact with suspected cases or animals and seek care promptly if fever, rash, or lymphadenopathy appears.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の男性、サル痘の潜伏期間中に複数の男性との高リスク接触があったと報告 ― ワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 香港で単発のMpox確定例が報告され、既存の流行パターン（性的接触による感染）に合致する散発例であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の影響を示す情報は現時点でないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区はChinaに含めて評価。2022年以降95例の累積があり継続的な性的接触を介した感染が続いているが、個別の重大な公衆衛生危機とは言えない散発例。CHPはWHOに報告済みで接触者調査中。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli in Nampally water, 3 Hyderabad railway stations flagged
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Hyderabad’s three major railway stations—Nampally, Secunderabad, and Kacheguda—feature in a national CAG audit of 512 non-suburban stations. A water sample from Nampally’s water cooler tested positive for E. coli, highlighting water-safety concerns alongside shortages of drinking-water taps, urinals and signage. The audit found 458 stations (89%) deficient on at least one minimum essential amenity (MEA). Secunderabad, a high-traffic station, lacked adequate water coolers, dustbins and signage. SCR-wide gaps included seven stations with deficient drinking-water taps and 20 without dustbins; some toilets were unhygienic, with missing taps, seats or registers. Divyangjan accessibility was poor: 29 SCR stations lacked standard ramps, and all 32 assessed stations lacked Divyangjan-accessible water taps on alternate platforms. Railways announce a “tank-to-tap” overhaul with filtration at 20,000 locations, centralized monitoring and periodic public reporting.

triage.headline_ja: ナンパリー駅の水道水から大腸菌検出、ハイデラバードの3鉄道駅が問題指摘
triage.triage_reason: 水道インフラの品質監査に関する報道であり、感染症の集団発生や患者報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はCAG（会計監査院）による鉄道駅の設備監査報告であり、E. coliは水質検査の一項目として言及されているのみ。実際の感染症患者や発生事例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Lam Dong Refuerza La Atención Primaria Ante El Auge Del Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Dong Strengthens Primary Care in the Face of the Dengue Surge
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Lam Dong province in Vietnam is strengthening primary health care to address a dengue surge and rising hand, foot and mouth disease, with malaria under surveillance ahead of the school year. The priority is early detection, rapid isolation of outbreaks, and breaking transmission chains through reinforced primary care, epidemiological surveillance, and coordination with schools and families. Dengue, a viral illness spread by mosquitoes, typically presents with high fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pain, fatigue, and rash; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, drowsiness, or breathing difficulties. Prevention focuses on eliminating standing water and mosquito breeding sites. HFMD is rising among children, spreading in nurseries and schools; emphasize hand hygiene, surface disinfection, and not sharing utensils. Malaria remains a risk; report fevers promptly, use nets, protective clothing and repellents, especially when traveling to risk areas. School reopening needs collaboration to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ラムドン省、デング熱の急増に対し一次医療を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ラムドン省での季節的なデング熱・手足口病の増加に対する通常の公衆衛生対応であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でないが、学校再開に伴う感染拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事中の『Foot And Mouth Disease』は動物の口蹄疫ではなく、手足口病（HFMD）を指していると考えられる。デング熱・HFMD・マラリアはいずれも季節性の感染症で、学校再開に向けた通常の予防的対応が中心。重症例数や死亡者数など具体的な深刻度は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội: Kích hoạt cao điểm chống dịch, chặn nguy cơ bệnh sốt xuất huyết lây lan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi: Activate the peak period of epidemic prevention and control to curb the spread of dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Hanoi reported 316 dengue fever cases across 74 wards/communes for 7–14 August, up 81 from the prior week, with 11 new foci in Dân Hòa, Liên Minh, Mê Linh, Phú Nghĩa, Phượng Dực, Sóc Sơn, Tam Hưng, Thanh Oai, Xuân Đỉnh, Yên Lãng and Yên Nghĩa. Since January 2026, 63 outbreaks have been recorded, 24 still active. With the school year approaching, authorities warn of continued transmission and potential hand-foot-mouth disease outbreaks. Delayed detection (>7 days) worsens containment. The Hanoi Department of Health has activated a city-wide peak prevention period, demanding all 126 communes/wards implement the '4 at the site' plan, define roles, secure funding, staff, equipment, and chemicals. Local rapid-response teams led by village heads, supported by health workers and QR-based real-time larval surveillance, intensify environmental cleaning, larviciding, door-to-door outreach, and public messaging to curb vector spread.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ：デング熱流行拡大阻止のため防疫強化期間を発動
triage.triage_reason: ハノイで季節性デング熱の症例数増加と新規発生地の拡大が続いており行政が対応を強化しているが、重症度や死亡例の情報がなく国際的拡大リスクも低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: ハノイの季節性デング熱流行に関する行政対応の報道。手足口病（EV71）については学校再開時期の潜在的リスクとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生報告はない。重症度・死亡数などの詳細情報が不足しているため、フルRRAへの移行は保留し経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: The 'brain-eating' organism that lurks in warm water around the world | Discover Wildlife
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the 'brain-eating amoeba', thrives in warm freshwater and has been detected on every continent except Antarctica. Primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) occurs when water containing the amoeba enters the nose, allowing it to reach the brain via the olfactory nerve; early symptoms include headache, nausea and vomiting, rapidly progressing to confusion, hallucinations, seizures, coma and death. Historically about 97% mortality with roughly 500 documented cases over six decades. A landmark 1978 Bath, UK case led to a ban on hot-spring bathing at the Roman Baths. In 2025, Kerala, India experienced an unusually large PAM outbreak; about 200 PAM patients were treated with anti-parasitic and anti-fungal drugs, and more than half of known outcomes survived. The organism multiplies up to 46°C and can inhabit poorly chlorinated pools, residential heaters, or warm-water discharges. Transmission is not person-to-person; avoid nasal exposure by nose clips when in warm freshwater.

triage.headline_ja: 世界中の温水域に潜む「脳を食う」生物 | Discover Wildlife
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はNaegleria fowleri（脳食いアメーバ）に関する一般的な解説・啓発記事であり、2025年のケララでのアウトブレイクも既に終息した過去の事象として紹介されているに過ぎず、新規の公衆衛生シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事は科学解説・啓発コンテンツであり、2025年ケララでのPAMアウトブレイクは既知の過去事例として言及されているのみ。人-人感染はなく、現時点で新規の警戒すべき動きは確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 2 300 décès enregistrés en 3 mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: More than 2,300 deaths recorded in 3 months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has caused about 2,370 deaths among over 5,000 confirmed cases within three months across five provinces. Health Minister Roger Kamba, at a Kinshasa press briefing, dismissed rumors of a Kinshasa case. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain appears to be spreading faster than the Zaïre (Zaire) strain, though Bundibugyo remains less lethal. No Ebola cases are reported in Kinshasa. To curb transmission, 18 high-risk health zones will implement remote learning for the 2026–2027 school year. The World Health Organization has classified the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and is coordinating the response with the Ministry of Health and humanitarian actors. Emphasis remains on strict hygiene measures to prevent transmission and interrupt the infection chain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRC:過去3か月で2,300人以上の死者を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州にわたり5,000人以上の感染、2,370人の死亡を出し、WHOがPHEICと認定するなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが確認されるため。
triage.notes: キンシャサでの感染例は否定されているが、DRC全体での大規模流行が継続中。WHOによりPHEIC認定済み。Bundibugyo株の拡散速度上昇が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ заявили о высоком риске дальнейшего распространения лихорадки Эбола в Демократической Республике Конго -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO said there is a high risk of further transmission of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — NIAT "Khovar".
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of a high risk of further Ebola virus disease transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, both domestically and internationally, as this outbreak becomes the second largest in history. Since the outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern three months ago, about 5,000 people in six provinces and 55 health zones have been infected, with more than 2,300 deaths. He described the spread as unprecedented, driven by instability, population movement, and heavy cross-border activity along roads, rivers, and mining routes. The Emergency Committee heard that two Ebola vaccines have progressed to human clinical trials, and a separate cross-protective vaccine is approaching Phase 3. He addressed DRC, Uganda, and France representatives, underscoring cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の更なる感染�拡大の高いリスクを表明——NIAT「Khovar」
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行であり、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが高いとされているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスは越境リスクに関するWHO事務局長の発言の中で言及されているが、実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみと判断。ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Volsomme tal! 5000 smittede - 2378 døde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Staggering numbers! 5,000 infected — 2,378 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, according to DR Congo's public health institute via Reuters, as of 19 August 2026. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May and likely ongoing for weeks before. The United Nations says the crisis is costing a life every half hour. In July, WHO and Africa CDC warned the outbreak is spreading faster than any previous Ebola event. The deadliest prior outbreak occurred 2018–2020, with about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases. The report underscores rapid transmission and high mortality, highlighting that the DR Congo crisis remains the most severe Ebola event in recent memory.

triage.headline_ja: 驚くべき数字！感染者5,000人、死者2,378人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数・死亡者数が過去最悪の規模に達しており、WHO・Africa CDCも過去最速の拡大と警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2018-2020年の過去最悪の流行（死者約2,300人）を上回る規模で、致死率も高く、国際的な支援ニーズが明確に示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Over 5000 er nu smittet med ebola i DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 5,000 are now infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,021 confirmed cases as of August 19, 2026, with 2,378 deaths, indicating about a 47% mortality rate. The numbers come from the DRC's public health institute via Reuters. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, though authorities believe transmission began weeks earlier. The United Nations says the outbreak is currently costing a life every half hour. In July, the WHO and Africa CDC warned that the spread is faster than any previous Ebola outbreak. The deadliest Ebola outbreak occurred from 2018–2020, with around 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases. The report underscores rapid transmission and ongoing impact in the DRC, without detailing response measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 5,000人超の感染者・47%の致死率という重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、過去最悪の流行を上回るペースで拡大しているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 国連発表で30分毎に1人が死亡するペース、WHO・Africa CDCが過去最速の拡大と警告。2018-2020年の流行（死者約2,300人）を既に上回る規模。

article.articleHeadline: Un nou val de Ebola ucide aproape jumătate dintre bolnavi, în Congo: avertismentul de ultimă oră al OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new wave of Ebola is killing almost half of the patients in Congo: the WHO's latest warning.
article.articleSummary: Nord-Kivu province in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces a new Ebola wave, prompting a WHO warning. A mutant Ebola strain complicates diagnosis and treatment. Since mid-June, 174 cases (confirmed or suspected) and 82 deaths, a case fatality around 47%. Since May, 5,021 infections and 2,378 deaths, with over 1,000 recoveries. Lab confirmation is hampered by the variant, and responses to some antivirals may be reduced. WHO teams operate on the ground with Congolese authorities, but security instability in Nord-Kivu hinders access to communities. Declared mid-May, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. Studies suggest the outbreak may have begun as early as February. Over 4,500 direct contacts or high-risk individuals have been vaccinated. Mobility and weak health infrastructure raise spillover risk to Uganda and Rwanda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの新たな波が患者の約半数を死亡させる：WHOの最新警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で致死率約47%の変異エボラ株による新たな流行波が発生し、WHOが警告を発した。感染規模が大きく（5,021例、2,378死亡）、治安不安定による対応の困難さと周辺国への拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・ルワンダへの波及リスクが指摘されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。変異株による診断・治療の複雑化、抗ウイルス薬の有効性低下の可能性など、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: தவெக ஆட்சியமைத்து 100 நாள்; வாழ்வாதாரம் இழந்த டெங்கு ஒழிப்பு பணியாளர்கள்?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thavek's 100 days in power; dengue-eradication workers who have lost their livelihoods?
article.articleSummary: Dengue eradication workers in Karur district, Tamil Nadu, numbering over 160, who have been paid daily wages for more than 15 years, have had their dengue control duties halted since Aug 1, 2026. The suspension endangers both livelihoods and public health as monsoon-related mosquito breeding and vector control activities pause. The Karur district Rural Development Department Union representing the workers filed a formal petition with the district collector seeking continued deployment. Families—more than 160 impoverished households—depend on this wage, with elder medical expenses and children's education at stake. District authorities are urged to resume dengue control work promptly to protect public health and livelihoods. The appeal also notes political-party governance context: after the Tamil Nadu Victory Party took office, livelihoods of these workers worsened, unlike during AIADMK/DMK governance.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ヴィジャイ・カジャガム(TVK)政権100日；生計を失ったデング熱撲滅作業員たち？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の流行状況そのものではなく、タミルナードゥ州カルール地区のデング熱防除作業員の雇用停止・生計問題を扱う政治色の強い記事であり、感染症の症例数や流行拡大に関する具体的データがないため情報不足。ただし媒介制御活動の中断は今後の感染リスク増大につながる可能性があり、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主旨はデング熱防除作業員の労働・政治問題であり、実際の症例数や流行拡大に関する疫学的情報は含まれていない。モンスーン期の媒介制御中断による潜在的リスクの観点から続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: China Detects First Human H1N2v Swine Flu Case: What You Need to Know About This Rare Virus
article.articleSummary: China reports its first human infection with influenza A(H1N2)v, a rare swine-origin influenza virus. The case highlights zoonotic risks from animal exposure and the role of genomic surveillance in detecting cross-species infections. While H1N2v infections in people are uncommon, health experts emphasize close monitoring because influenza viruses can evolve to acquire characteristics enabling human infection. The article stresses vigilance in surveillance; no further details on clinical course, laboratory confirmation, or exposure specifics are provided. This event underscores China’s ongoing attention to animal-to-human spillover threats and the potential for rare swine-origin influenza strains to cross into humans as part of national public health preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、H1N2v型豚インフルエンザのヒト初感染例を検出：この稀なウイルスについて知っておくべきこと

triage.notes: 臨床経過、検査確認方法、感染源（動物との接触状況）等の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。新型インフルエンザ亜型のヒト感染例はIHR(2005)上、常時通報対象となりうる事象である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: إصابات إيبولا المؤكدة تتجاوز 5000 حالة - Lebanese Forces Official Website

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:確認されたエボラ感染者数が5,000例を超える

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 5 آلاف حالة

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases, with deaths rising to 2,378, according to government data issued on Wednesday. article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo exceed 5,000, government data shows

These figures reflect confirmed cases and may not capture suspected or probable cases. The report signals a sustained public health challenge for the region, underscoring the need for ongoing surveillance and response efforts. The brief provides only updated counts; no details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation processes, or imported/exported cases are included.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数、政府データにより5,000人を超える

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: Baudo Baraka Jules' coffin is being prepared for burial by response-team members in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, who secure a rope around the casket and lower it toward the grave at Nyamurongo Cemetery, with family members present. This moment unfolds within the context of an Ebola outbreak in the region. Jules had died at the Ebola Treatment Center northeast of Bunia after fever and vomiting, symptoms that his mother also experienced, while his father is currently under observation at the same treatment center. Family members witnessed the burial as responders carried out the interment in the cemetery today.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ出血熱の発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ブニアでエボラ出血熱の症例（死亡例および家族内での症状発生）が報告されており、致死率の高い感染症であり国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
