article.articleHeadline: WHO Influenza at the human-animal interface (Aug 7th) - Uptick in H9N2 Cases in China
article.articleSummary: WHO update dated Aug 7 (posted overnight) covers July 8–Aug 7 and reports 8 human H9N2 cases in Mainland China and 1 human H5N1 case in Cambodia (all previously reported). The Bangladesh July H5N1 case has been laboratory-confirmed as H5N1. The report notes an uptick of H9N2 activity in China, with a recent Hong Kong case, but it remains unclear whether this reflects more spillovers or improved surveillance. The background cites Chinese studies warning that H9N2 is accruing mammalian adaptations, including receptor-binding changes and HA mutations, raising pandemic risk. Mentioned lineages Y280/G57 show increasing mammalian adaptation, while African/Middle Eastern lineages are older. Studies across 2024–2025 report that inactivated poultry vaccines may fail to prevent transmission and could drive viral evolution. The report provides no new clinical symptom details or exported/imported case information.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによるヒト-動物境界面インフルエンザ報告（8月7日）－中国でH9N2感染例が増加傾向
triage.triage_reason: 中国におけるH9N2感染例の増加傾向と哺乳類適応変異への懸念が示されているが、重症度や社会的関心の情報が不足しており、現時点ではフルRRAに進むほどの明確なシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: カンボジア・バングラデシュのH5N1症例は既報告分であり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。香港の新規H9N2症例は中国(China)に統合して計上。哺乳類適応変異に関する研究知見は将来的なパンデミックリスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Четворо оболелих у Војводини: Грозница Западног Нила код свих прешла у тежак облик
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four ill in Vojvodina: West Nile fever has progressed to a severe form in all.
article.articleSummary: Four confirmed cases of West Nile fever were registered in the Autonomous Province of Vojvodina by August 16, with two cases in Central Banat and two in South Banat. Among the patients are three men and one woman, with a mean age of 52. All cases involve the neuroinvasive form of the disease (encephalitis and/or meningitis) requiring hospital treatment. West Nile fever is a seasonal, vector-borne illness in the region, transmitted by bites from infected mosquitoes, typically occurring June–November. About 80% of infections are asymptomatic; ~20% have mild flu-like illness; less than 1% develop severe neuroinvasive disease, presenting with severe headache, neck stiffness, drowsiness, disorientation, coma, tremors, seizures, weakness, or paralysis. Older individuals and those with immunosuppression or chronic diseases are at higher risk. Diagnoses are confirmed by infectious disease specialists based on clinical presentation and laboratory testing; severe cases require hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: ヴォイヴォディナで4人発症：全員が西ナイル熱の重症型に進行
triage.triage_reason: セルビア・ヴォイヴォディナ自治州における季節性の西ナイル熱発生であり、対象国（インド等）は記事の主題ではない。既知の媒介動物感染症で異常性・国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビア（対象国外）における西ナイル熱の季節性発生に関するもの。発生地域リストにUttar Pradesh（インド）が含まれているが、記事本文・サマリーではインドに関する言及がなく主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief: Ebola outbreak 'far from being under control'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo is far from under control, according to WHO chief Tedros at an IHR Emergency Committee meeting on 2026-08-19. To date, more than 5,000 cases and nearly 2,500 deaths have been registered in just under 100 days. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and is accelerating faster than previous episodes; experts fear it could become Africa's largest Ebola outbreak. The worst West Africa outbreak of 2014-2015 killed more than 11,000 people. Officials note a large number of unreported cases; well over 2,000 deaths have been reported since the outbreak was known, but many new cases have not been registered as contact cases, so the full picture is not yet visible. No details provided on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection source.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長:エボラ出血熱の流行は「制御下にあるとは言い難い」
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がIHR緊急委員会でコンゴのエボラ流行が史上2番目の規模で加速中と発言、5000例超・死者2500人超という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー中で言及がなく主題国とは確認できないため除外。多数の未報告例がある可能性が指摘されており、実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Deaths Top 2,300 as WHO Warns Crisis Persists
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is the largest and deadliest in the country’s history with almost 5,000 infections and more than 2,300 deaths across six provinces and 55 health zones as of mid‑August. Ituri province accounts for about 85% of cases and 79% of deaths. The WHO emergency designation remains in place; a continental plan seeks $518 million, with just over half disbursed. Weekly totals (Aug 3–9) reached 579 cases and 304 deaths. Lab counts vary by agency: WHO 4,665/2,184 (Aug 12); Africa CDC >5,000/2,320 (Aug 17); Congolese government 4,945/2,325. No Bundibugyo‑specific vaccine exists; two are in human trials, and a cross‑protection vaccine is moving toward phase 3 in animals. The PARTNERS trial (remdesivir + MBP134) enrolled 100 patients across three Ituri facilities. Attacks on health workers and deaths outside treatment centers hinder tracing; U.S. travel restrictions remain for DRC travelers within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者2,300人超え、WHOは危機継続を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が継続し、感染者約5,000人・死者2,300人超、WHOの緊急事態指定と国際的な資金要請、米国の渡航制限措置が発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAfrica大陸が含まれるが、記事の主題はDRC国内（特にIturi州）に限定されるためDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。国境を越えた人的拡大の明示的記述はないが、WHO緊急事態指定・国際資金要請・米渡航制限からリスクは高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola/RDC: Não há registo de uma epidemia a avançar tão depressa - Resposta internacional de emergência é precisa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: There is no record of an epidemic advancing so quickly - The international emergency response is precise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the 17th since 1976, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain—the only Ebola variant with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. As of 19 August 2026, the DRC Ministry of Health reports 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths, with the epidemic spreading rapidly across eastern provinces from Ituri near the Uganda border. Earlier figures cited more than 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths. Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases, including 15 importations, and declared itself Ebola-free on 28 July. Bundibugyo’s estimated case-fatality rate ranges 30–50%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. Contributing factors include insecurity, forced displacement, large refugee camps, and reliance on traditional healers. WHO warns the outbreak is far from controlled and calls for a robust international response to prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/コンゴ民主共和国：これほど急速に拡大する流行は記録にない - 国際緊急対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（バンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法未承認）がDRC東部で急速に拡大し、死亡者2,378名・症例5,021件、国境を越えた感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダは輸入例20件確認後7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済みだが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCが主要発生国であり、致死率30-50%と非常に高く、WHOも国際的な緊急対応を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Goma - Plus de 3 millions d'enfants visés par une vaccination intégrée contre la polio, la rougeole et la rubéole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Goma - More than 3 million children targeted by an integrated vaccination campaign against polio, measles and rubella.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo's North Kivu, Goma and surrounding territories will host an integrated vaccination campaign against polio, measles, and rubella targeting over 3 million children aged 0 months to 14 years across 15 health zones. Officially launched on 17 August 2026, the five-day operation runs 20–24 August 2026. Access remains challenging in some areas. The campaign will reach more than 1.8 million children aged 0–59 months for polio and about 2.9 million children aged 6 months–14 years for measles and rubella. The provincial Health Division reports a hybrid strategy: vaccinations in health centers, outreach activities, and door-to-door visits. North Kivu continues polio control efforts after a recent notification of a derivative poliovirus case in neighboring Maniema province. The campaign also aims to strengthen measles and rubella immunity, amid ongoing reported cases in several zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ゴマ - ポリオ、麻疹、風疹に対する統合予防接種キャンペーンが300万人以上の子どもを対象に実施
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ（デリバティブ株）の症例通知と麻疹・風疹の継続的な発生が背景にあるが、記事本文は主にワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、詳細な症例数や重症度データが不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 隣接するマニエマ州でのポリオ由来株症例の通知、及び麻疹・風疹の継続的発生が言及されているが、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数等の詳細は記事に記載されていない。ワクチン接種キャンペーン自体は公衆衛生対応活動であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Nashik: Dengue Cases Rise As Rainfall Triggers Mosquito Breeding; Notices Issued To 208 Establishments
article.articleSummary: Nashik reports a dengue outbreak driven by monsoon rainfall, with the Malaria Department issuing show-cause notices to 208 establishments after dengue larvae were found, including eight government offices such as Zilla Parishad, Nashik Road Railway Station, and the Government Polytechnic at Samangaon. Dengue and other mosquito-borne diseases (chikungunya, malaria, swine flu) rise during the monsoon. Dengue larvae breed in vacant plots, construction sites, basements, scrap yards, tyre shops, rooftop water tanks, and any water-logged area. Case counts by month show 6 (Jan), 3 (Feb), 2 (Mar), 1 (Apr), 3 (May), 8 (Jun), escalating to 33 in July as rainfall increased water stagnation. Citizens are urged to prevent standing water around homes and seek prompt medical attention if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ナシク:雨季による蚊の発生増加でデング熱患者が増加、208事業所に通知発行
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加であり、モンスーン期の通常の傾向に一致する。国際的拡大やIHR基準への該当性は低いが、症例数増加傾向のため経過観察が望ましい。
triage.notes: モンスーン期における例年の蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア）の季節的増加であり、地方自治体レベルでの対応（通知発行、監視強化）が行われている。重症度や死亡数に関する情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Từ 15/8/2026 đến 15/9/2026 tổ chức Tháng cao điểm phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From August 15, 2026 to September 15, 2026, organize the Dengue Fever Prevention and Control Peak Month.
article.articleSummary: Hanoi, Vietnam launches a Dengue Fever Prevention and Control Peak Month from 15 August to 15 September 2026 as dengue cases rise in the capital. Nationally, over 70,000 dengue cases and 9 deaths were reported in the first seven months of 2026, with Hanoi showing a six-week upward trend and persistent outbreaks. The forecast projects further increases as students return to Hanoi and weather favors Aedes mosquito proliferation. The city directs integrated actions: Hanoi Department of Health to monitor, assess risk, standardize diagnosis and treatment, triage and refer patients, ensure medicines, intravenous fluids, and blood supplies, and train staff; Culture, Sports and Tourism and Education sectors to intensify public information, school-based prevention, environmental cleaning, and vector control; Finance to allocate funds; Construction to address water stagnation near worksites; Public Security to support enforcement and outbreak response; ward/commune authorities to implement control measures during the peak month.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年8月15日から9月15日まで、デング熱予防・対策強化月間を実施
triage.triage_reason: ハノイ・ベトナムでの季節性デング熱の増加と死亡例（全国で7か月に7万例超・9名死亡）が報告されているが、例年発生する媒介蚊媒介性の流行であり、政府主導の対策キャンペーンが既に開始されているため、直ちにフルRRAへ進める段階ではないが、感染拡大の傾向を継続監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの季節性・地域流行病であり、記事は政府主導の予防対策強化月間（8/15〜9/15）の実施を報じる行政的な内容。異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は見られず、既に国内で管理体制が構築されている。今後の患者数・死亡者数の推移を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái viêm phổi do đồng nhiễm Covid-19 và tụ cầu vàng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Little girl with pneumonia caused by coinfection with COVID-19 and Staphylococcus aureus.
article.articleSummary: Coinfection of SARS-CoV-2 and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) caused pneumonia and acute bronchiolitis in a 4-month-old girl in Hanoi, Vietnam. An presented with fever 38.5°C, cough, rhinorrhea, wheeze. Hospital Tam Anh Hanoi diagnosed acute bronchiolitis on the backdrop of COVID-19; chest X-ray showed lung parenchymal involvement; throat swab culture grew MRSA; SpO2 declined to 92% prompting IV antibiotics and oxygen therapy. After three days, oxygen was no longer required. MRSA is resistant to beta-lactams including methicillin. Antibiotic susceptibility testing guided targeted therapy; patient rapidly improved: fever resolved, feeding normal, SpO2 stabilized on room air, lung auscultation normalized. Because of prior noisy breathing since birth, clinicians recommended airway assessment after recovery (echocardiography, chest CT) to identify potential airway malformations. Emphasizes that coinfections worsen outcomes in pediatric respiratory illness; seasonal changes increase pathogen circulation. Prevention includes hygiene and full age-appropriate vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19と黄色ブドウ球菌の重複感染による肺炎の女児
triage.triage_reason: 単一の小児患者に関する臨床症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事象を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はハノイの病院における個別の小児患者（生後4ヶ月女児）のCOVID-19とMRSAの重複感染による肺炎・急性細気管支炎の臨床症例報告であり、患者は治療により速やかに回復している。集団感染や公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての要素はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Des motards vandalisent des véhicules de la riposte contre Ebola à Aru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Motorcyclists vandalize Ebola response vehicles in Aru.
article.articleSummary: On August 17, 2026, in Kandoy, Aru territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, motorcyclists vandalized Ebola response vehicles and a health facility, injuring a driver and causing material damage. The violence is linked to two suspected Ebola cases reported in the area, though some community members dispute them, and investigations to identify responsibility are ongoing per sector chief Israel Omo of Ndo. The attacked convoy was en route to Kandoy to retrieve a female caregiver and an eight-month-old baby labeled as suspected cases by the alert team; both were to be transported to Aru-center for higher-level medical care. The infant’s mother reportedly died recently in Mongwalu under a context suspected of Ebola, though these cases have not yet been laboratory-confirmed. By Tuesday, calm had returned, but several patients had fled the health facility and motorbike-taxi traffic remained paralyzed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:アルにおけるバイク運転者らがエボラ対応車両を破壊
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例（乳児とその母、及び死亡した母親）が報告され、対応チームへの暴力事件も発生しており、IHR基準の重大性・異常性が該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 疑い症例は未検査確認であり、感染確定情報が入り次第、追加のRRAで重症度・拡大リスクの再評価が必要。地域住民の対応拒否・暴力行為は対応活動の実施可能性に影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Warum die Eindämmung so schwerfällt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Why containment is so difficult.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading to more provinces, with over 5,000 cases and nearly 2,500 deaths reported in about 100 days. Containment is proving increasingly difficult as transmission expands geographically and aid organizations report being stretched to their limits. The piece outlines key questions and answers about the outbreak, highlighting challenges in surveillance, case management, and community engagement amid fragile health infrastructure. The expanding outbreak underscores the risk of further spread within the country and potential cross-border movement. International and local responders are attempting to intensify contact tracing and field operations, but access, security, and logistical constraints continue to hinder containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：なぜ封じ込めがこれほど困難なのか
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラが複数州に拡大し、5000例超・死者2500人近くと重大な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大リスクや対応能力の限界も示されているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 致死率約50%と非常に高く、複数州への拡大、国境を越える移動リスクが明記されている。医療体制の脆弱性と支援団体の限界も報告されており、緊急のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - L'OMS juge l'épidémie "loin d'être maîtrisée", Kinshasa défend sa riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola - WHO says the epidemic is far from under control; Kinshasa defends its response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is far from controlled. By August 18, 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases and about 2,325 deaths, with roughly 90% of cases in Ituri—the main epicenter and the deadliest outbreak in the DRC’s recent history. Six provinces are affected, spanning 55 health zones (about 8% of the country's zones). The World Health Organization warns that national and international spread remains elevated, urging faster data sharing, durable funding, greater security, and stronger cross-border coordination; concern centers on deaths occurring outside treatment centers and known contact lists. Field teams face insecurity and scarce ambulances. Two vaccines designed against Bundibugyo have entered human trials in a Partners study enrolling 100 patients. With schooling due soon, authorities plan offline distance-learning and enhanced hygiene measures in affected areas; 40% of schools are in zones with cases, 13% in high-risk zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱 - WHOは「制御には遠い」と判断、キンシャサは対応を擁護
triage.triage_reason: 5,000人超の確定患者・2,325人の死者を伴う大規模エボラ流行がDRC6州に拡大し、WHOが国内・国際的拡大リスクを警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数を満たす。
triage.notes: DRC史上最も死亡率の高いエボラ流行とされ、6州55保健地帯に拡大。WHOは資金・治安・データ共有の強化を要請しており、フルRRAへの移行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو يصل إلى 5000 حالة متجاوزًا جهود الاستجابة بسرعة غير مسبوقة - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola outbreak in the Congo reaches 5,000 cases, outpacing response efforts at unprecedented speed - Al-Ahram Gate
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of Sunday, according to the Ministry of Health. Transmission is occurring under extremely challenging conditions, including insecurity, displacement, and high population mobility, accelerating spread to unprecedented speeds. Since the first case, the outbreak has expanded about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic, which killed over 11,000 people. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated that the outbreak has spread quickly and that the local and international risk remains high, noting the epidemic is far from under control. The report underscores the urgency for enhanced response measures amid ongoing insecurity and population movement in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が5000例に達し、前例のない速さで対応努力を上回る - アル・アハラム・ゲート
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5000例超・死者2378人に達し、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の約3倍の速度で拡大しており、WHO事務局長も国際的リスクが高いと明言していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー本文はDRCの流行状況のみを主題としているため、Angolaはverified_locationsから除外した。Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Myawaddy Launches 'Crackdown' on Sex Trade as HIV Infections Surge
article.articleSummary: Rising HIV infections along the Myanmar–Thailand border spur a Myawaddy crackdown on sex work in Karen State. On August 13, police raided two brothels on Pyi Thayar Street, arresting 32 women and four men; women were sentenced to three years, men to five. The operation followed remarks by Colonel Soe Moe Win that sex work would be eliminated to curb HIV transmission. Health workers and residents say the arrests are cosmetic and won’t reduce the trade or HIV; effective prevention requires regular medical checks and access to care at brothels, KTVs, and massage parlors. Myawaddy, a hub with about 60 brothels, 40+ massage parlors, and 16 karaoke venues, reports HIV infections rising by dozens monthly. HIV/AIDS treatment recipients increased from 1,688 (2024) to 2,055 (2025) and 2,419 (2026), per Myawaddy District Health Department.

triage.headline_ja: ミャワディでHIV感染急増を受け性売買の「取り締まり」開始
triage.triage_reason: 国境地域でHIV感染が緩やかに増加している事例だが、急性感染症のアウトブレイクではなく既知の慢性感染症の傾向報道であり、数値も具体性に欠けるため、追加情報を待って評価する。
triage.notes: HIVは慢性感染症であり、既存の対策プログラムの一環として報道されている。急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しないが、性産業従事者への感染拡大リスクと取り締まりによる医療アクセス低下の懸念があるため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak reaches 5,000 cases as it outpaces response efforts at unprecedented speed
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Congo has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of Sunday, with Ituri province’s Bunia the epicenter. The virus appears to have begun spreading from the Mongbwalu mining town as early as February, with authorities declaring the outbreak on May 15. The current outbreak is spreading about three times faster than the West Africa 2014–2016 epidemic, and the World Health Organization warns the risk of national and international spread remains high and the outbreak is far from under control. The overall case fatality rate stands at 47.4%, rising to about 70% in North Kivu where response is most challenged. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus. Response is hindered by insecurity, displacement and attacks on health workers, including incidents in Aru; road access and community information gaps further complicate containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が5,000例に到達、前例のない速さで対応能力を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）が該当し、WHOも国際拡大リスクを警告している重大なエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州、Bunia、Mongbwalu鉱山町）のみが感染発生地として言及されており、他国での確定例は記載されていないため除外した。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、致死率47.4%（一部地域70%）、治安悪化・保健従事者への攻撃が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ предупредила о распространении Эболы в ДР Конго в 2026 году
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warned of the spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread and is not yet under control, with cases nearing 5,000 and deaths exceeding 2,300. The outbreak has affected six provinces and 55 health zones as of August 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the situation has deteriorated over the past three months. Many patients die outside health facilities, complicating contact tracing and leaving some transmission chains unknown. Ongoing armed conflict and mass displacement hinder response efforts. In Bunia, one of the epicenters, health workers report distrust and occasional resistance from communities, including an attack on an ambulance. WHO appeals to local moto-taxi drivers to assist in prevention and rapid identification of suspected cases. The risk of further spread, including beyond the DRC, remains high.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国における2026年のエボラ拡大を警告した
triage.triage_reason: 症例数約5,000、死者2,300人超と規模が大きく、複数州・保健区に拡大しており、WHOも国際的拡大リスクを警告しているためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 武力衝突や住民の避難、医療施設外での死亡が接触者追跡を困難にしており、地域社会の抵抗（救急車襲撃）も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من تفشي إيبولا خارج حدود الكونغو الديمقراطية بعد تخطي الإصابات 5 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of an Ebola outbreak outside the borders of the Democratic Republic of the Congo after surpassing 5,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases, with transmission accelerating faster than any prior outbreak. The World Health Organization warns the epidemic could spread beyond borders, risking Uganda and other neighbors, as cross-border transmission remains likely. The outbreak, first declared on May 15 (the seventeenth in DRC) and believed to have circulated weeks earlier, is ongoing across six Congolese provinces, including areas near the South Sudan border, amid weak health infrastructure and conflict-related disruptions. WHO’s Emergency Committee has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) with the national risk deemed very high in DRC and high in Uganda and nearby countries, though overall global risk is considered low. Context notes the deadliest Ebola outbreak (2013–2016) caused over 11,300 deaths in West Africa (Liberia, Sierra Leone, Guinea).

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国での感染者5000人超えを受けエボラの国境を越えた拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5000人超の感染者を伴うエボラ流行が拡大中で、WHOがPHEICを宣言し越境拡大の高いリスクを警告しているため、IHR基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行が主題であり、ウガンダ・南スーダン国境近隣地域への拡大リスクが言及されているが、実際の感染確認は現時点でDRC国内に限定されている。対象国リストにあるDRC以外（スーダン、シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ウガンダ、ギニア）は背景情報や過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Người Việt Nam thứ 44 mắc giun rồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 44th Vietnamese to contract Guinea worm.
article.articleSummary: Guinea worm disease (dracunculiasis) case marks Vietnam’s 44th infection, from Lao Cai province. A 49-year-old farmer with forest/stream exposure sought care for two ulcers on the left arm. About 20 days earlier, he discharged white worm segments—10–15 cm from the first lesion and ~20 cm from the second—later burned in nylon. Ultrasound and tests confirmed Dracunculus medinensis infection. The patient was initially afebrile and asymptomatic, later developing swelling, redness, and mild systemic symptoms. Transmission occurs when drinking water containing copepods with larvae, with aquatic hosts such as fish, frogs, tadpoles and shrimp. Vietnam has reported 26 cases from 2020–2025; previously none. There is no vaccine or drug; treatment is careful extraction of the worm. Prevention emphasizes boiling water, avoiding raw foods, hygiene, and community surveillance. Northern provinces affected include Yen Bai, Phu Tho, Thanh Hoa, Lao Cai, and Hoa Binh.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムで44人目のギニア虫（メジナ虫症）感染者
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでは本来流行のないギニア虫症（世界的根絶対象疾患）の非流行国内発生が続いており異常性は高いが、今回は単発の症例報告であり急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: ベトナムは歴史的にギニア虫症の流行国ではないが、2020年以降26例が報告されており、感染源（水系・魚介類等）の特定と地域サーベイランス強化が必要。単発症例のためWATCHとしたが、非流行国での継続的発生は世界的根絶事業上重要な監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de cas d'Ebola a dépassé le seuil des 5000 cas en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases has surpassed the 5,000-case threshold in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Among the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), lab-confirmed cases have reached 5,021, with 270 additional suspected cases as of last Sunday. The death toll stands at about 47%, and more than 1,060 people have recovered. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reaffirmed that the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) after the WHO Emergency Committee meeting in Geneva. The WHO says reversing the outbreak’s trajectory within the next three months remains possible if the necessary resources are mobilized, but the outbreak is far from controlled. The figures reflect ongoing transmission and the continued prioritization of the outbreak on the international health agenda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数が5000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: PHEICとして再確認された大規模なエボラ流行であり、致死率約47%、症例数5000件超と公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が非常に高い事象であるため。
triage.notes: スイス（ジュネーブ）はWHO緊急委員会の開催地として記載されているのみで、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。WHOはPHEICを再確認しており、3か月以内の状況改善には追加資源投入が必要としている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: " En première ligne de la riposte gouvernementale ", Roger Kamba - " Il y a beaucoup de chances qu'Ebola n'arrive pas à Kinshasa "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: "At the forefront of the government's response", Roger Kamba - "There is a good chance that Ebola will not reach Kinshasa."
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola response leaders presented updated measures in Kinshasa during a cabinet briefing. Premier Judith Suminwa Tuluka chaired the technical session with Public Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba and response chief Jean-Jacques Muyembe to review the outbreak and new directions. Three axes were approved: reinforced medical actions alongside standard measures; salary pay scale for physicians, nurses, and frontline responders, formalized by decree; and improved risk communication to counter infodemic and boost community adherence to prevention, vaccination options, and care pathways. Vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain are under study, with antivirals considered for patients or highly exposed workers. The salary scheme was validated to harmonize compensation on the ground. Surveillance on the Congo River was reinforced; 65 km from Kinshasa a health post screens boats from affected zones. No Ebola cases have been recorded in Kinshasa; authorities aim to maintain vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）：「政府対応の最前線に立つ」ロジェ・カンバ氏 ― 「エボラがキンシャサに到達しない可能性は高い」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生事象であり、キンシャサへの拡大リスクや政府の閣議レベルでの対応が報告されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサでの感染例は報告されていないが、政府が河川監視強化やワクチン・治療薬の検討など積極的な対応策を協議している内容であり、アウトブレイクの継続と首都への拡大リスクが注視される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola en RDC - Le Gouvernement décrète la riposte à grande échelle pour garantir le succès de la rentrée scolaire 2026-2027 !
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola in the DRC - The Government declares a large-scale response to ensure the success of the 2026-2027 school year!
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launches a large-scale Ebola response to safeguard the 2026-2027 school year. In an August 18, 2026 briefing, the government announced a differentiated restart of classes from September 1, with four weeks of distance learning (no internet) using printed materials and radio programs to curb Bundibugyo-strain transmission. The Education Ministry reports 40 of 138 sub-divisions across six provinces affected by Ebola, with 18 in high-risk (red) zones. The six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo—totalling 55 health zones are affected. Epidemiological data show 5,021 confirmed cases, 751 in isolation, 1,061 recovered, and 2,378 deaths. Vaccination is highlighted as a key tool, in a response led by the President and coordinated by Education, Health, and Communications ministries to protect populations during the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱 - 政府が2026-2027年度の新学期を成功させるため大規模対応を発令
triage.triage_reason: 5,021人の確定例、2,378人の死亡、6州55保健地区に及ぶ大規模なエボラ出血熱流行（第17次）であり、政府が学校閉鎖・遠隔学習を含む大規模対応を発令している。公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染リスクからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内の教育対応に焦点を当てているが、感染規模（5,000例超、死者2,378人）と地理的拡大（6州55保健地区）から国際的注目度が高いイベントと判断。国境を越えた拡大リスクについては明示的記載がないため一部不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vajdaságban eddig négy esetben azonosították a nyugat-nílusi vírust
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Vojvodina, the West Nile virus has been identified in four cases so far.
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, four West Nile virus fever cases have been identified in Vojvodina, Serbia, with two in Central Banat and two in South Banat. Patients—three men and one woman—have average age 52. All cases progressed to the neuroinvasive form, causing encephalitis and/or meningitis, requiring hospitalization; some remain in hospital. West Nile fever is seasonal, transmitted by infected mosquitoes, with activity from June to November in the region. About 80% of infections are asymptomatic; ~20% develop mild influenza-like illness, while a minority develop severe neuroinvasive disease. Neurological symptoms include severe headache, neck stiffness, drowsiness, confusion, coma, tremor, seizures, muscle weakness, and paralysis, especially among older and immunocompromised individuals or those with chronic diseases such as diabetes, cancer, or cardiovascular disease. Diagnosis is made by an infectious diseases specialist based on clinical presentation and lab tests. Severe neuroinvasive cases require hospitalization. Preventive precautions to reduce risk are advised.

triage.headline_ja: ヴォイヴォディナで西ナイルウイルスが4例確認
triage.triage_reason: セルビア・ヴォイヴォディナでの西ナイル熱発生であり、対象国リストに含まれない。インドの地域情報は記事サマリーに全く言及がなくBluedotの誤付与と判断される。
triage.notes: 西ナイル熱は季節性の既知疾患でセルビア国内での例年発生パターンに合致。対象国（India等）はBluedotの地域付与エラーと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ca giun rồng thứ 44 tại Việt Nam làm tổ dưới da người đàn ông
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam detects its 44th Guinea worm case, burrowing under a man's skin.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam, as of 19 August 2026, reports its 44th Guinea worm disease case. A 49-year-old man from Lao Cai province presented at Dang Van Ngữ Hospital in Hanoi with two deep lesions on the left forearm. About 20 days earlier he noticed pimples that swelled; on 17 August his family extracted two white segments, 10–15 cm and 20 cm long, then burned them. Ultrasound on 19 August showed a thickened subcutaneous tract in the left forearm (6–8 mm). He had no fever or itching. There is no pre-symptom diagnostic test; diagnosis is made when the worm emerges. There is no drug to treat Guinea worm; removal of the worm is the only known method. Prevention focuses on boiling water, avoiding raw or undercooked foods, and good hygiene. Since 2020 Vietnam has 43 prior cases; Lao Cai has 26, Phu Tho 14, Thanh Hoa 3.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでギニア虫（メジナ虫）症の44例目を確認、男性の皮下に寄生
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの単発のギニア虫症例（44例目）であり、重症度・拡大リスクは低いが、根絶対象疾患の非典型的発生地域という異常性があり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症（dracunculiasis）はWHOの根絶対象疾患であり、アジア地域での発生は極めて稀。2020年以降ベトナムで43例の既往があり、今回で44例目。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、水・食品を介した感染経路のため国際拡大リスクは低いが、根絶プログラムの観点から継続的な症例報告の監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Clases a distancia con fichas y emisiones de radio en zonas de riesgo por el ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Remote classes with worksheets and radio broadcasts in Ebola risk zones in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists with 4,945 cases and 2,325 deaths to date, making it the second deadliest on record and the worst in Congolese territory. In response, the government will start the 1 September school year with a differentiated approach in outbreak zones. Of 138 educational subdivisions in affected provinces, 40 are directly impacted and 18 are high risk. Three risk levels — green, orange, red — govern schooling: green zones with no Ebola cases resume normally; orange zones, affected but controlled, maintain in-person classes with reinforced prevention (hygiene, handwashing, distribution of health kits); red zones implement distance learning via printed worksheets and local radio broadcasts (no internet needed). Materials are distributed every two weeks for pickup by parents; students may continue their academic trajectory and sit state certification exams. High-risk zones keep schools as service points. The plan lasts four weeks, pending Health Ministry review.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危険地域における学習帳と地域ラジオ放送を用いた遠隔授業
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は死者2,325人・症例4,945人に達し、同国史上最悪規模とされる深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は学校再開に関する対応策が主題だが、背景として既知の大規模エボラ流行（史上2番目の致死率、コンゴ領内最悪）の統計情報が含まれるため、フルリスク評価対象として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận trường hợp người đàn ông mắc giun rồng thứ 44 tại Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam records the 44th case of a man infected with Guinea worm.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports its 44th Guinea Worm Disease (Dracunculus medinensis) case in Lao Cai Province on Aug 19, 2026. The patient, a 49-year-old man named N.V.T., works in cinnamon bark peeling and has long rural exposure, frequenting forests, streams, and drinking spring water. He presented with two non-itching, afebrile skin lesions on the left forearm. On Aug 17, family extracted two white worm segments, about 10–15 cm and 20 cm long, which were burned. Ultrasound showed localized subcutaneous thickening in the left forearm. There is no pre-symptomatic laboratory test; removal of the worm is the current treatment, with emphasis on not rupturing the worm and maintaining hygiene to prevent spread. Since 2020 Vietnam has recorded 43 prior cases, mainly in Lao Cai (26), Phu Tho (14), Thanh Hoa (3). Public health advice: boil water, avoid raw foods, and seek medical care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムで44例目のギニア虫（メジナ虫）感染症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ギニア虫症はアフリカ諸国での撲滅計画対象疾患であり、ベトナムでの感染経路不明な継続的発生（累計44例）は異常事象としてWHO等の関心対象であり、続報監視だけでなく評価に進める価値がある。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症（Dracunculiasis）は通常アフリカ諸国（チャド、南スーダン等）でのみ確認される疾患であり、ベトナムでの感染経路（水生生物媒介の有無）が未解明。2020年以降累計44例と継続的発生がみられ、国際的なギニア虫撲滅プログラム（WHO/CDC）の関心事項となっている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie entrave l'accès aux soins de santé de routine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak hampers access to routine health care.
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is hindering access to routine health care. Health workers warn fear of infection deters pregnant women from clinics, increasing risks of fetal complications, stillbirths, and premature births. A mother treated near an Ebola Treatment Center described trauma and anxiety that complicates seeking care. To curb transmission, health teams strive to maintain essential services while reinforcing Ebola safety protocols; several facilities were temporarily closed, staff quarantined, and premises disinfected before reopening. At Elikya Hospital, medical leaders report the facility is now safe and encourage women to seek care to prevent complications. The situation highlights the tension between outbreak control and ongoing maternal–neonatal health needs amid an active Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・DRC:流行が日常的な医療アクセスを妨げている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、DRCで活動中の流行が医療システムに影響を及ぼしていることから、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: エボラは既知の疾患だが、DRCで継続中の流行であり、医療システムへの間接的影響（母子医療アクセス低下）が報告されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無は記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Jabalpur News: शहर भर में मौसमी बीमारियों का फैला प्रकोप, न तो कीटनाशक का छिड़काव और न ही फॉगिंग का धुआं | Outbreak of seasonal diseases spreads across the city; neither insecticide spraying nor fogging is being carried out.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jabalpur News: Outbreak of seasonal diseases spreads across the city; neither insecticide spraying nor fogging is being carried out.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal illnesses are spreading across Jabalpur as of August 19, 2026, amid monsoon rains, with mosquitoes and various viruses driving infections. Despite repeated municipal reviews and plans, sanitation remains patchy: main roads get sweepings, but lanes and older neighborhoods see little regular cleaning. Areas including Niwadganj, Sarafa, PandriBa, Dikshitpura, Andherdev, Tulaaram Chowk, Trimurti Nagar (FCI Line), and MulaniGanj report garbage dumps, clogged drains, and foul odors that foster disease. No insecticide spraying or fogging is being carried out. Residents have complained of illnesses among children, women, and the elderly; malaria cases have been reported in MulaniGanj, with others suffering seasonal illnesses. Health department actions appear lacking, and vector-control measures are not implemented, risking wider outbreaks unless sanitation and mosquito-control steps are promptly initiated.

triage.headline_ja: ジャバルプル・ニュース：市内全域で季節性疾患の流行拡大、殺虫剤の散布も燻蒸消毒も実施されていない
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のマラリア発生とベクター対策の不備が報告されているが、規模・重症度等の詳細情報が不足しており、地域限定的な衛生管理の問題として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地方メディアによる季節性疾患（マラリア含む）の報道で、地元自治体の衛生管理・防蚊対策の不備が主題。国際的な影響や重症度に関する具体的データは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Second dengue death reported at Tenkasi Sri Lankan Tamil refugee camp
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-19, dengue continues in a Sri Lankan Tamil refugee camp near Boganallur, Kadayanallur taluk, Tirunelveli district, Tamil Nadu. More than 150 families reside there. Over the past month, more than 50 residents developed fever and were treated at area hospitals. The camp recorded its second dengue death: 13-year-old Rihana Mary, daughter of Rajan-Saila Sri, died while receiving treatment at Tirunelveli Government Medical College Hospital. A second resident, Narmala (27), wife of Dinesh, also treated for dengue at Tirunelveli Government Hospital, died on Tuesday despite treatment. In response, health and sanitation authorities intensified activities. Residents allege dumping and burning garbage from surrounding areas near the camp creating unhygienic conditions, and urged removal of the garbage and improved cleanliness to prevent further spread of dengue.

triage.headline_ja: テンカシのスリランカ・タミル難民キャンプでデング熱による2人目の死亡が報告される
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州の難民キャンプ内でのデング熱による死亡例が続いているが、規模は単一キャンプに限定的であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。衛生状態悪化による感染継続の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インドのデング熱は季節性流行が一般的であり、本件は特定の難民キャンプ内での衛生環境悪化に起因する局地的アウトブレイク。国家レベルの公衆衛生危機というよりコミュニティレベルの問題であり、ゴミ処理などの環境改善対応が続報の鍵となる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N2

article.articleHeadline: China's First Human H1N2v Case Raises Flu Concerns
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old child in Yunnan Province, China, tested laboratory-confirmed for influenza A(H1N2)v, a swine-origin virus. The patient, exposed to domestic pigs, developed fever and cough with mild respiratory illness requiring hospital care and recovered after treatment including oseltamivir. Whole-genome sequencing showed all eight gene segments closely related to swine influenza viruses circulating in China. No secondary cases among close contacts and no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. WHO notes human A(H1N2)v infections are rare but monitored; one infection occurred between 23 January and 31 March 2026, with another in the following surveillance period. The case underscores animal-to-human transmission risk but does not indicate an outbreak. Emphasizes early detection, genetic sequencing, and surveillance at the human-animal interface (One Health) to prevent future transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で初のヒトH1N2v感染例が確認され、インフルエンザへの懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブタ由来の新型インフルエンザA(H1N2)v亜型のヒト感染例が中国・雲南省で初めて確認され、WHOが監視対象としているため、パンデミック潜在リスクの観点からフルリスク評価に進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 患者は軽症で回復し、二次感染例も確認されていないが、新型インフルエンザ亜型（H1N2v）のヒト感染はWHOの継続監視対象であり、動物-ヒト境界面でのサーベイランス強化が求められる事例。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو يسجل أكبر موجة تاريخية بأكثر من 5 آلاف إصابة - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo records the largest wave in history with more than 5,000 cases - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 5,021 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths as of early August 2026, the largest outbreak in the DRC to date by case count and the seventh in the current wave. Began May 15, this outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments, complicating control and transmission reduction. Despite containment efforts, response is hampered by weak health infrastructure, hard-to-reach areas, and community resistance to preventive measures, alongside security instability and protests by health workers that disrupt surveillance, case finding, and isolation. With rising fatalities, authorities underscore the ongoing need for rapid surveillance, adequate resources, and a robust, well-supported response to limit further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行、5,000人以上の感染者を記録し史上最大の波に
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）の史上最大規模の流行で、5,021例・2,378人死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン・治療薬のない株であることや治安不安・医療インフラ脆弱性から国際的拡大リスクも高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ株はワクチン・承認治療薬がなく、致死率が高い（約47%）。治安不安、医療従事者の抗議活動、コミュニティの抵抗が対応を困難にしている点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: أرقام صادمة.. إيبولا ينتشر بسرعة قياسية غير مسبوقة تاريخيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking numbers... Ebola spreads at a pace unprecedented in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread at an unprecedented pace in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of Sunday, the Ministry of Health reports 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths, with the outbreak unfolding under insecurity, displacement, and dense population movement that hinder response. The outbreak has infected and killed more people faster than any previous Ebola crisis. Since the first case, transmission has progressed roughly three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which caused over 11,000 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the outbreak has spread quickly and the risk remains high domestically and internationally; the epidemic is far from under control. International warnings of worsening spread and cross-border impact persist.

triage.headline_ja: 衝撃の数字…エボラが史上前例のない速さで拡大

article.articleHeadline: АПОКАЛИПТИЧНИ СЦЕНИ ВО КОНГО - СЗО бара итна помош!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: APOCALYPTIC SCENES IN CONGO - WHO CALLS FOR URGENT AID!
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains a global health threat, with confirmed cases surpassing 5,000 and more than 2,320 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged urgent international aid after an emergency meeting, noting ongoing transmission chains that must be interrupted. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the deadliest in the country’s history, with deaths already exceeding 2,299 from the 2018–2020 period. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or official treatment. Response is hampered by armed conflict, misinformation, distrust of health workers, and local traditional practices, complicating hotspot detection. The outbreak was officially declared May 17, but genomic analyses indicate spread began in February. Vaccination efforts include an experimental vaccine in the UK (first volunteer vaccinated last month); India has produced hundreds of thousands of doses of a vaccine developed with the University of Oxford, which, if trials succeed, will be shipped to the field.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける惨状 - WHOが緊急援助を要請！
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5,000例・2,320人以上の死亡に達し、WHOが緊急援助を要請するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: インドと英国はワクチン開発・生産拠点として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm một ca giun rồng được phát hiện tại Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another case of Guinea worm disease detected in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Guinea worm disease (dracunculiasis) case 44 detected in Vietnam since 2020. A 49-year-old male, N.V.T. from Mậu A, Lao Cai, presented with two deep lesions on the left forearm. Family had removed two white worm segments, about 10–15 cm and 20 cm, on Aug 17. The patient is a cinnamon-peeler and farmer; he works in forests, swims in streams, and drinks spring water. Ultrasound on Aug 19 showed thickened subcutaneous tissue along one third of the left forearm (6–8 mm) with a diffuse hyperechoic area. He was afebrile, with no itching or pain, and remains able to work. Since 2020 Vietnam has reported 43 cases: Lao Cai 26, Phu Tho 14, Thanh Hoa 3; most patients are male and consume raw or undercooked foods. No drug exists; treatment is complete worm extraction. Prevention: avoid rupturing the worm, avoid raw foods, boil water, keep lesions dry, and seek care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでギニア虫症(dracunculiasis)の新たな症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: ギニア虫症は世界的に撲滅対象の希少疾患であり、ベトナムでの非典型的な発生継続（2020年以降44例目）は異常性が高いが、当該症例は軽症で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症は本来アフリカ諸国が主流の疾患であり、ベトナムでの発生（2020年以降44例、Lao Cai・Phu Tho・Thanh Hoaに集中）は非典型的で、WHOのギニア虫症撲滅プログラムの関心対象となる可能性がある。個々の症例は軽症・局所的だが、感染経路（生水・生食・森林労働）が継続しているため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Praygraj News| Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News in Hindi Newstrack | Praygraj News: घूरपुर में जलनिकासी ठप, मुख्य मार्ग पर जलभराव से हाहाकार; बीमारी का खतरा मंडराया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Praygraj News| Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News in Hindi Newstrack | Praygraj News: In Ghoorpur, drainage is stalled, waterlogging on the main road causes chaos; risk of disease looms.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, in Ghoorpur village, Praygraj, the drainage system is badly clogged, causing waterlogging on the main road after rainfall. The blocked drain allows dirty water to stagnate, creating a foul odor and enabling mosquito breeding. The resulting floods disrupt mobility, with residents and schoolchildren forced to wade through water. Residents allege repeated complaints to the gram panchayat secretary and other officials, yet no cleaning or long-term drainage solution has been implemented. Block-level authorities have been informed but action remains absent. Health risk is rising due to mosquito-borne and other infectious diseases associated with stagnant water. Residents urge immediate on-site inspection, clearance of the blocked drain, elimination of waterlogging, and a permanent drainage solution to prevent worsened conditions during rains and to protect public health and daily commute.

triage.headline_ja: プラヤグラージ・ニュース：グールプルで排水機能停止、幹線道路の浸水で混乱；病気のリスクが浮上
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症の発生ではなく、排水不良による浸水と将来的な疾病リスクへの懸念を報じる一般的な公衆衛生記事であり、実際の症例報告や異常事態は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の疾病の発生報告ではなく、排水不良・浸水による蚊の発生と将来的な感染症リスクを懸念する住民の訴えを扱った内容。具体的な症例数や病名の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: KPKP Jakbar vaksinasi puluhan hewan penular rabies di Jelambar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Jakarta's KPKP vaccinates dozens of rabies-transmitting animals in Jelambar.
article.articleSummary: West Jakarta's KPKP vaccinated 36 rabies-transmitting animals in Jelambar's RW 005 (Grogol Petamburan) on Wednesday, including 23 dogs, 12 cats and 1 monkey. The vaccination drive aims to boost community awareness of regular pet vaccination and keep Jelambar free from rabies. Officials say free vaccination makes it easier for residents to protect their pets while saving time and costs. Through May 2026, 3,692 rabies-transmitting animals have been vaccinated toward an annual target of 9,300, with vaccination efforts continuing across eight districts in West Jakarta to reach the end-of-year goal. The program is run by the West Jakarta City Government’s Food Security, Marine Affairs and Fisheries Service (KPKP).

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo exceed 5,000 as outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 5,000, reaching 5,021 by Tuesday, with 2,378 deaths over the weekend. This is the largest outbreak in DR Congo’s history and the second-largest globally, driven by the Bundibugyo strain for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Declared May 15, cases have continued to rise despite response efforts. Challenges include weak healthcare infrastructure, community resistance, insecurity, and protests by response workers, limiting access to affected areas, case identification, and contact tracing. Insecurity and limited resources slow medical support and transmission prevention. Authorities call for stronger public health measures and increased international support to bolster the response as Congo battles its worst Ebola outbreak to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱感染者数が5,000人を超え、アウトブレイクが悪化
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で死者2,378人、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株による深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際支援の必要性も明示されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、治安悪化・医療体制の脆弱性・地域社会の抵抗により対応が困難化。DRC史上最大、世界でも2番目に大きい流行規模。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận ca bệnh giun rồng tại Lào Cai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guinea worm disease case reported in Lào Cai.
article.articleSummary: Guinea worm disease (dracunculiasis) case reported in Lao Cai, Vietnam. A 43-year-old resident, N.V.T., presented to Dang Van Ngữ Hospital (Hanoi) on 19 Aug with two deep left-arm lesions. Ultrasound and history confirmed Dracunculus infection after two white, threadlike worm segments, 15 cm and 20 cm long, were extracted and burned. He works peeling cinnamon bark, frequents forests, wades in streams, and drinks spring water. About 20 days earlier, two nodules appeared; initial cleaning with alcohol failed, and swelling prompted family removal of the worms. There is no pre-symptom diagnostic test or specific antiparasitic drug. Transmission occurs via water containing copepods harboring Dracunculus larvae; the worm may emerge through the skin, risking sepsis, septic arthritis, abscess, tetanus, or deformities. Prevention emphasizes boiled water and hygiene. Since 2020, Vietnam has reported 44 cases: Lao Cai 27, Phu Tho 14, Thanh Hoa 3, predominantly in men who consume raw or undercooked foods.

triage.headline_ja: ラオカイ省でギニア虫症(dracunculiasis)の患者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでは本来非流行地域とされるギニア虫症の症例が継続的に報告されており(2020年以降44例)、地理的異常性はあるが、単発症例で重症度・国際的拡大の証拠は乏しく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症はWHOの根絶対象疾患であり、通常アフリカ諸国（チャド、南スーダン、エチオピア等）で報告される。ベトナムでの継続的な症例報告（ラオカイ省、フート省、タンホア省）は地理的に異常だが、感染経路は水中のケンミジンコを介した感染であり、ヒト-ヒト感染は起こらないため疫学的拡大リスクは低い。続報および累積症例数の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية لأكثر من 5000 مريض
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola virus infection cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to over 5,000 patients.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, government data show that confirmed Ebola virus disease cases have surpassed 5,000, with the latest totals reaching 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of early this week. The outbreak represents the 17th wave of Ebola in the country and is described by the Public Health Institute as the largest in history in terms of case numbers, with the late July peak driving the surge. By this latest report, the outbreak ranks as the second-worst globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic in both infections and deaths. The update underscores the scale of the ongoing outbreak and the challenge of containing multiple waves within a single country.

triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での第17波エボラ流行に関するもので、Angolaは主題として言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO extends global health emergency over DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: The WHO extends the Ebola Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak. As of 19 August 2026, it records 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths—the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and second largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Transmission risk: very high across six DRC provinces; high in Uganda; global risk low. Factors: persistent insecurity, displacement, mining corridors, transit routes. Security challenges and violence against health workers: recent attack in Ituri's Aru territory injuring an ambulance driver. WHO actions: ramping up community engagement with motorcycle taxi associations; deploying over 100 epidemiologists and 500 community health workers for contact tracing; 400 new hospital beds. Funding: about 60% of the $115 million appeal secured. Critical needs: sustained vigilance, survivor-led trust-building, regional coordination.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCエボラ出血熱流行に関する国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を延長
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを延長するほどの大規模エボラ出血熱流行（確定4,945例、死亡2,325例、DRC史上最大）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染リスクは「高」、世界的リスクは「低」とされているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であり、ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を延長している点は既にWHO通知済み事案であることを示す。

article.articleHeadline: أول حالة إصابة بشرية بفيروس إنفلونزا الخنازير لطفل في الصين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human infection with swine influenza virus in a child in China
article.articleSummary: China reported its first human infection with swine influenza A(H1N2)v in a healthy child aged 2 years 10 months. The patient developed fever and persistent cough, progressing to bronchopneumonia; initial testing detected influenza A and Haemophilus influenzae. Treated with antibiotics and inhaled budesonide, fever subsided and breathing improved; the child was discharged after recovery. Conventional assays were negative, but next-generation sequencing recovered the swine-origin influenza A(H1N2)v genome, confirming infection by a virus typically circulating in pigs and distinct from seasonal human influenza viruses. Although most swine influenza viruses do not cause disease in humans, direct contact with infected pigs is a known risk. This case emphasizes the need for genomic surveillance to identify unusual influenza strains. Location: China. Date: 2026-08-19.

article.articleHeadline: أول إصابة بشرية بفيروس إنفلونزا الخنازير لطفل فى الصين.. اعرف التفاصيل - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human case of swine flu virus in a child in China: find out the details
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, China reports the first human infection with swine-origin influenza A(H1N2)v in a 2-year, ten-month-old child from a rural area where pigs, poultry, and doves are raised near homes. The child developed fever and recurrent cough, progressed to bronchopneumonia, and required hospitalization. Initial testing showed influenza A and Haemophilus influenzae; CT revealed progressive lung involvement. He improved after antibiotics and inhaled budesonide, and was discharged. Genomic sequencing by next-generation sequencing identified a reassortant A(H1N2)v genome with genes from H1N1, H1N2, and H3N2 lineages, confirming A(H1N2)v. Routine RT-PCR can be negative; genomic surveillance proved crucial for confirmation. Infection likely stemmed from pig exposure: a relative’s pig died near the time of illness; two other pigs had respiratory and gastrointestinal symptoms; influenza A was detected in a pig carcass. Thirty close contacts tested negative; no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. WHO notes swine influenza viruses rarely cause sustained human disease; emphasize hygiene for workers near pigs.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で子どもの豚インフルエンザウイルス初のヒト感染例、詳細判明

triage.notes: 新型リアソータント株A(H1N2)vのヒト感染は稀であり、豚由来と推定される。接触者30名は陰性でヒト-ヒト感染の持続的証拠はないが、遺伝子解析によるサーベイランス強化が必要。続報でヒト-ヒト感染拡大の有無を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ebola no Congo ultrapassam 5.000, segundo dados do governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 5,000, according to government data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 5,021 confirmed cases, according to government data released Aug 19, 2026. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC has become the country’s largest by case count, with the Public Health Institute reporting 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths as of the latest situation update, ending the weekend. The outbreak, which began earlier in July, has prompted authorities to warn that response efforts are not containing transmission. The DRC’s outbreak ranks as the second-worst globally to date, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic in both infections and fatalities. The report underscores ongoing transmission challenges and the continuing public health emergency in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数、政府データによると5,000人を超える
