article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola tại Congo vượt mốc 5.000 ca nhiễm, tốc độ lây lan nhanh gấp 3 lần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 5,000 cases, spreading three times faster.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of August 19, 2026, with a case fatality rate averaging 47.4% and up to 70% in North Kivu. The outbreak, the 17th Ebola wave in DR Congo, is driven by Bundibugyo and spreading three times faster than the West Africa 2014-2016 epidemic. Transmission appears to have started in Mongbwalu in February, with many new cases outside official surveillance after the May outbreak declaration, due to insecurity, mass displacement, and ongoing population movement. Health facilities face attacks in Ituri's Aru region; staff strike over unpaid wages. WHO warns it remains a global health emergency and advocates closer-to-community responses, including using motorcycle-taxi drivers for surveillance. Oxford vaccine candidate for Bundibugyo has begun trials in the UK, with hundreds of thousands of doses produced in India and ready for use pending trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染者5,000人を突破、拡大速度は3倍に加速
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染者5,021人・死者2,378人（致死率47.4%）に達し、拡大速度が過去の西アフリカ流行の3倍とされ、WHOが世界的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態と表明している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 英国・インドはワクチン開発・生産拠点として言及されているのみで、感染拡大の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安悪化・住民避難による監視体制の不備が感染拡大の一因とされ、国際的な支援（WHO・ワクチン試験）が既に動いている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fears keep pregnant women away from healthcare in eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s deadliest Ebola outbreak is driving pregnant women away from healthcare, increasing risks of stillbirths, premature births, and maternal deaths. In Bunia, Ituri province, fear and the proximity of Ebola treatment centers deter prenatal care, with Elikya Hospital reporting missed appointments and late arrival of complications. The hospital briefly closed for 21 days for quarantine and disinfection, but staff say it is now safe. Anxiety remains among new mothers, including those who delivered near Ebola facilities. National data show rising maternal deaths, with UNFPA reporting weekly deaths jumping from 3.1 to 5.8 between May 25 and July 19; non-facility deaths nearly doubled. The outbreak has recorded thousands of confirmed cases and more than 2,000 deaths. Health workers are strengthening infection prevention and striving to restore confidence in essential services while continuing outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラへの恐怖がコンゴ民主共和国東部で妊婦を医療から遠ざけている
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で継続中の大規模エボラ流行（死者2000人超）が妊産婦の医療アクセスを阻害し母体死亡増加を招いており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と重症度の高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行に関する二次的影響（妊産婦医療アクセス低下）の報道。UNFPAのデータが引用されており国際機関の関与が確認できる。流行そのものの新規性は低いが、被害の深刻化・継続を示す内容のためPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Katastrophe im Kongo - fast 2.500 Tote in nur 100 Tagen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Catastrophe in the Congo - Almost 2,500 Dead in Just 100 Days
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases and nearly 2,500 deaths in just under 100 days. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the epidemic is far from under control and could become Africa’s largest, potentially exceeding the 2014–2015 West Africa crisis that killed over 11,000. Experts note a large undercount; since discovery in mid-May, authorities report more than 2,000 deaths and many cases not linked to known contacts. The outbreak has spread from Ituri to six provinces, complicating surveillance in remote, insecure areas. MSF runs seven treatment centers and multiple isolation units across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with about 430 beds and 1,400+ staff. Armed groups, travel restrictions, and the upcoming monsoon season threaten access to tests and care; malaria and other diseases may surge, worsening the crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ大惨事 - わずか100日で約2,500人死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が5,000例・2,500人以上の死亡に達し、6州へ拡大、WHO事務局長も過去最大規模になり得ると警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー上ではDRC国内（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopo）の流行のみが主題であり、Angolaでの発生は記載がないため除外した。マラリア等他疾病の増加リスクも言及されているが、主題はエボラである。

article.articleHeadline: पावसाळी तापाचा विळखा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Grip of Monsoon Fever
article.articleSummary: Monsoon-driven health concerns rise in Uran taluka, Maharashtra, with dengue and a seasonal fever labeled 'hivatap' alongside cold, cough, fever, and body aches. June recorded 450 hivatap cases, July 1,380, and August 1-15 saw 1,142 hivatap cases. Dengue counts were 66 in June, increased in July, and 247 cases were treated in August’s first 15 days in private and government hospitals. In August’s first 15 days, daily counts in Uran taluk ranged from about 200 in Uran city to roughly 700 across the taluk for fever, cough, body ache, dengue, and other illnesses. Public health measures emphasize cleanliness and boiled drinking water; residents are advised to seek hospital testing promptly and follow medical guidance. Indira Gandhi Rural Hospital, led by Dr. B. M. Kale, urges timely testing and sanitary practices.

triage.headline_ja: 梅雨時の熱病の脅威
triage.triage_reason: マハラシュトラ州ウランでのデング熱・季節性発熱症例が増加しているが、モンスーン季における例年の流行パターンであり異常性は低い。重症度・死亡者情報が不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 地域病院（Indira Gandhi Rural Hospital）が対応し、公衆衛生対策（清潔保持・煮沸水の推奨）を呼びかけている地域限定の季節性流行報道。重症度・死亡者数の情報が記事に含まれておらず判断材料が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Mahakam Ulu Ingatkan Warga Waspadai ISPA dan Diare Saat Musim Kemarau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mahakam Ulu Health Office Reminds Residents to Watch Out for Acute Respiratory Infections (ARI) and Diarrhea During the Dry Season.
article.articleSummary: On August 19, 2026, Mahakam Ulu Dinkes P2KB warns residents to guard against Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) and diarrhea during the dry season. ARI, caused by viruses, bacteria, or other organisms, affects upper to lower respiratory tracts; dry air, dust, and smoke—especially from forest fires—raise risk, while air pollutants from vehicle exhaust compound exposure. Diarrhea risk rises with contaminated water and foods; diarrhea is linked to hygiene and water quality, with low river flow possibly increasing bacterial load; river contamination from litter, including used diapers, is noted. Although ARI cases are reported, many residents self-medicate and are not captured in health records. Two border sub-districts require ongoing medicine logistics. Preventive measures include boosting immunity via nutritious meals, multivitamins, and ample clean water; maintain healthy environments and monitor dengue risk during pancaroba.

triage.headline_ja: マハカム・ウル保健局、乾季における急性呼吸器感染症（ARI）と下痢への注意を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は乾季における一般的なARIと下痢への注意喚起が主題であり、デング熱については季節性の警戒事項として一文で触れられているのみで、具体的な発生数・症例情報は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は乾季における公衆衛生の一般的注意喚起であり、デング熱は文末で「乾季の変わり目（pancaroba）に注意」と触れられる程度で、具体的な感染事例や集団発生の報告はない。ARIおよび下痢についても具体的な症例数は不明で、既存の季節的な保健指導に留まる内容。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura tem 30 dias para apresentar estudo técnico e adequar equipes de combate à dengue - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall has 30 days to present a technical study and to adjust dengue-control teams - Conexão Tocantins - News Portal
article.articleSummary: The Municipality of Sucupira, southern Tocantins, must within 30 days present a technical assessment to dimension its Endemic Disease Control Agent workforce and adjust vector-control teams to bolster surveillance and response against dengue, chikungunya and zika. The order, issued by a Civil Public Action brought by the Tocantins Public Prosecutor’s Office, follows findings that the municipal service relied on a single Endemic Disease Control Agent and lacked a technical study showing adequate staffing. It also requires continuous active case finding for suspected arboviruses who do not return for investigations. The municipality must provide a concrete timetable for staffing, including possible hires via public selection process under Law No. 11.350/2006, and document efforts to locate, follow-up, and close cases. Noncompliance carries a daily fine of R$1,000, capped at R$30,000, given the risk of disease spread.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所、デング熱対策チームの体制整備に関する技術報告書提出まで30日の期限 - Conexão Tocantins
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア・ジカは既知の流行性感染症であり、本記事は感染拡大自体ではなく自治体の人員体制整備を命じる行政訴訟に関する内容であるため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は検察による自治体への行政命令に関する内容で、具体的な症例数や流行規模の情報はない。デング等は当該地域で既知の流行病であり、異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Menos conhecidas, hepatites D e E também circulam no Brasil e preocupam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Less well-known, Hepatitis D and E are also circulating in Brazil and raising concerns.
article.articleSummary: Brazil hosts circulating Hepatitis D (Delta) and Hepatitis E alongside the better-known A–C. A meta-review of 200 studies (2013–2024) involving over 14.5 million people, published in PLOS One (July) and part of Einstein’s project on viral hepatitis in vulnerable populations, highlights regional variability and notable prevalence. Hepatitis D is most evident in the Amazon region, with up to 23.9% prevalence linked to Hepatitis B co-infection and to more severe liver injury; genotype 3 predominates there, and vaccination against Hepatitis B helps prevent D, though rapid Delta testing is unavailable. Hepatitis E is transmitted via contaminated water/food and zoonotically from pigs; genotype 3 predominates in Brazil, with studies in the South reporting up to 59% and overall prevalence ranging 0.9%–59.4%. Animal reservoirs exist across regions. Authors emphasize these forms may be underdiagnosed, underscoring the need for targeted surveillance to advance elimination efforts.”}{

triage.headline_ja: あまり知られていないD型・E型肝炎もブラジルで流行しており懸念される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2013-2024年のメタレビュー研究（学術的疫学レビュー）の紹介であり、急性のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして拾う必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の慢性的な疫学状況（B・D・E型肝炎の地域的流行）に関するメタレビュー研究の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや緊急対応を要する事象ではない。アマゾン地域でのD型肝炎、南部でのE型肝炎の高い罹患率は継続的な公衆衛生課題として言及されているが、急性シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Le nombre de cas d'Ebola a dépassé le seuil des 5000 en République démocratique du Congo - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases has surpassed the 5,000 threshold in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases. As of Sunday, 16 August 2026, 5,021 cases have been confirmed and 270 are suspected, with a case-fatality rate of about 47% and more than 1,060 recoveries. In Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), following guidance from the Emergency Committee of independent experts. The WHO says it remains possible to reverse the outbreak’s progression within the next three months if necessary resources are mobilized, but the situation is far from under control. The remarks underscore ongoing international concern and the need for sustained public health action to curb transmission in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の感染者数が5000人を超える - RTBF Actus
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を継続宣言しており、致死率約47%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO本部所在地であり実際の発生国ではないため除外した。PHEIC継続宣言中であり、フルRRAへの移行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad sees seasonal surge in viral fevers, flu-like illnesses amid wet weather
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Hyderabad is experiencing a seasonal surge in viral fevers, influenza-like illnesses (ILI) and suspected vector-borne cases linked to persistent wet weather and high humidity. Outpatient departments across major state-run hospitals, including Fever Hospital and Gandhi Hospital in Secunderabad, report rising walk-ins with fever-dominant presentations. Clinicians note many patients have overlapping symptoms that resemble influenza, dengue, and chikungunya. Common presentations include sudden high-grade fever, severe body aches, fatigue, headaches, and respiratory symptoms such as scratchy throat and cough. While dengue and malaria testing often return negative, doctors caution that aggressive circulating viral and respiratory strains are the main culprits. Public health authorities urge residents to remove stagnant water, ensure safe drinking water, and avoid self-medication to curb transmission and complications.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードで湿潤な天候の中、季節性のウイルス性発熱・インフルエンザ様疾患が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の気候要因によるウイルス性発熱・ILIの増加であり、重症化や国際的拡大の情報はないが、デング・チクングニヤ等の媒介動物感染症の可能性が排除できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は雨季による季節性のウイルス性発熱・呼吸器症状の増加を報じており、デング・マラリア検査は陰性が多いとされる。重症例・死亡例の言及はなく、地元医療機関で対応可能な範囲と見られる。今後デング・チクングニヤ等の確定診断が増える場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Langka di Kongo 'Menggila', Tewaskan Lebih dari 2 Ribu Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare Ebola outbreak in Kongo 'goes wild', killing more than 2,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Kongo region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is far from under control, spreading to six provinces. About 70–80% of new cases have no known link to prior patients, indicating undetected community transmission. Leading agencies warn containment won’t be achieved in weeks or months; a three-month control target remains possible only with sufficient resources. The outbreak is the worst in the DRC’s history, with at least 2,325 deaths reported. Funding remains a major bottleneck: only about 60% of the US$115 million needed has been secured. Additional challenges include delayed case detection, overwhelmed monitoring teams, armed conflict, and limited vaccines and treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola virus species.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのまれなエボラ流行が「制御不能」に、死者2000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が6州に拡大し、地域感染が疑われる状況で、死者2,000人超・資金不足・武力衝突など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種による稀な流行であり、資金・医療資源不足、武力衝突により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - August 19, 2026
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurges in the United States and China. In the U.S., as of Aug 12, 2026, 50 states report growing or likely growing infections with no declines noted. In China, a July wave driven by Omicron-derived NB.1.8.1 and sublineages saw infections rise by about 560% to 522,000 (from 79,000 in June). Vaccination uptake for the 2025–26 season stands around 18% of adults; upcoming 2026–27 vaccines will target the NB.1.8.1/XFG lineage. Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues its fast spread, with >5,000 cases and >2,300 deaths, roughly 100 new cases daily, and the outbreak described as the deadliest in DRC history. WHO is finalizing a Phase 3 vaccine-trial protocol, likely starting with Merck’s Ervebo in an adaptive, ring-vaccination design. Uganda reports its last confirmed patient discharged on July 16, initiating a 42-day clock toward outbreak end. Urgent calls for speed, scale, and solidarity accompany these efforts.

triage.headline_ja: Balloon Juice - 疫病・パンデミック最新情報 - 2026年8月19日
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が史上最悪規模（>5,000例、>2,300死亡）で急速拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。国際的な支援・治験対応が進行中で、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はブログによる複数疾患のまとめ記事。COVID-19（米国・中国）は季節的再流行であり新規性は低いが、DRCのエボラ流行は史上最悪規模で深刻性・異常性・国際的関心が高く、フルRRA対象とすべき。米国・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kulonprogo Ungkap Risiko Keracunan MBG dari Ayam Barbeque
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kulon Progo Health Office Reveals MBG Poisoning Risk from Barbecued Chicken
article.articleSummary: In Kulonprogo Regency, Indonesia, health authorities traced suspected MBG-related illness among students at SMP 3 Wates to a barbecue chicken dish. Vomitus tested positive for Staphylococcus aureus, Enterobacter, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Streptococcus, and Serratia, while stool contained pathogenic Escherichia coli, with abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea reported. Multivariate analysis found barbecue chicken as the strongest exposure with an adjusted odds ratio of 10.47 (p<0.001) versus other MBG meals. Food testing was limited by small sample size. Cooking began at 03:00 WIB for 45 minutes, with distribution through 09:30 WIB and no label for maximum safe consumption time. Recommendations include shortening the cook-to-portion interval, limiting room-temperature storage to under 2 hours, rapid cooling for unpacked cooked items, periodic health checks for handlers, PPE and handwashing, HACCP implementation, expiry labeling, and maintaining a batch-specific food-sample bank.

triage.headline_ja: クロンプロゴ保健局、バーベキューチキンによるMBG中毒リスクを公表
triage.triage_reason: 単発の学校給食における食中毒事案であり、国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威やヒト-ヒト感染の懸念もない。
triage.notes: 食品由来の細菌性食中毒事案（学校給食プログラムMBGに関連）。地域保健当局が調査・対応済みであり、感染症危機管理の観点でのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le cas suspect d'Ebola à Kinshasa était " très probablement " un cas de choléra (Roger Kamba)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the suspected Ebola case in Kinshasa was "very likely" a case of cholera (Roger Kamba).
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa’s suspected Ebola case, reported August 12 in a 35-year-old arriving by river from Mbandaka in Équateur, was ruled out after Ebola tests were negative; health minister Roger Kamba said it was “very likely a cholera” case. The patient developed diarrhea and vomiting without fever or GI bleeding and died August 16 after about 48 hours. Post-mortem sampling was ongoing, with lab confirmation planned. Twelve contacts were identified; none exhibited diarrhea or vomiting at the time. Hygiene, decontamination, and active surveillance were implemented in health facilities and the community. The INSP and WHO confirmed no epidemiological link to the current Ebola outbreak, and officials report zero Ebola cases in Kinshasa. Authorities called for strengthened river and entry-point controls to prevent introduction, and announced the Congo River Without Ebola initiative to curb spread along the Congo River.)

triage.headline_ja: DRC:キンシャサでのエボラ疑い症例は「非常に高い可能性で」コレラ症例であった（ロジェ・カンバ保健大臣）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例は否定されコレラと判明したが、死亡例が発生しコンゴ川沿いの継続的な感染リスクへの言及があり、社会的・政治的関心（保健大臣発表、WHO関与）も高いためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 当初エボラ疑い症例として報告されたが検査で陰性、コレラの可能性が高いとされた。現行のエボラ流行との疫学的関連はなしとWHO/INSPが確認。コンゴ川沿いの感染拡大防止策（Congo River Without Ebola initiative）が発表されている点は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Hanoi intensifie la prévention de la dengue face à la hausse des cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi steps up dengue fever prevention as cases rise.
article.articleSummary: 316 dengue cases were reported in Hanoi from Aug 7–14, in 74 communes/districts, up 81 from week, with 11 outbreak foci. Since Jan 2026, 63 foci have been identified, 24 active. Dengue no longer follows a seasonal pattern and can occur year-round; the school return and unstable weather may raise transmission. Some patients have severe disease; officials warn of potential hand, foot, and mouth disease as schools reopen. Investigations found foci detected more than seven days after onset, limiting early intervention. A proactive, risk-based model piloted since July in Khuong Dinh ward and O Dien shifts toward risk management, with community teams and larval habitat data via QR codes. On Aug 17, 126 communes were ordered to intensify prevention, review plans, and conduct sanitation, improve communication, detection, staffing, and supplies. Hanoi CDC will maintain surveillance; schools will be cleaned before term; aim to treat at least 95% of affected homes/spaces.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、デング熱症例増加に対応し予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでデング熱症例が増加し当局が対策を強化しているが、既知の風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱の季節性変化や重症例の発生が報告されているが、現地当局（ハノイCDC）が主体的に対策を実施しており、国際支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện giun rồng dài 20 cm từ 2 nốt giống mụn trên tay người đàn ông 49 tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of a 20 cm long guinea worm from two pimply nodules on the hand of a 49-year-old man.
article.articleSummary: Dracunculus medinensis (Guinea worm) infection reported in Lao Cai, Vietnam—the country’s 44th case. A 49-year-old man, N.V.T., from Mau A commune, presented with two nodules on the left forearm. His family extracted two worm strands, about 10–15 cm and 20 cm, before hospital admission. Ultrasound showed subcutaneous thickening in the left forearm (6–8 mm) vs the right (1.3 mm). Diagnosis relied on clinical signs and emergence of the worm; there is no pre-symptom laboratory test and no specific drug or vaccine. Treatment requires careful extraction to avoid breaking the worm, as rupture can release larvae and cause inflammatory or infectious complications (cellulitis, abscess, septic arthritis, tetanus, sepsis). Preventive measures include safe water, avoiding raw or undercooked aquatic foods, keeping wounds clean, and seeking medical care rather than self-removal. Transmission occurs via water containing Cyclops; some cases may involve undercooked aquatic animals.

triage.headline_ja: 49歳男性の手にできた2つのニキビ状のしこりから20cmのギニア虫が発見される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのギニア虫感染症例（国内44例目）であり、稀少で異常な事象だが単発症例であり深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や国際的拡大リスクは確認されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症はヒト-ヒト感染がなく、汚染水を介した感染であるため流行拡大の可能性は低い。ベトナムでは近年動物媒介性の非典型例が散発しており、国内累計44例目という点で異常性は認められるが、単発症例報道であり社会的関心度・政府対応の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: पशुओं में फैल रहा ऐसा रोग, जिसका कोई इलाज नहीं, गाजियाबाद में आई ये कैसी आफत?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A disease spreading among animals with no cure; what kind of calamity has come to Ghaziabad?
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh reports 22 cases of Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cattle during the monsoon. LSD is a contagious viral disease primarily affecting cattle and spreads not via air but through contact with infected animals and blood‑sucking vectors (mosquitoes, flies, ticks); dirty surroundings and standing water heighten risk. Symptoms include high fever, lethargy, reduced appetite, lower milk production, and red patches or nodules on the skin that can rupture and discharge pus. There is no cure; vaccination is key. The veterinary department has vaccinated over 40,000 of roughly 66,000 district cattle, with no cases among the 22 being severe so far. Advice: isolate sick animals, avoid unnecessary movement, maintain cleanliness, provide clean water and nutrition. Leaves like turmeric, giloy, and chakwad may be given but are not substitutes for medical care; consult a veterinarian for severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 動物に治療法のない病気が拡大、ガジアバードで一体何が起きているのか？
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病はウシに限定された既知の動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染性はなく、症例も軽症で地域の獣医当局によりワクチン接種等で管理されている。
triage.notes: 本疾病はウシ等の家畜に感染するランピースキン病であり、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されていない。モンスーン期の媒介動物（蚊・ハエ・ダニ）による拡大がみられるが、地域獣医部門によりワクチン接種（約6万6千頭中4万頭超）が進められ、重症例なし。人的公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en République démocratique du Congo (RDC) : l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé (OMS) maintient l'urgence internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): the World Health Organization (WHO) maintains the international emergency.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with the WHO Emergency Committee recommending continued PHEIC status since May 17. The outbreak has 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths, the largest in the DRC to date and the second deadliest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. Transmission is expanding rapidly; risk is 'very high' in DRC, 'high' in Uganda and neighboring countries, 'low' elsewhere. Security incidents hamper response; an ambulance driver was injured and three vehicles vandalized in Kandoy, Ituri. WHO has strengthened its response: 100 epidemiologists deployed, 500 community health workers, roughly 400 beds added in two weeks. Community engagement with motorcyclists as surveillance/intervention agents; emphasis on safe burials and providing chlorine and gloves. Lita and Nizi cited as progress examples.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ出血熱：世界保健機関（WHO）が国際的緊急事態を継続
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を継続認定し、DRC史上最大規模（確定4,945例、死亡2,325人）のエボラ流行が拡大中であり、ウガンダなど周辺国にもリスクが及んでいるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRomania（Cluj含む）やUgandaが含まれるが、記事主題はDRCでの流行であり、Ugandaは『リスクが高い』とされるのみで確定例の記載はなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。Romaniaは無関係な地域情報としてBluedotの誤検出と判断。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N2

article.articleHeadline: أول إصابة بشرية بـ"إنفلونزا الخنازير" H1N2v في الصين.. طفل يتعافى وتحذيرات من انتقال العدوى - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human case of swine flu H1N2v in China... a child recovers and warnings about transmission of the infection - Voice of the Nation
article.articleSummary: China reports the first laboratory-confirmed human infection with swine-origin influenza A(H1N2)v in a child aged 2 years 10 months. The patient presented with fever and cough, developed bronchopneumonia, and recovered after hospital care. Initial RT-PCR suggested influenza A, but some samples were negative; next-generation sequencing recovered the full viral genome, confirming A(H1N2)v. The rural case occurred in an area where pigs, poultry, and pigeons reside near homes and food preparation spaces. A relative’s pig died during the period, and two other pigs showed respiratory and gastrointestinal symptoms; influenza A was detected in tissue from the dead pig, suggesting a possible source, though a definitive transmission route could not be proven. Thirty close contacts were negative and asymptomatic during follow-up, with no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission. H1N2v denotes a variant swine influenza virus. Emphasizes genomic sequencing and animal–human interface surveillance, plus standard precautions for people working with pigs.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で豚インフルエンザ「H1N2v」ヒト感染初例…幼児が回復、感染拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: 中国における新規変異豚インフルエンザ(H1N2v)のヒトへの初感染例であり、動物-ヒト境界での新規病原体出現という異常性とパンデミック潜在性から、WPRO基準を複数満たし社会的関心も高いと判断した。
triage.notes: H1N2vは新規変異株であり、動物由来インフルエンザのヒト感染例としてパンデミック潜在性の観点から監視強化が必要。現時点で持続的ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、接触者30名は陰性・無症状。

article.articleHeadline: ਸਿਹਤ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੇ ਡੇਂਗੂ ਦੇ ਬਚਾਅ ਸਬੰਧੀ ਚੈਕਿੰਗ ਕੀਤੀ - Health Department conducts check on dengue prevention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department Conducted Checks on Dengue Prevention
article.articleSummary: Punjab health department teams, led by Dr. Nandni Sharma and in-charge Apar-Upaр Singh, conducted dengue prevention checks across urban Punjab, visiting dhabas, restaurants, and confectionery shops, and conducting door-to-door campaigns. Residents were educated on preventing dengue and malaria fever and on treatment options, with a call to follow health department rules. The guidance notes that Aedes mosquitoes go from egg to adult in 7–10 days, so every Friday breeding sites such as coolers, flower pots, and refrigerators should be cleaned and dried to prevent larvae. Any larvae found were destroyed on the spot, and fines were issued. Attending health workers included Harvindar Singh, SI Ram Singh, Sonu Kalyan Nagar Samana, and breeding-checkers Narinder Singh, Jatinder Singh, Pavandeep Singh, Avtar Singh. Location: Samana, Punjab.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がデング熱予防のための点検を実施
triage.triage_reason: 内容はパンジャブ州保健局による定例的なデング熱・マラリア予防活動（幼虫チェック・啓発）であり、異常な発生や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方保健局によるルーティンのデング熱予防・啓発活動を報じるもので、患者数増加や異常発生の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola explained: How it spreads, symptoms and what to do if exposed
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BVD) outbreak is the deadliest in Congo’s history, with over 2,300 deaths since it began on May 26, 2026. The disease spreads by direct contact with body fluids, contaminated surfaces, contact with infected dead bodies, and handling infected wildlife; incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms include sudden fever, abdominal pain, fatigue, sore throat, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and sometimes bleeding. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; early supportive care in isolation improves survival. The situation raises cross-border concerns into East Africa; Kenya lists Ebola testing sites (National Public Health Laboratory; KEMRI-CDC NBI; KEMRI VHF Lab in Nairobi; mobile lab), all requiring BSL-3/4 laboratories. Prevention emphasizes avoiding fluids and contaminated items, hand hygiene, avoiding wild animals, and safe burial; survivors may shed virus in semen. Suspected cases should call 719 or inform authorities; travelers should monitor symptoms after travel to affected areas; currently no outbreak in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱を解説：感染経路、症状、感染した場合の対処法
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（死者2,300人超）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、東アフリカへの越境拡大リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア向けの一般解説記事であり、ケニア国内での発生は現時点でないと明記されている。主題であるエボラ流行はDRCで発生中。KenyaおよびMozambiqueは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo enfrenta la peor epidemia de ébola de su historia - RNV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the worst Ebola epidemic in its history - RNV
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the worst on record, with nearly 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths since its May 17 declaration. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that transmission has spread rapidly and the risk of further expansion remains high both inside the country and internationally. Deaths are occurring at homes and in communities, outside treatment centers and contact lists, signaling an untracked transmission chain. Initial cases appeared in Uganda, where transmission has since been halted, while a traveler carried the virus to France last month. The WHO Emergency Committee has deemed the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, calling for intensified global cooperation and mobilization of resources for the coming months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が史上最悪のエボラ流行に直面 - RNV
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと認定した史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、国際的拡大（ウガンダ・フランスへの伝播）と未追跡の感染鎖が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHOによりPHEIC認定済みで、既にリスク評価対象として国際的に扱われている事案。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo registra mais de 5 mil casos de Ebola, diz governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records more than 5,000 Ebola cases, the government says.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-19, the Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its 17th Ebola outbreak, the largest on record by case count. By the end of July, the outbreak had surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases (5,021) and 2,378 deaths, making it the second deadliest Ebola outbreak worldwide, behind the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. The current wave is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and gained momentum in the following weeks. Health system weaknesses, community resistance, instability, and protests by health workers have impeded case identification, contact tracing, and treatment. Authorities warn that measures implemented so far have not been sufficient to contain the spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例数が5,000件を超えたと政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模となる第17次エボラ流行で、症例数5,000超・死亡者2,378人に達し、ワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株が原因であるため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行（第17次）であり、ワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株が原因。医療体制の脆弱性、地域住民の抵抗、不安定な情勢、医療従事者のストライキ等が対応を阻害しており、当局は現行の対策では抑制不十分と警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội tăng cường công tác phòng, chống dịch bệnh sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi strengthens dengue fever prevention and control efforts
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever – Hanoi, Vietnam strengthens prevention and control via Directive 4247/UBND-KGVX signed 19 August 2026 to prevent outbreak spread. The Hanoi People’s Committee directs the Department of Health to guide wards and communes in preventive measures, ensure proper triage, referral, and hospital readiness, and prevent shortages of medicines, blood, and related products. It mandates standardized diagnostic and treatment protocols and inter-hospital consultation for severe cases. Surveillance is intensified, especially in areas with complex or prolonged outbreaks. Public information campaigns, coordinated by Culture, Sports and Tourism and media, will educate residents on dengue signs, prevention, and vector control; promote mosquito and larva elimination and environmental sanitation, with insecticide spraying as indicated. The Education sector will boost school-based awareness and weekly larval control. Ward/Commune leaders shoulder primary responsibility under the '4 at-site' principle; a Dengue Prevention Month runs Aug 15–Sept 15, 2026, with ongoing monthly control Aug–Nov 2026 and targeted spraying as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ市、デング熱の予防・対策活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで季節性に発生する既知の感染症であり、本記事は行政による予防・対策強化の指示に関するもので、具体的な患者数や死亡者数等の規模を示すデータがなく、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイ市人民委員会による予防指令（Directive 4247/UBND-KGVX）の内容が中心で、感染者数・死亡者数などの具体的疫学データは記載されていない。デング熱予防月間（8/15-9/15）等の季節的対策として位置づけられ、異常事態を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- El jefe de la OMS avisa de que la epidemia de ébola "no...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - The WHO chief warns that the Ebola outbreak "no...."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, with nearly 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths reported by Aug 15 (DRC authorities: 4,945 cases, 2,325 deaths). The epidemic is driven by insecurity, displacement, and large-scale population movements along roads, rivers, and mining routes. Fatalities occurring outside treatment centers and outside known contact lists indicate hidden transmission chains that are not yet traced, risking continued spread. The risk extends beyond the DRC: Uganda halted transmission after the initial spillover, and last month a traveler carried the virus to France, illustrating cross-border importation. Borders may slow responses but do not stop transmission. The response emphasizes DRC government leadership with WHO and Africa CDC to strengthen community-based surveillance, expand healthcare capacity, support safe and dignified burials, engage communities, and accelerate trials for vaccines and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行は「制御下にない」と警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が制御不能と警告する大規模流行（約5000例・2300人超死亡）で、越境感染（ウガンダ、フランス）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの初期スピルオーバーは制御されたが、その後フランスへの渡航関連感染例も報告されており、隠れた感染連鎖のリスクが指摘されている。ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia Ebola din RDC este "departe a fi controlată" şi există un risc "mare" de răspândire internaţională, avertizează OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is far from under control, and there is a high risk of international spread, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains far from controlled and poses a high risk of national and international spread, WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned as the Emergency Committee convened. Since RDC declared the 17th Ebola outbreak in May in the north and east, nearly 5,000 people have been infected and over 2,300 have died across six provinces and 55 health zones. The outbreak is the second-largest on record and is advancing faster than all previous outbreaks, driven by insecurity, population movement, and transport corridors along rivers and roads toward mining areas. Early symptoms—fever and headache—delay diagnosis and fuel transmission; response has faced criticism for slowness and distrust, with ambulances vandalized and a nurse injured in Ituri. The EU has allocated €2.5 million for tests. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus, though clinical trials are underway; WHO will publish recommendations for RDC and at‑risk countries in coming days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は「制御にはほど遠い」、国際的拡大の「高い」リスクがあるとWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が国際的拡大リスクを警告し、既に5000人感染・2300人超死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHO緊急委員会が招集され、DRCおよび周辺リスク国への勧告を近日発表予定。Bundibugyo型ウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬はなく、臨床試験中。治安不安・人口移動が感染拡大を助長。

article.articleHeadline: National Leprosy Eradication Programme workshop begins in Indore to strengthen leprosy control, interruption of transmission
article.articleSummary: Leprosy remains the focus as India’s National Leprosy Eradication Programme (NLEP) conducts a two-day Review-cum-Capacity Building Workshop in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, starting August 19, 2026. Organized by the Central Leprosy Division (CLD), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the event gathers over 70 participants, including DGHS officials, state and district leprosy officers from all 51 MP districts, RLTRI Raipur, Aska Institute, district consultants, and APAL representatives, to strengthen programme implementation and accelerate interruption of transmission (IoT). Key sessions address MP’s epidemiological scenario, LCDC quality and outcomes, and retrospective/reverse contact tracing, with emphasis on early case detection, contact tracing, timely treatment, and disability prevention. Dr. Sunil V Gitte urged data-driven prioritization of districts to push prevalence below 1 per 10,000. The workshop continues August 20, 2026, under intensified surveillance and last-mile actions toward IoT.

triage.headline_ja: インドール市で全国ハンセン病撲滅プログラムのワークショップ開始、ハンセン病対策と感染連鎖の遮断を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既存のハンセン病撲滅プログラムに関する行政ワークショップの開催報告であり、新規の感染拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はNLEP(全国ハンセン病撲滅プログラム)の能力強化ワークショップに関する内容で、感染拡大や新規事例報告ではなく、既存の慢性疾患対策活動の一環。

article.articleHeadline: وباء إيبولا يخرج عن السيطرة في الكونغو.. أكثر من 5 آلاف إصابة و2378 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spiraling out of control in Congo... more than 5,000 cases and 2,378 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to accelerate, with 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health as of Sunday. Ongoing humanitarian and security crises, including displacement and extensive population movement, are driving rapid transmission and hindering response efforts. The current outbreak is advancing faster than any prior Ebola event, surpassing West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (which caused over 11,000 deaths). World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the spread remains rapid and the local and international risk remains high, raising concerns about expansion into new areas within DRC and across borders to neighboring countries. The article notes challenges in reaching affected regions and does not provide details on symptoms or laboratory confirmation or explicit infection sources, underscoring the potential for further cases and deaths as the crisis persists.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴで制御不能に…5,000人以上感染、2,378人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、過去最大規模の流行となっており、周辺国への越境拡大リスクもWHOにより指摘されているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行拡大が主題であり、Angolaは発生地域として付与されているが本文中に言及がないため除外した。WHOは近隣国への越境拡大の懸念を表明しているが、具体的な越境発生は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: surto de Ebola chega a 5 mil casos e avança mais rápido que a resposta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola outbreak reaches 5,000 cases and outpaces the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of Aug 16, per the Ministry of Health. The epidemic advances in extreme conditions—insecurity, displacement, and high population movement—facilitating rapid spread. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is likely to surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 11,000 deaths) and is far from under control. Frontline workers report exhaustion and strikes due to delayed pay, underscoring workforce pressures. A key bottleneck is the lack of vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with most new cases outside the monitored contacts, indicating accelerated transmission and strained surveillance. The outbreak is unfolding in one of the country’s most remote regions, challenging containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ出血熱の流行が5000例に達し、対応より速いスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5,021例・2,378死亡に達し、WHOが2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性を警告。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高く、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン・承認済み治療薬が存在しないこと、治安不安・人口移動により監視・接触者追跡が困難な状況が拡大の要因とされる。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリー上で言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 5 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 5,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, according to the Public Health Institute, making it the country’s seventeenth outbreak and the second-worst globally by infections and fatalities. The outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began with the May 15 declaration and by late July had become the largest in the DRC to date. There are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo. Persistent challenges include weak health infrastructure, community resistance to safety measures, ongoing violence, and protests by some responders, all of which have hampered rapid detection, isolation, and patient care. The report cites cumulative figures as of the current period; no details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染者数が5000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 5000例超・2378人死亡という大規模アウトブレイクであり、致死率が高く医療体制やワクチン・治療薬の欠如、暴力・地域住民の抵抗など拡大リスクが高いため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる第17回目のアウトブレイクで、DRC史上最大規模。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、治安不安・住民の抵抗が対応を阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Advierten que ébola dista de estar bajo control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They warn that Ebola is far from being under control.
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has nearly 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths, the second-worst Ebola outbreak in history. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said it is far from under control at the Emergency Committee meeting convened three months after WHO declared an international health emergency on May 17. Since the May declaration, the epidemic has spread rapidly, and the risk of further expansion remains high, according to the top UN health official. The gathering underscores the ongoing challenge of containment and the need for sustained global vigilance and response as outbreaks persist in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは制御下にはほど遠いと警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行が継続し、感染者約5000人・死者2300人超、WHOはPHEIC下でも制御に至っていないと警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言済みであり、3か月経過後も感染拡大リスクが高いままであるとされている。既にPHEIC宣言が出ているため、フルRRAでの継続的な状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El jefe de la OMS avisa de que la epidemia de ébola "no está ni mucho menos bajo control"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO head warns that the Ebola epidemic "is by no means under control."
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains far from controlled, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. With almost 5,000 infections and more than 2,300 deaths reported, primarily in the DRC, the outbreak is propelled by insecurity, displacement, and large-scale population movement along roads, rivers, and mining corridors. As of August 15, Congolese authorities recorded 4,945 cases and 2,325 deaths, highlighting concern that new deaths occur outside treatment centers and outside known contact lists. Each untraced fatality signals an untracked transmission chain, threatening to prolong transmission across borders. The risk extends beyond Congo; Uganda has halted transmission after an initial spillover, while last month a traveler carried the virus to France. Tedros commended the Congo government and partners in scaling community-based surveillance, expanding healthcare capacity, ensuring safe and dignified burials, community engagement, and accelerating trials for vaccines and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行は「決して制御下にあるとは言えない」と警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約5000人の感染者・2300人超の死者を記録し、国境を越えた感染（ウガンダへの伝播、フランスへの輸入例）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは感染拡大が既に止まったとされ、フランスは輸入例1件のみのため、対象国リストにはDRCのみを含めた。ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's confirmed Ebola cases surpass 5,000
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths since it was declared in mid-May. The epidemic spans 55 health zones across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo, with Ituri the epicenter and sustained transmission ongoing there. Authorities urge reinforced, consistent public communication to counter misinformation and sustain adherence to control measures. To limit spread toward Kinshasa, surveillance along the Congo River about 65 kilometers (40 miles) from the capital has been intensified, including a health post monitoring boats from affected areas. The World Health Organization classifies the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain and has surpassed the 2018–2020 eastern Congo outbreak in severity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定患者数が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と分類した大規模エボラ流行で、確定例5,000人超・死者2,378人と過去の東部コンゴ流行を上回る規模に達しており、首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクも指摘されているため。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）として分類されている点が特に重要。致死率は約47%と高く、キンシャサへの拡大防止のためコンゴ川沿いの監視強化が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Hog raisers say border inspections still key despite ASF regionalization precautions
article.articleSummary: ASF regionalization rules allow imports from ASF-free parts of a source country, but the Philippines must maintain border inspections to curb smuggled or ASF-infected meat. The National Federation of Hog Raisers notes this ongoing risk, saying border checks are essential for the meat processing sector, where PAMPI sources pork from reputed suppliers but could be bypassed without inspection facilities. Without first border inspection facilities, smuggled or frozen pork could slip in while carrying ASF. The DA had lifted a temporary import ban on industrially manufactured, hermetically sealed, heat-treated canned pork products after deeming biosecurity risks negligible, aligning with the World Organisation for Animal Health Terrestrial Animal Health Code. The code prescribes virus inactivation in meat via heat treatment of at least 30 minutes at 70C.

triage.headline_ja: 養豚業者、ASFの地域区分（リージョナリゼーション）対策にもかかわらず、国境検査が依然として重要と指摘
triage.triage_reason: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は動物疾病であり人の公衆衛生への直接的影響はないが、密輸・輸入豚肉を通じた侵入リスクが継続しているため、政策動向を注視する必要がある。新規の発生拡大や急性事案ではなく、既存の貿易・検疫政策に関する記事である。
triage.notes: 本記事はフィリピンにおけるASF地域区分（ゾーニング）政策と国境検査体制に関する業界団体の見解を報じたものであり、新たな感染拡大や急性のアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。人への健康影響はなく、主に養豚産業・貿易政策に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: ICMR plans three-year TB-free pilot project in Delhi slums - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: ICMR proposes a three-year Delhi slum TB-free demonstration project targeting 1.5–1.75 lakh residents at each of three sites, to be implemented with NTEP, Central TB Division, MoHFW, Delhi Government and local authorities. The integrated, community-based approach emphasizes early detection, rapid diagnosis, treatment support and prevention, including household surveys and screening of vulnerable groups, with NGOs and community-based organisations as field partners. Aims to reduce TB burden amid urban slum challenges such as overcrowding, migration, undernutrition and limited healthcare access, and to prevent treatment interruptions by counselling and adherence support. In 2025 Delhi reported 1.12 lakh TB notifications; TB prevalence according to the 2019-2021 India TB Prevalence Survey is 747 per 100,000. The project will generate evidence on scalability under routine health programmes, and ICMR invites eligible NGOs to express interest as implementation partners.

triage.headline_ja: ICMR、デリーのスラム地域で3年間の結核撲滅パイロット事業を計画
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドの既知のTB対策プログラム（パイロット事業）の計画発表であり、異常な発生や急性のアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は新規のアウトブレイクではなく、ICMRによる既存対策強化のためのパイロット事業計画に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: 8 நாட்களில் 22,158 தெருநாய்களுக்கு ரேபிஸ் தடுப்பூசி - சென்னை மாநகராட்சி தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies vaccination for 22,158 stray dogs in 8 days - Chennai Municipal Corporation information.
article.articleSummary: On 11 August 2026, the Greater Chennai Corporation launched a mass anti-rabies vaccination drive and endectoparasiticidal treatment for stray dogs, conducted across three zones—Thiruvottiyur, Manali, and Tondiarpet. Ten squads operated concurrently, and in eight days the program vaccinated 22,158 stray dogs against rabies. The effort aims to protect the public from rabies and create a rabies-free Chennai by vaccinating all street dogs and administering parasite treatment. The drive began on 11 August 2026 and spanned eight days. Officials stated the drive seeks to curb rabies transmission to humans and addresses stray dog populations through vaccination and endectoparasiticidal treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 8日間で22,158匹の野良犬に狂犬病ワクチン接種 - チェンナイ市当局発表
triage.triage_reason: 野良犬への予防的ワクチン接種事業に関する行政発表であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防的な野良犬ワクチン接種プログラムの実施報告であり、狂犬病の症例増加や集団発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bengaluru School H1N1 Row: Civic Body Issues Notice Over Unverified Outbreak Claims
article.articleSummary: Clarence High School on Pottery Road, Bengaluru, received a notice from the North Corporation over unverified H1N1 outbreak claims. Officials said only two teachers tested positive for H1N1 and one had recovered; no confirmed H1N1 infections among students. The school declared a holiday, with classes set to resume on Wednesday. City health teams visited the school, sanitisation was carried out, and no medical records indicated student infections. Health authorities warned fever and cough in some children could reflect common infections. The commissioner’s public notice stated that spurious media disclosures without adequate medical evidence could violate the Epidemic Diseases Act. Authorities reported no similar incidents at other Bengaluru schools. The school had alerted media on August 15; investigation is ongoing, but no student cases are confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルールの学校でH1N1騒動：市当局が未確認の集団感染主張について通知を発行
triage.triage_reason: 教師2名の陽性のみで生徒への感染は確認されておらず、季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)としての通常事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は『未確認のアウトブレイク主張』に対する市当局の対応が主題であり、確認された感染は教員2名のみ。季節性H1N1インフルエンザとして通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak reaches 5,000 cases as it outpaces response efforts
article.articleSummary: Congo’s Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths, with Ituri province and Bunia the hardest-hit areas. The outbreak, likely beginning in the Mongbwalu mining town as early as February and officially declared May 15, is spreading at an unprecedented pace, about three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, and risk of national or international spread remains high. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus, complicating response efforts. Overall case fatality rate stands at 47.4%, but in North Kivu it reaches about 70%, reflecting severe challenges in some areas. Health workers face violence and shortages amid insecurity, displacement, and poor infrastructure, with cases increasingly reported outside monitored contact lists. WHO and local authorities warn the outbreak is not under control and demand closer community engagement to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、対応が追いつかない中で5,000例に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率47.4%（一部地域70%）、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、国際的拡大リスクが高いと明記されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリー上では言及されておらず除外。過去最速の拡大ペース、ワクチン・治療薬の不在、治安悪化による対応困難が強調されており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Myanmar: il colera riapre le ferite di un Paese in guerra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Myanmar: Cholera Reopens the Wounds of a Country at War.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Yangon, Myanmar, as of Aug 19, 2026: since Aug 9, about 500 people hospitalised with cholera-like symptoms; rapid tests positive in 149 cases, with 9 confirmed by the National Laboratory; more than 100 admissions occurred in a single day on Thursday before a reported slowdown. One death, a 92-year-old man, attributed to preexisting cardiac and pulmonary diseases rather than cholera. Health authorities have started epidemiological surveillance and containment in affected areas. The disease recurs in Myanmar, with a 2024 wave causing over 3,400 hospitalisations by end-August during the monsoon season. Myanmar remains war-torn, with millions displaced. In Rakhine State near the Bangladesh border, the Rohingya crisis persists: about 308,797 Rohingya are refugees in Bangladesh among over 828,000 listed; repatriation hinges on security improvements. July saw more than 500 missing after two boats sank off Myanmar; no updates on those individuals. IOM and UNHCR are reporting on the migrant tragedy.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマー：コレラが戦争で疲弊した国の傷口を再び開く
triage.triage_reason: ヤンゴンで短期間に500人がコレラ様症状で入院し公衆衛生への影響が認められる上、戦乱・避難民という脆弱な社会状況下で流行しやすさ・管理可能性の懸念が高く、国際機関の関心も示されている。
triage.notes: ラカイン州・バングラデシュ国境のロヒンギャ難民危機は文脈として言及されているが、コレラ流行の主体はヤンゴンでのアウトブレイクであり、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。2024年にも同様の流行があり再発性の疾患である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: por que a participação das comunidades é decisiva para conter a epidemia : Linkezine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: why community participation is decisive in containing the epidemic: Linkezine
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo requires community involvement alongside hospitals and PPE. MSF doctor Rachel Soeiro, at the Brazilian Society of Tropical Medicine conference on August 18, 2026, says information, trust, and active community participation are essential to interrupt transmission. The Guinea Ebola epidemic of 2014–2016 is cited as field experience. Ongoing conflict, displacement, and limited health access in the DRC hinder timely case identification and isolation. Emergencies do not suspend other health needs: pregnant women require care, children need vaccination, and TB/HIV patients must continue treatment; maintaining services sustains public trust and care-seeking. Early detection is vital, as initial Ebola symptoms can resemble malaria. Preparedness before outbreaks—training, PPE, diagnostics, vaccines, treatments—and sustained research funding are emphasized. Containing an epidemic starts before the hospital: information, trust, and community participation save lives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：地域社会の参加が流行制圧に決定的な理由：Linkezine
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における進行中のエボラ流行に関する内容で、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、専門家会議でも取り上げられ社会的関心が示されている。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル熱帯医学会議でのMSF医師の発言を報じる解説記事だが、対象はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行。ブラジルは会議開催地にすぎず発生国ではない。ギニアは2014-2016年流行の過去事例として引用されており、現在の発生国ではないため対象国リストにも含まれない。マラリア・結核・HIVは併存する医療ニーズとして言及されているのみで本イベントの主題ではない。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: सिर्फ बुखार ही नहीं, H1N1 वायरस दिमाग पर भी कर सकता है असर! डॉक्टर से जानें लक्षण और बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's not just fever; the H1N1 influenza virus can also affect the brain! Learn the symptoms and prevention from a doctor.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1), commonly known as swine flu, is primarily a respiratory illness but can, in some cases, affect the brain and nervous system. Beyond fever and dehydration, patients may develop severe headache, persistent vomiting, confusion, excessive drowsiness or loss of consciousness, speech difficulties, weakness, and seizures. Experts warn that influenza-related brain inflammation can manifest as encephalitis or encephalopathy, with children more prone to seizures during flu illness. In very rare instances, H1N1 may trigger Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS), an autoimmune attack on the peripheral nerves that can progress to paralysis and, in severe cases, threaten breathing. Seek urgent medical care if headache worsens with fever, abrupt behavioral changes, new weakness or balance problems, or seizures. Neurological complications can occur during illness or recovery, so continue monitoring symptoms after the fever subsides. Dr. Ritu Jha, head of Neurology in Faridabad Sector-8, emphasizes vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 熱だけじゃない、H1N1インフルエンザウイルスは脳にも影響を及ぼす可能性がある！医師が症状と予防法を解説
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団感染や公衆衛生危機の報告ではなく、H1N1の一般的な神経学的合併症について医師が啓発する健康情報記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）の神経系合併症に関する一般的な医療解説記事であり、特定の発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。Faridabad(Haryana州)の医師のコメントが含まれるが、地域的な流行状況の言及はないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: China bans Finnish pork imports over swine fever
article.articleSummary: China bans imports of pigs, wild boar and related products from Finland over African swine fever (ASF) concerns as Finland reports its first confirmed ASF cases. Thousands of people in south-eastern Finland are under strict restrictions after the Finnish Food Authority detected ASF in wild boar in Virolahti, Kymenlaakso, on 30 July, prompting area-wide controls. ASF is highly contagious and often fatal in pigs and wild boar; there is no vaccine or treatment, and the virus does not infect humans. The ban on Finnish pork products underscores the international trade impact of the outbreak and highlights ongoing containment efforts following wildlife detection.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、アフリカ豚熱を理由にフィンランド産豚肉の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は動物（豚・イノシシ）のみの感染症でヒトへの感染はなく、発生国フィンランドは対象国リストに含まれないため公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本イベントはフィンランドにおける野生イノシシのアフリカ豚熱発生に対する中国の輸入禁止措置であり、ヒトへの感染性はない。発生国フィンランドは対象国リストに含まれず、中国は輸入禁止措置の実施国であるため発生地域として不適切。対象国での発生は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Children account for one-third of reported Ebola deaths in DR Congo: UNICEF
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains ongoing, with UNICEF reporting 5,021 confirmed cases across 55 health zones in six provinces and a case fatality rate of 47.4% (WHO African Regional Office). Children aged 17 and under account for about 21% of confirmed cases but 33% of reported deaths, indicating a disproportionate mortality burden in the pediatric population. UNICEF cites strained treatment services driven by delayed referrals, overcrowding, limited critical care and pediatric capacity, resource constraints, and data reporting gaps. The agency urges accelerated community surveillance and contact tracing, plus stronger early detection, timely referrals, and pediatric-focused care as transmission continues. Overall, the outbreak persists, with transmission ongoing and persistent challenges in delivering timely care and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱死亡者の3分の1は子ども：ユニセフ報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中（5,021例、致死率47.4%）であり、小児の死亡割合が高いなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染継続のリスクが確認されるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: UNICEFおよびWHOアフリカ地域事務局のデータに基づく報告。55の保健区・6州にわたる継続的流行で、国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: epidemia de ébola sigue sin control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola epidemic remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom warns that the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control as of August 19, 2026. Geneva briefing cites nearly 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths, predominantly in the DRC. The outbreak is driven by insecurity, displacement, and widespread population movement along roads, rivers, and mining corridors. Alarmingly, deaths are occurring outside treatment centers and beyond known contact lists, signaling transmission chains that have not yet been traced. The epidemic will persist until all transmission chains are detected and interrupted. WHO is strengthening surveillance, expanding healthcare capacity, supporting safe burials, and promoting clinical trials for vaccines and treatments. The situation highlights persistent public health challenges in the DRC amid conflict and displacement, with ongoing international concern for outbreak control and containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ出血熱の流行は依然として制御不能
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が制御不能とWHOが警告し、感染者約5,000人・死者2,300人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、追跡不能な感染連鎖の存在から国際的拡大リスクも高い。IHR基準の複数該当が確認される。
triage.notes: Genève（スイス）はWHO本部の記者会見地であり、発生地域ではないため除外。実際の流行地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận ca mắc giun rồng thứ 44 tại Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam records its 44th case of Guinea worm disease.
article.articleSummary: Guinea worm disease (dracunculiasis) in Vietnam: A 1977-born man from Mậu A commune, Lào Cai Province, presented at Dang Van Ngữ Hospital on 19 Aug 2026 with two lesions on the left forearm. He works peeling cinnamon bark, enters forests, and reportedly drinks spring water. About 20 days earlier two lesions appeared; last week his family extracted two white worm segments (roughly 10–15 cm and 20 cm) from the arm and burned them. Ultrasound showed focal subcutaneous thickening in the left forearm (6–8 mm) versus 1.3 mm on the right. There is no diagnostic test to detect infection before symptoms, and there is no specific drug; treatment is removal of adult worms. Vietnam has 44 cases since 2020, with Lao Cai 26, Phú Thọ 14, Thanh Hóa 3, predominantly male. Prevention: avoid raw foods, boil water, maintain hygiene, report suspected cases, and do not pull the worm.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでギニア虫症（メジナ虫症）の44例目確認
triage.triage_reason: ギニア虫症はWHOの根絶対象疾患であり症例の継続的発生は異常だが、本症例は単発報告で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは確認されず、社会的関心の明確な高まりも記事からは読み取れないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ギニア虫症はWHOの世界根絶プログラム対象疾患であり、ベトナムでは2020年以降44例（ラオカイ26例、フート14例、タインホア3例）が報告されている。感染経路は生水飲用や森林での樹皮採取と関連し、ヒト-ヒト感染はないため流行拡大の可能性は低いが、継続的な感染源（水中のミジンコを介した感染サイクル）の存在が疑われるため、根絶事業の観点から継続的な監視が必要。
