article.articleHeadline: إنفلونزا الخنازير H1N2v تصل إلى البشر تفاصيل أول حالة في الصين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu H1N2v reaches humans: details of the first case in China.
article.articleSummary: Swine-origin influenza A(H1N2v) has reached humans in China, marking its first reported case. As of 2026-08-19, the patient is a previously healthy child aged 2 years 10 months. Details are published in the European Medical Journal. Health authorities are monitoring the situation closely, noting influenza viruses can evolve and acquire properties enabling human infection. The report describes a single human case in China; no additional infections are described, and there is no stated ongoing outbreak. Symptoms were not detailed in the excerpt. The article highlights the need for continued surveillance, laboratory confirmation where available, and investigation into possible exposure or infection source. No information on imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: H1N2v型豚インフルエンザがヒトに感染：中国での最初の症例の詳細
triage.triage_reason: 新型（豚由来）インフルエンザA(H1N2v)のヒト初感染例であり、IHR(2005)附属書2上「新亜型インフルエンザのヒト感染」は常に通報対象となる異常事象に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が適切。
triage.notes: 単一症例で重症度・感染源・二次感染の有無など詳細情報が不足しているため、続報の確認とラボ確定情報の収集が必要。新型インフルエンザ亜型のヒト感染例はIHR上自動的に通報対象となりうる点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Myanmar, il colera riapre le ferite di un Paese in guerra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Myanmar, cholera reopens the wounds of a country at war.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Yangon, Myanmar, as of August 19, 2026: at least 500 hospitalizations since August 9 with symptoms consistent with cholera; rapid tests positive in 149 cases, with 9 confirmed by the National Laboratory. More than 100 patients were admitted in a single day before case numbers slowed; a 92-year-old man died, with death attributed to preexisting cardiac and pulmonary conditions. Health authorities have intensified epidemiological surveillance and containment in affected areas. The episode echoes past outbreaks, including 2024 waves in Yangon with over 3,400 hospitalizations and confirmed cholera during the monsoon season; earlier outbreaks have occurred in Yangon and Mandalay. Broader context shows Myanmar still at war for over five years with millions displaced; Rohingya in Rakhine State face ongoing displacement, with 308,797 Rohingya verified in Bangladesh camps (out of 828,000 named), awaiting repatriation only after security improves. President Min Aung Hlaing’s Aug 17 visit to Moscow reflects ongoing diplomatic efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマー、コレラが戦争下の国の傷跡を再び開く
triage.triage_reason: ヤンゴンで500人以上の入院と検査陽性149例（確定9例）が報告され、内戦下で医療・衛生体制が脆弱な地域での拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへの移行が望ましい。
triage.notes: 2024年のヤンゴンでの大規模流行（3,400人超入院）の再燃とされ、内戦による人口移動・医療インフラ崩壊が感染拡大の背景にある。ラカイン州のロヒンギャ避難民やモスクワ訪問は文脈情報であり、コレラ発生地はヤンゴン・マンダレーに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: le gouvernement prend en charge les frais des soins de santé en Ituri pour inciter au dépistage d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The government covers health care costs in Ituri to encourage Ebola screening.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, leads the government to cover all health-care costs in Ituri to remove financial barriers to screening. Health Minister Dr. Roger-Samuel Kamba announced in Kinshasa that all health-care in Ituri will be free, regardless of facility, to encourage people with even minor symptoms to seek diagnostic evaluation. Measures extend beyond Ebola treatment centers: all health centers will receive essential sanitary kits, and all health workers in Ituri will be paid to ensure prompt, cautious care. The government has deployed more than 20 laboratories in two months to speed testing, acknowledging the virus’s rapid spread. Three months after the outbreak declaration in the DRC, the country reports over 5,000 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and around 2,300 deaths, roughly a 47% case fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：政府がイツリ州での医療費を負担し、エボラの検査受診を促進
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で発生宣言から3ヵ月、確定患者5000人超・死者約2300人（致死率約47%）に達する大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は既に3ヵ月継続し確定患者5000人超・致死率約47%と極めて深刻。政府は検査促進のため医療費無償化、20超のラボ展開等の対応を実施中。渡航・貿易制限に関する明示的記載はないが、規模から国際的関心・支援の必要性は高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 5.000 casos de ébola confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 5,000 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of August 17, 2026, the outbreak declared in the eastern DRC on May 15 has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths. The case fatality rate stands at 47.4%. Of the patients, 782 are in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,091 have recovered. Contact tracing is at 84.1%. This outbreak ranks as the second-worst Ebola episode on record globally and the most severe to date in the DRC. The figures come from the Congolese Ministry of Public Health's latest bulletin, reflecting the ongoing outbreak in the eastern region and indicating continuing transmission as of mid-August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確認例5,000件の壁を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5,000例超・致死率47.4%と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトを持ち、史上2番目に大規模な流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行であり、致死率47.4%と非常に高い。継続的な感染拡大が確認されており、国際的な支援・監視が必要と考えられる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N2

article.articleHeadline: إنفلونزا الخنازير H1N2v تصل إلى البشر.. تفاصيل أول حالة في الصين - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Influenza H1N2v Reaches Humans: Details of the First Case in China - The Week
article.articleSummary: China reports the first human infection with swine-origin influenza A(H1N2)v in a 2-year-10-month-old child in a rural area near pig and poultry farming. The patient developed fever, recurrent cough, and pneumonia; initial RT-PCR indicated influenza A, with Haemophilus influenzae co-infection on sputum culture. CT showed increased lung markings and opacities; treated with antibiotics and inhaled budesonide; fever resolved and he was discharged. Genomic analysis via next-generation sequencing revealed a recombinant A(H1N2)v genome with gene segments from H1N1, H1N2, and H3N2. Investigations point to a likely animal source, with a pig pen near the home and a dead pig testing positive for influenza A; no definitive transmission route identified among 30 close contacts. No ongoing outbreak or pandemic; underscores importance of genomic surveillance and precautions for those exposed to pigs, including hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: H1N2v型豚インフルエンザ、ヒトへ感染 中国での第一例の詳細
triage.triage_reason: 新規の組換え型（H1N1・H1N2・H3N2由来）豚インフルエンザA(H1N2)vによる中国初のヒト感染例であり、IHR附属書2では新型インフルエンザ亜型のヒト感染は常時通報対象とされるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 本例は単発例で回復・退院済み、濃厚接触者30名にヒトーヒト感染の明確な証拠はないが、新規の組換え型豚インフルエンザウイルスのヒト感染例であるため、IHR附属書2の『新型インフルエンザ亜型によるヒト感染』は常時通報対象に該当し得る点に留意。ゲノムサーベイランスの継続と続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: USP desenvolve vacina inovadora que bloqueia replicação do chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: University of São Paulo develops an innovative vaccine that blocks chikungunya virus replication.
article.articleSummary: Scientists at the University of São Paulo (USP) and the University of Bonn, Germany, report a chikungunya vaccine strategy using a genetically modified virus that can complete only a single replication cycle. After this initial replication, particles remain immature and cannot infect new cells, enabling immune exposure without disease. Described in npj Vaccines (May 2026), the approach protected mice with a single dose and elicited a neutralizing response against Mayaro virus, suggesting potential applicability to other pathogens. The team modified chikungunya so maturation is blocked: E3 remains on the surface, preventing exposure of E2 required for cell entry; this was achieved by using a human cell line that does not produce the furin enzyme. The goal is a robust immune response with a safety profile suitable for immunocompromised and elderly individuals. Funded by FAPESP (projects 17/19137-7, 18/11939-0, 23/09619-5).

triage.headline_ja: USP、チクングニアウイルスの複製を阻止する革新的なワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: 研究開発（ワクチン開発）に関する学術報道であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上のイベントではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ大学とドイツ・ボン大学の研究者によるチクングニア熱ワクチン開発に関する科学ニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生地域情報ではない。ワクチン開発研究であるため、感染症サーベイランス上の発生地域（Brazil, Germany）は該当対象国のうちBrazilのみだが、実際の感染発生ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS alerte sur une épidémie hors de contrôle en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO warns of an out-of-control outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On August 18, 2026, during an Ebola Emergency Committee meeting, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is far from being under control. The briefing underscored ongoing transmission and an eruption not yet contained, signaling a severe and evolving public health threat in the DRC. The committee convened to assess the situation and consider further steps, reflecting heightened concern from WHO about the persistence and spread of Ebola in the country. As of August 19, 2026, the agency's top official characterized the outbreak as far from controlled, emphasizing the need for intensified response, enhanced surveillance, and international support to affected regions within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:WHOがDRCでの制御不能な流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が緊急委員会でエボラ流行が制御不能と警告しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的・国際的関心が高い重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: WHOエボラ緊急委員会が開催され、DRCでの流行が制御不能と評価された。具体的な症例数・死亡数・地域の詳細は記事に記載なし。フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue | Tenkasi உயிரை பறித்த டெங்கு... உயர்ந்த பலி எண்ணிக்கை - அச்சத்தில் மக்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue | Dengue that claimed lives in Tenkasi... rising death toll - people are scared
article.articleSummary: Three dengue-related deaths have been reported in the Kadayanallur area of Tenkasi district, Tamil Nadu, including a Nursing College student who died from dengue fever. The death toll had previously been two and has now risen to three, indicating an escalating outbreak in the region. Residents are living in fear as dengue cases appear to spread, and people are demanding immediate government action to curb transmission. The report calls for urgent public health measures, including enhanced vector control, risk communication, and healthcare readiness to prevent further fatalities. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases, but underscores the need for rapid intervention to protect the community in Tenkasi’s Kadayanallur area.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱 | テンカシで命を奪ったデング熱…死者数増加 - 住民は恐怖に
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナードゥ州テンカシ県で死者数が増加するデング熱の地域流行が報告されており、住民の不安（社会的関心）とWPRO基準（重症度・持続的暴露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当するため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドでは季節性・地域性の流行が一般的であり、国際的な異常性は低いが、死者数の増加と住民の懸念から地域レベルでの継続的な監視が必要。検査確定や感染源、政府対応の詳細情報は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Myanmar: Cholera outbreak in Yangon
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Yangon, Myanmar's largest city (population >5 million), faces a cholera outbreak. Since 9 August, 500 people have been hospitalized for severe diarrhea; 149 tested positive for cholera by rapid tests, with nine cases formally confirmed as Vibrio cholerae by the National Health Laboratory. Cholera is an acute diarrheal infection caused by Vibrio cholerae; symptoms range from mild/moderate illness to severe acute watery diarrhea with dehydration that can be fatal within hours if untreated. Most patients respond to prompt oral rehydration solution (ORS). Prevention and control measures emphasize strengthened surveillance, water, sanitation and hygiene improvements, risk communication, access to quality treatment, and oral cholera vaccine campaigns, amid ongoing outbreak in Yangon and a strained healthcare system due to conflict.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマー:ヤンゴンでコレラ発生
triage.triage_reason: 500人が入院、149人が検査陽性、9人が確定診断とされ、大都市ヤンゴンで拡大している上、紛争により医療体制が脆弱化しており公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染・拡大のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 紛争による医療インフラの脆弱化が状況を悪化させている可能性があり、続報でのケース数・拡大範囲・国際支援状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola, lejos de ser controlado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, far from being under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a public health emergency of international concern, as per the WHO Emergency Committee after three months of response. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus confirmed the decision, stressing the outbreak is far from under control. Nearly 5,000 cases and over 2,300 deaths make it the worst Ebola epidemic in the DRC’s history and the second-largest globally; if current trends persist, it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Intense population movement in eastern DRC, compounded by armed conflict and insecurity, are driving transmission. A critical concern is deaths occurring at home and in communities, outside treatment centers and contact lists, signaling undetected transmission chains. The UN agency calls for renewed cooperation and resources to protect communities in the coming months and prevent further domestic and international spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、制御にはまだ遠い状況
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと認定した大規模エボラ流行で、死者数が過去最悪水準に達し、国際的拡大リスクと武力衝突による対応困難さが確認されているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事内でAngolaへの拡大は明示されていないため、対象国リストに含まれないAngolaはverified_locationsから除外。WHOはPHEICを継続認定しており、コミュニティ内での未検知感染連鎖が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma segunda morte por febre maculosa em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms second death from Rocky Mountain spotted fever in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Campinas confirms its second death from Rocky Mountain spotted fever in 2026. A 29-year-old man who visited a fishing site in another municipality on June 17 developed symptoms June 21 and died June 26. Health Surveillance says the probable infection occurred outside Campinas, but authorities are reinforcing guidance at fishing sites near the border with the neighboring city. RMSF is tick-borne and can progress rapidly; symptoms include fever, headache, severe body aches, malaise, nausea and vomiting. Treatment should begin promptly upon suspicion. The first fatal case of 2026 occurred April 21, a 74-year-old man with probable infection in the city’s northwest region while gardening near vegetation and watercourses. With two Campinas deaths in 2026, the municipality also saw six RMSF cases in 2025, all fatal. Public health urges precautions in wooded areas, vegetation, river margins, fishing sites, and to inform clinicians of visit locations.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスで2026年2件目のロッキー山紅斑熱による死亡例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ダニ媒介性で人-人感染がなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、致死率の高さと同地域での継続的な発生（2025年は6例全例死亡）が見られるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本疾患はダニ媒介性で地域的・季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、2025年にも同市で6例（全例死亡）報告されている。致死率の高さから継続的なモニタリングが望ましいが、国際的リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Universitas Pakuan Libatkan 100 Warga Bogor Perkuat Deteksi Dini TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pakuan University Engages 100 Bogor Residents to Strengthen Early TB Detection
article.articleSummary: Universitas Pakuan in Bogor conducted a two-day community service program, 'Keluarga Tangguh Lawan TBC', in Pasirjaya, Bogor Barat, to strengthen early tuberculosis (TB) detection and prevention at the community level. Held August 18–19, 2026 and funded by the Kemendiktisaintek 2026 grant, the activity engaged about 100 Pasirjaya residents. The program integrates TB education, transmission prevention, recognition of symptoms and risk factors, and integrated contact tracing with free health checks (CKG). It promotes family and community empowerment, and education on using medicinal plants and jamu to support health, while clarifying that TB treatment must follow health services. Partners include Universitas Pakuan, Bogor City Health Office, UPTD Puskesmas Pancasan, Pasirjaya Kelurahan, PKK cadres, and local groups, with local officials in attendance.

triage.headline_ja: パクアン大学、ボゴール住民100人を対象に結核早期発見強化プログラムを実施
triage.triage_reason: 地域コミュニティによる結核早期発見・啓発活動に関する記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核のアウトブレイクではなく、大学と地域が連携した早期発見・啓発の地域保健活動を報じるもの。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: encore un centre hospitalier incendié après la confirmation d'un cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: yet another hospital center set on fire after confirmation of an Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Unknown attackers burned Bora Maisha hospital in Mukalangirwa, Butembo, North Kivu, DRC, during the night of August 18 after a confirmed Ebola case was reported at the facility. One of three active buildings and its laboratory equipment were destroyed; patients fled. The confirmed case had already died, and numerous contacts (caregivers, co-patients, and visitors) are reportedly showing Ebola symptoms or are in flight, raising transmission concerns. Health workers urged community vigilance and respect for health facilities, and called for strengthened security in Butembo, especially in the Katwa health zone, which currently has 255 confirmed Ebola cases of the Bundibugyo strain and 160 deaths. The article also notes two earlier July incidents in which two local facilities—Crinovic in Kavikene, Vulamba, and Zawadi/Mapendo in Kyaghala, Bulengera—were set ablaze amid rumors of collusion with outbreak response teams.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ:エボラ感染確定後、またもや病院施設が放火される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ブテンボのカトワ保健区でエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）が255例確定・160人死亡という深刻な流行が継続中であり、医療施設への放火・患者逃走・接触者の逃亡により感染拡大とアウトブレイク対応の阻害が懸念されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 医療施設への放火事件が複数発生し、対応チームへの不信感がアウトブレイク管理を妨げている点は、感染拡大リスクだけでなく治安・社会的緊張の観点からも重要な情報。接触者の逃亡・症状出現の報告は感染拡大の即時リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Construction d'un centre de traitement Ebola à Kisangani pouvant accueillir 50 patients - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Construction of an Ebola treatment center in Kisangani capable of accommodating 50 patients - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, Kisangani, capital of Tshopo Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is constructing a standardized Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) with an initial capacity designed for 10 suspected and 12 confirmed cases, with plans to extend to 50 beds. The city currently operates a 4-bed facility (2 confirmed, 2 suspected); tent extensions will add eight beds, bringing capacity to 12 (4 confirmed, 8 suspected). MSF logistics coordinator Garcia Pol Heredero said work began about two weeks ago after technical site assessment and community engagement; the site is on the former governor’s residence concession, overseen by OCBA Log Construction. This effort supports the Bundibugyo-sstrain Ebola outbreak in Tshopo, which has recorded 15 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, by strengthening local treatment capacity for affected people.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニでエボラ治療センター建設、最大50人の患者収容可能 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中で、確定15例・死亡7例が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: MSF（国境なき医師団）が治療センター建設に関与しており、既に確定例・死亡例が発生している進行中のアウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価（RRA）が推奨される。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites D e E no Brasil: estudo revela alta circulação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis D and E in Brazil: Study Reveals High Circulation.
article.articleSummary: An analysis led by Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein examined data from more than 14.5 million Brazilians and, published in PLOS One as part of the 'Characterization of Viral Hepatitis in Vulnerable Populations' project, highlights substantial circulation of hepatitis D and E in Brazil. Reviewing 2013–2024 studies, the work finds Hepatitis D prevalence up to 23.9% in the Amazon and Hepatitis E up to 59% in the South, with both infections likely underdiagnosed. Hepatitis D depends on Hepatitis B; vaccination against B is a preventive measure. Genotype 3 of HBV/D in the Amazon is linked to more severe disease, and infections cluster among poorer, isolated groups such as riverine and Indigenous populations. Hepatitis E is zoonotic via pigs and contaminated water/food. Delta testing is limited; there is no rapid diagnostic test, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance to move toward elimination in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるD型・E型肝炎:研究により高い循環が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2013–2024年のデータを後方視的に分析した研究発表であり、急性の感染拡大や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はHospital Israelita Albert Einsteinによる既存データ（2013-2024年）の分析結果を発表する学術研究報告であり、急性のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。アマゾン地域や南部地域での慢性的な肝炎D・E型の高い罹患率とサーベイランス強化の必要性を指摘しているが、即時対応を要する公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: MP में पहली बार मिला Hepatitis C का दुर्लभ Genotype-4, हमीदिया हॉस्पिटल में भर्ती मरीज की जांच में खुलासा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare Hepatitis C genotype-4 detected for the first time in Madhya Pradesh, revealed during the investigation of a patient admitted to Hamidia Hospital.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-19, Madhya Pradesh records the first known Hepatitis C genotype-4 case, detected during investigation of a patient admitted to Hamidia Hospital, Bhopal. The patient had a complex co-infection with tuberculosis; testing revealed a Hepatitis C virus variant distinct from the region’s usual strains, identified as genotype-4. Experts warn that genotype-4, if not treated promptly, elevates the risk of cirrhosis, liver failure, and liver cancer. When TB or other diseases are present, the liver damage can accelerate, a two-hit pattern. After six days of intensive monitoring at Hamidia Hospital and the Regional Institute of Respiratory Diseases, liver enzymes remained normal. In India, genotype-4 is rare (about 0.24%–1.5% of North Indian hepatitis C cases); this Madhya Pradesh case is its first registered instance, with genotype-4 more common in Africa and the Middle East.

triage.headline_ja: MPで初めてC型肝炎の稀な遺伝子型4型を検出、ハミディア病院入院患者の検査で判明
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者における稀な遺伝子型の初検出という症例報告であり、アウトブレイクやヒト-ヒト感染拡大の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一患者の症例報告であり、C型肝炎は血液・体液を介する感染であるため急速な地域拡大やヒト-ヒト感染拡大の公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。患者の肝機能は正常範囲内で安定していると報告されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Is Back. Who Needs To Worry?
article.articleSummary: H1N1 influenza is resurging, with risk amplified by patients' underlying conditions. In India, the National Centre for Disease Control and clinicians warn that healthy people typically recover within a week, but those with heart disease, diabetes, asthma or COPD, cancer treatment, or immunosuppression face serious complications, including heart strain, hyperglycemia, pneumonia, and respiratory failure. High-risk groups include pregnant women, young children, older adults, and transplant recipients. Symptoms to watch for include breathlessness, chest pain, blue lips, persistent fever, confusion, severe weakness, vomiting, or falling oxygen levels; children needing urgent care if fast breathing, poor feeding, or lethargy. Early medical contact is advised for high-risk patients; do not wait for tests. Oseltamivir is the main antiviral and is most effective within 48 hours, vaccines are recommended annually, especially for high-risk groups. Prevention also includes vaccination, avoiding sick contacts, keeping conditions controlled, and following doctor advice.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1が再来。誰が心配すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: インドでH1N1インフルエンザの注意喚起記事だが、具体的な患者数や地域的な感染拡大データがなく、季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な医療アドバイス記事に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの国立疾病管理センター（NCDC）による医療アドバイスが中心で、具体的な発生規模や急増を示すデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: La riposte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola fragilisée par les violence en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak response weakened by violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hampering Ebola outbreak response, with the United Nations warning that security risks are undermining life-saving interventions. In affected areas, insecurity, attacks on response teams, and community resistance disrupt field operations and complicate patient care, while critical resources remain insufficient to meet needs. The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has now caused more than 2,300 deaths nationwide. The security challenges add to a range of on-the-ground obstacles facing health workers as they work to isolate cases, trace contacts, and provide treatment and supportive care. The report underscores the need for protection of response personnel and adequate supplies to sustain outbreak control efforts amid ongoing violence.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行対応、暴力により脆弱化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が既に2,300人以上の死者を出しており、暴力によって対応活動が妨げられているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 国連が安全上のリスクが対応活動を損なっていると警告しており、既に2,300人超の死者が出ている大規模流行。暴力・治安悪化により対応チームへの攻撃や地域住民の抵抗が報告されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 22 leptospirosis cases in San Lazaro Hospital, more expected amid Habagat rains
article.articleSummary: 22 leptospirosis cases at San Lazaro Hospital, Manila, with 3 severe, rising amid Habagat floodwaters. A 34-year-old man developed jaundice after floodwater entered his rubber boots; fever and urinary issues followed. Severe cases may require dialysis as liver and kidney toxins accumulate; breathing can be affected. From January to Aug 19, the hospital has admitted 84 cases. A female sidewalk vendor from Carriedo, Sta. Cruz, contracted infection via floodwater splashed onto a dog-bite wound; she has fever and urinary issues. Dr. Iftizar Haron expects more cases due to ongoing exposure, comparing to last year’s 200+ admissions and projecting up to 100 this year. Typical symptoms: fever, body pains, difficulty urinating. DOH data: 3,440 nationwide as of Aug 8, 35% below last year; July 12–25 saw 348 cases (27% higher than June–July 11). Doxycycline stock: 3.1 million capsules; use after medical consultation; not for pregnant/breastfeeding or doxy allergy. Outpatient department treated ~800.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ラザロ病院でレプトスピラ症22例、ハバガット豪雨の中さらなる増加が予想される

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat's mosquito-borne disease campaign reduces malaria by 45% and dengue by 39%
article.articleSummary: Gujarat, India, reports a major reduction in mosquito-borne diseases through a door-to-door prevention drive. Up to Week 33 of 2026, malaria cases fell 45% to 774, dengue by 39.1% to 788, and chikungunya by 48.1% to 80, with no malaria or dengue deaths recorded in this period. Testing exceeded 1.11 crore blood samples in 2026, vs 1.09 crore in 2025; dengue and chikungunya diagnostics at 42 centers yielded over 83,000 and 12,000 serum tests (nearly 96,000 total). The campaign emphasizes surveillance, timely diagnosis and treatment, and vector control. Phase I (Apr 27–May 6) achieved 89% fever-surveillance coverage; Phase II (Jul 1–10) used 19,558 teams to survey 6.51 crore people, collecting over 257,000 blood samples and identifying 28 malaria cases. Insecticide spraying began Aug 1; first round reached 116 malaria-sensitive villages; 29.63 lakh breeding sites eliminated; fogging in 321,000+ houses; 497 vector-control teams and 5,024 sites with larvivorous fish.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州の蚊媒介性疾患対策キャンペーンによりマラリアが45%、デング熱が39%減少
triage.triage_reason: 記事は感染症の減少・対策成功を報じる内容であり、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola sigue preocupando: la RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 5.000 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to be a concern: the DRC surpasses the 5,000 confirmed cases mark.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths since the outbreak began in May, with a case fatality rate of 47.4%. About 782 patients are in isolation or hospitalized and 1,091 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 84.1%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé. Ninety days after the first case, the outbreak remains uncontrolled, driven by insecurity and displacement. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the outbreak is not under control and notes the risk of cross-border spread; Uganda has halted transmission, and a traveler carried the virus to France. This is the second-worst Ebola outbreak in history and the most severe in the DRC, surpassing 5,000 cases less than two weeks after crossing 4,000. Response includes community surveillance, expanded healthcare capacity, safe burials, community engagement, and vaccine/therapy trials.

article.articleHeadline: मानव - भटक्या श्वानांचा संघर्ष रोखा ! भटक्या श्वानांचे निर्बीजीकरण रेबीज लसीकरण युद्धपातळीवर राबवा; जिल्हाधिकारी डॉ. श्रीकृष्ण पांचाळ यांचे आदेश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stop the conflict between humans and stray dogs! Sterilization of stray dogs; rabies vaccination on a war footing—District Collector Dr. Shrikrishna Panchal's orders.
article.articleSummary: Thane district in Maharashtra launches war-footing strategies to sterilize stray dogs and vaccinate against rabies, following Supreme Court directives and the 2023 Animal Birth Control Rules. District Collector Dr. Shrikrishna Panchal, also head of the District Animal Birth Control Committee, directs all municipalities and local bodies to implement comprehensive sterilization and mass rabies vaccination programs, with separate action plans for rural and urban areas. A high-level review highlighted rising human-dog conflicts and outlined deployment of manpower, facilities, and veterinary coordination to scale up operations. Emphasis is on sustained, planned sterilization and large-scale vaccination beyond temporary measures. For monsoon and natural disasters, temporary shelters with clean water and basic facilities should be established per Indian Animal Welfare Board guidelines, alongside emergency veterinary services and rapid inter-agency coordination. The approach requires coordinated, multi-agency action across local governments, veterinary services, and other authorities.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak becomes deadliest as cases surpass 5,000
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak declared a global health emergency by WHO on 18 August 2026 as infections exceed 5,000 and deaths pass 2,320, making it the deadliest Ebola epidemic in the DRC’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (2,299 deaths). The Bundibugyo Ebola virus drives this wave, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. WHO Director-General Tedros described transmission at unprecedented speed, with new chains yet to be traced. Containment faces armed conflict, misinformation, community distrust, and unsafe burial practices. Response measures include hand-washing stations, disinfectants, and deploying motorbike riders as surveillance and response officers on the ground. An experimental vaccine targeting Bundibugyo is in trials, with the first human volunteer in the UK in July 2026 and hundreds of thousands of doses produced in India, awaiting trial outcomes. The objective remains rapid case finding and breaking every transmission chain.

article.articleHeadline: Congo Cries 'Global Emergency' as Unchecked Ebola Cases Hit 5,000+
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases, with 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths recorded as of Sunday. It is the 17th DRC outbreak and the deadliest, exceeding the 2018–2020 event which killed 2,299. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that international spread cannot be ruled out and that the risk of further national and international spread remains high; the epidemic remains far from under control. Ebola is highly contagious and causes severe, often fatal illness; transmission occurs via bodily fluids such as vomit, blood or semen and via contaminated surfaces. The response is hampered by insecurity, displacement, and rapid population movements. On vaccines, the first volunteer for this strain was vaccinated in the United Kingdom last month; doses developed by Oxford University have been produced in India and are ready for immediate use if trials succeed, with volunteers urged to participate.

article.articleHeadline: Children hit hardest in DR Congo Ebola outbreak, UNICEF warns
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 5,021 confirmed cases across 55 health zones in six provinces, with a case fatality rate of 47.4%. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and is spreading faster than prior incidents; WHO warns it could become the deadliest globally if not urgently contained. Ituri province remains the epicentre, accounting for about 84.8% of cumulative cases, though transmission is accelerating in neighboring provinces. UNICEF reports children (17 and under) comprise about 21% of confirmed cases but 33% of deaths, signaling elevated pediatric mortality and strained treatment services due to delayed referrals, overcrowding, limited critical care and pediatric capacity, resource constraints, and data gaps. The outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); authorities urge enhanced surveillance, stronger early detection and timely referral, and pediatric-focused care.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Surpass 5,000 - Taarifa Rwanda:
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,000 cases, with 5,021 infections and 2,378 deaths reported to government and WHO data. article.articleHeadline: Cidade mineira confirma caso de febre maculosa e emite orientações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City in Minas Gerais Confirms a Case of Brazilian Spotted Fever and Issues Guidance.
article.articleSummary: Ponte Nova, in the Zona da Mata region of Minas Gerais, Brazil, confirmed a case of Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa) on Aug 18. The patient was hospitalized, started on treatment, and is improving. Brazilian spotted fever is a tick-borne zoonosis caused by Rickettsia bacteria. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, muscle aches, with possible swelling and redness on the palms and soles. Health authorities advise prevention: use icaridin-based repellents, wear light-colored, long-sleeved clothing, long pants, closed shoes; white socks aid tick visibility. For yard work, use PPE; avoid sitting or lying on grass during outdoor activities. Regular body checks and prompt tick removal with tweezers reduce infection risk. Periodic acaricide treatment for dogs, horses, and cattle is recommended by a veterinarian. Seek medical care at first symptoms and report exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông 49 tuổi mắc giun rồng: Cảnh báo và lời khuyên từ Bác sĩ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 49-year-old man contracts guinea worm: warning and advice from a doctor.
article.articleSummary: Guinea worm disease (Dracunculus medinensis) case in Vietnam: the 44th infection nationwide. On 19 August 2026, a 49-year-old farmer from Mậu A, Lào Cai Province, presented at Dang Văn Ngữ Hospital with two deep, non-itchy lesions on the left forearm. He works in forestry and cinnamon bark peeling, with exposure to streams. About 20 days earlier two white worm segments were extracted by family—one about 10–15 cm and the other about 20 cm—and burned. Ultrasound showed localized subcutaneous thickening along roughly one-third of the left forearm (6–8 mm), with milder changes on the right. Experts note there is no pre-emergence test and no specific drug; the current approach is complete worm removal. Do not break the worm. After extraction, maintain hygiene, boil water, avoid raw foods, and seek prompt medical care for suspected cases.

article.articleHeadline: Pourquoi l'épidémie d'Ebola est-elle la pire qu'a connue la RDC ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is the Ebola outbreak the worst the DRC has ever known?
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the deadliest yet, with 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths reported as of 18 August; case fatality rate around 45.9% (figures evolving). The Ituri province remains the epicenter, but transmission has rapidly spread to six of 26 provinces. The outbreak, declared on 15 May, prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, first identified in Uganda in 2007, a rare strain for which no licensed vaccine or specific therapy exists. Vaccines exist for Zaïre ebolavirus; Africa CDC has urged immediate deployment of Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) broadly, even though efficacy against Bundibugyo is unproven. The AU's Africa CDC notes Ervebo as the only currently available vaccine. By comparison, the 2018–2020 Zaïre outbreak caused 2,299 deaths in DRC.

The virus crossed into Uganda, which reported 20 cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths; Uganda was declared Ebola-free on July 28. Caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which has a 30–50% fatality range and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea and hemorrhagic manifestations. The WHO maintains the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確認例5000件の壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5,000例超・致死率47.4%に達し、ウガンダへも越境、WHOがPHEICと認定していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済みであり、記事の主題は継続中のDRCでの流行拡大。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOによりPHEICと認定されている点は特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Bhiwandi Civic Body Intensifies Monsoon Disease Prevention Drive Across City
article.articleSummary: Monsoon-focused public health drive in Bhiwandi-Nizampur City Municipal Corporation (BNCMC) aims to curb vector-borne and water-borne diseases, notably dengue and malaria. As of Aug 19, 2026, the campaign deploys door-to-door surveillance by ANMs and ASHA workers across 20 Urban Health Centres, 29 HWCs, 10 HBT clinics, and one BGP Hospital, with intensified fogging and insecticide spraying. Guppy fish breeding centres were established to reduce larval mosquito populations. Public awareness through pamphlets, posters, and collaboration with community leaders is ongoing. Water samples from supplied drinking water are sent to the Government Laboratory in Thane for quality testing. Preventive steps target discarded tyres, construction sites applying temephos larvicides in water-filled ducts, and mandatory surveillance reports from private and government facilities. Stocks of medicines are maintained for continuity of care during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディ市自治体、モンスーン期の感染症予防対策を市全域で強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・マラリアはインドで季節性・地域流行的に発生する疾患であり、本記事はモンスーン期における定例の予防対策（防疫活動）を報じるものであって、異常な発生や症例急増を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な症例数や死亡者数、異常な流行の兆候を示しておらず、地方自治体による毎年恒例のモンスーン期対策活動の報告である。デング熱・マラリアはインドの当該地域で毎年流行する既知の疾病であり、IHR基準・社会的関心の観点からも新規シグナルとしての特異性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-BENI-EBOLA-OVER 5000 CASES
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains a global health concern, centered in Beni, North Kivu Province, with cases surpassing 5,000 as of August 19, 2026. The World Health Organization designates the situation as a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), as the epidemic spreads into new areas and prompts expanded response efforts. Authorities are pursuing experimental vaccines and treatments to curb transmission and improve outcomes. A patient was being checked at an Ebola treatment center in Beni on August 16, 2026, illustrating ongoing clinical management. The report underscores international relevance and the need for continued surveillance, public health measures, and access to investigational interventions as the outbreak evolves across eastern DRC. Key locations: Beni, North Kivu Province, DRC; date references: Aug 16, 2026 (treatment center visit) and Aug 19, 2026 (case count/PHEIC status).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国・ベニ:エボラ出血熱、5000例超え
triage.triage_reason: 5000例超え・PHEIC宣言と報じられており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はPHEIC宣言に言及しているが、これが2026年時点で実際に発表されたものか、過去の状況の記述かは本文がないため確認が必要。続報での正式なWHO声明の確認を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: DOH repeats guidance vs lepto as rains spawn floods | Claudeth Mocon-Ciriaco
article.articleSummary: Philippines: DOH reports 3,440 leptospirosis cases as of Aug 8, 2026, 35% lower than 5,318 cases in the same period in 2025, amid floods from the southwest monsoon and serial typhoons. Between July 12–25, cases rose to 348 (up 27% from June 28–July 11's 275). Public advised to avoid wading in floodwaters; if unavoidable, wear boots and wash with soap and water immediately. People with flood or mud exposure, even without symptoms, should consult a health center or doctor within 24–48 hours for risk assessment and possible treatment or prophylaxis. Those with fever, headache, chills, back or leg pain, or red eyes should go to DOH Leptospirosis Fast Lanes or nearest facility. Emphasizes continued guidance due to ongoing floods in the Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: DOHは豪雨による洪水を受け、レプトスピラ症への注意喚起を改めて発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症は例年見られる公衆衛生上の課題で、今回の症例数は前年より35%減少しており異常性は低いが、洪水が続く限り曝露リスクは継続するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年同期比で減少しており、季節性の洪水に伴う既知のパターン。DOHによる定期的な注意喚起であり、重症度や国際的拡大の情報は記事中に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo says Ebola cases exceed 5,000 with 2,378 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases with 2,378 deaths, according to government data as of August 19, 2026. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus and centered in six eastern provinces—notably Ituri (Bunia) and North Kivu—has spread roughly three times faster than the deadliest prior outbreak. The World Health Organization maintains the situation as a global health emergency with a high risk of spread to neighboring countries. Ongoing conflict, mass displacement, and weakened health services hamper response, with frontline staff unpaid and strikes or walkouts common. Community mistrust fuels attacks on health teams; a mob burned an ambulance in Aru. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus. Most new cases lie outside monitored contacts, and authorities trace the outbreak back to Mongbwalu as early as February, with declaration on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ患者数が5000人を超え死者2378人と発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)がDRC東部で急速に拡大し、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態と認定、周辺国への拡大リスクも高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが既にグローバルヘルスエマージェンシーと認定している大規模アウトブレイク。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、治安悪化、医療従事者への攻撃など対応能力に深刻な課題があり、優先度の高いシグナルとして即時フルRRAへ移行すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Tirunelveli steps up dengue prevention measures ahead of monsoon
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention measures were announced for Tirunelveli and Tenkasi as sporadic cases emerge ahead of the northeast monsoon amid Super El-Nino. On 19 August 2026, Collector Anand Mohan chaired a review to avert an outbreak: mass cleaning to remove garbage, desilting drains, and ensuring chlorinated drinking water with ongoing laboratory monitoring. Local bodies will deploy anti-dengue workers, provide medical care, and monitor patients after discharge. Stagnant rainwater and sewage must be drained; discarded plastics, tyres, and bottles removed to prevent mosquito breeding; public awareness campaigns and sanctions on violators. Fever cases in schools and anganwadis should be referred to the nearest government hospital or primary health centre; Taluk Medical Officer alerted. In Tenkasi, dengue-related deaths were reported: Rehan Mary (class VIII) and D. Nirmala (21) from the Boganallur Sri Lankan Tamils rehabilitation camp, admitted to Tirunelveli Medical College Hospital; Rehan Mary died a month earlier, Nirmala died on Tuesday night.

triage.headline_ja: ティルネルヴェリ、モンスーンを前にデング熱予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン前の季節性デング熱対策に関する記事で、地域内で散発的症例と2件の死亡が報告されているが、地元行政による通常の予防対応の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: インド・タミルナードゥ州ティルネルヴェリ／テンカシ地区における季節性デング熱で、地元当局が予防措置（清掃、蚊の発生源除去、意識啓発）を実施中。2名の死亡例が報告されているが、地域内対応で管理可能な状況であり、国際的な拡大や支援要請の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 5,000 cases, 2,320 deaths reported in DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) exceeds 5,000 cases and 2,320 deaths across six provinces, according to Africa CDC. Three months into the Ebola response, the epidemic's scale is straining Congo's health system, with a high case fatality rate underscoring severity. Africa CDC calls for urgent, unified continental action to contain transmission, strengthen surveillance, improve patient care, and protect at‑risk communities. The agency is coordinating with Congolese authorities and partners to escalate the response and bring the outbreak under control. The report emphasizes the need for shared mobilisation: Africa must respond together to curb spread and safeguard affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：DRCで5,000件の症例、2,320人の死亡が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 6州にわたる大規模エボラ流行で死者2,320人、致死率が高く公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、国際的な支援要請も出ているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが大陸レベルでの統一対応を要請しており、コンゴの医療システムに大きな負荷がかかっている。致死率(46%超)が高く、感染拡大の継続リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo llega a 5.000 casos y supera la respuesta de salud a velocidad inédita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo reaches 5,000 cases and outpaces the health response at an unprecedented pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths, according to data from the Ministry of Health, with figures current as of Sunday. Responders warn that transmission is accelerating at an unprecedented pace, outpacing the health response in one of the country’s most remote regions. The surge is driven by insecurity, displacement, and extensive population movement, complicating containment efforts and challenging response teams operating in harsh conditions. The account highlights the ongoing, rapid spread amid conflict-affected areas, where access to communities is difficult and movement is fluid, stoking transmission across affected zones. The data reflect a rapidly expanding outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、5000例に達し前例のない速さで医療対応を上回る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5000例超・死者2378人に達し、治安不安と人口移動により制御不能なスピードで拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 致死率は約47%と高く、治安不安・人口移動により対応が追いついていない状況。国際的な支援強化が必要とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Myanmar: El cólera reabre las heridas de un país en guerra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Myanmar: Cholera Reopens the Wounds of a Country at War.
article.articleSummary: Cholera resurges in Yangon, Myanmar, with at least 500 hospitalizations since August 9; rapid tests positive in 149 cases, nine confirmed by the National Laboratory. A 92-year-old man died, attributed to preexisting heart and lung conditions. Health workers have intensified epidemiological surveillance and containment in affected areas. The episode echoes Yangon’s 2024 cholera surge, when the WHO logged more than 3,400 hospitalizations by late August amid monsoon rains. Cholera in Myanmar traces back to post-Cyclone Nargis; the first case was May 9, 2008, though the 2008 event did not trigger a major outbreak. Separately, the country’s war and displacement persist. In Rakhine State, the Rohingya crisis deepens: 308,797 Rohingya verified as former residents of Rakhine in Bangladeshi camps, among more than 828,000 names; repatriation hinges on improved security.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマー:コレラが戦争中の国の傷を再び開く
triage.triage_reason: ヤンゴンで8月9日以降500件超の入院と死亡例が発生し、2024年の大規模流行(3400件超入院)を想起させる規模であり、戦乱・避難民状況下でのさらなる拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事はミャンマー・ヤンゴンでのコレラ流行が主題。ラカイン州のロヒンギャ危機・バングラデシュへの言及は別事象(避難民問題)であり、コレラの発生地域としては確認できないため対象国から除外した。戦乱による医療アクセス低下・雨季の衛生状態悪化が流行拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: Ebola salgını kontrol altına alınmaktan çok uzak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak is far from being under control.
article.articleSummary: Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in eastern Ituri province and driven by the Bundibugyo variant, remains far from under control. Since it began three months ago, about 5,000 people have been infected across six provinces and 55 health zones, with more than 2,300 deaths. The WHO has declared this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The response is expanding, but international spread risk remains high due to displacement and population mobility along roads, rivers, and mining routes. Uganda has halted transmission after the first case; a traveler carried the virus to France, illustrating cross-border risks. Two vaccines have entered human trials for Bundibugyo; one animal study shows cross-protection, and the PARTNERS trial has enrolled around 100 patients. Urgent needs include faster data sharing, stronger surveillance, sustainable funding, access, security, and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行は制御からほど遠い状態にある
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行で、感染者約5000人・死者2300人超と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、既にウガンダやフランスへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでは初発例後に感染拡大が停止、フランスへは渡航者経由での持ち込み事例が発生。両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生地はDRC東部イトゥリ州。

article.articleHeadline: CIDSCON 2026: गांधीनगर में संक्रामक रोगों की रोकथाम के लिए एक मंच पर जुटेंगे विशेषज्ञ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CIDSCON 2026: Experts to come together on a platform in Gandhinagar for the prevention of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: CIDSCON 2026, the 16th Annual Conference of the Clinical Infectious Diseases Society, will run August 20–23, 2026, at Gandhinagar's Mahatma Mandir Convention Centre, Gujarat. More than 950 delegates from India and abroad—clinicians, researchers, microbiologists and health professionals—will gather to discuss diagnosis, prevention and treatment of infectious diseases, with emphasis on India-specific challenges. Major topics include antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and stewardship, tropical infections, tuberculosis, HIV, fungal infections, virology, infection control, next-generation sequencing, phage therapy, and AI-based clinical practice. A series of AI-focused workshops will explore current AI landscape, applications beyond large language models, and AI's potential role in medical decision-making. A dedicated Gujarat session on August 22 will highlight AMR containment via GUJSAR-N and AMR dashboards. The conference closes with a valedictory on August 23, followed by lunch.

triage.headline_ja: CIDSCON 2026: ガンディーナガルで感染症の予防に向け専門家が一堂に会する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術会議の開催案内であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核・HIV等感染症に関する学術会議（CIDSCON 2026）の開催告知であり、具体的な感染症発生事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Equipes de saúde combatem dengue em Aeroporto e Consórcio 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health teams combat dengue in Aeroporto and Consórcio 1
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention was reinforced in Bom Jesus, focusing on the Aeroporto and Consórcio 1 neighborhoods, where health teams conducted a resident awareness campaign. Community Health Agents (ACS) and Endemic Disease Control Agents (ACE) distributed informational materials detailing dengue prevention and measures to prevent the proliferation of Aedes aegypti. The initiative, led by Bom Jesus City Hall and the Municipal Health Secretariat, seeks to broaden public access to prevention information and strengthen resident participation in vector control. Emphasized actions include eliminating water-holding containers and monitoring potential breeding sites to mitigate transmission risk. Case counts or fatalities are not provided in the report. The activities reflect ongoing public health efforts as of 19 August 2026 to reduce local dengue risk through community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: 保健チームがアエロポルトおよびコンソルシオ1地区でデング熱対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱予防・啓発活動を報じた内容であり、症例数や死亡者数の報告もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による日常的なベクター対策・住民啓発活動の報道であり、症例数・死亡者数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Five African countries end polio outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, five African countries have stopped poliovirus type 2 transmission: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, Republic of Congo, and Uganda. OBRA assessments in Jan–Jun 2026 found transmission interrupted, with outbreak closures confirmed by WHO Africa. In the Republic of the Congo, last detection was December 2023, with rapid interruption through strengthened surveillance and vaccination campaigns. Burundi declared a circulating type 2 outbreak in March 2023 and interrupted transmission through intensified routine immunization, targeted campaigns, and environmental surveillance with GPEI support. Uganda detected poliovirus in May 2024 and then intensified surveillance and outbreak response. Ghana upgraded laboratory capacity this year, complementing high-quality surveillance and rapid response. Guinea-Bissau focused on underserved populations with targeted campaigns and enhanced surveillance, reporting no detections since July 2021. Madagascar’s reappearance highlights ongoing reimportation risk and the need for continued vigilance and high immunization.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ5カ国でポリオ流行が終息
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ流行の終息（ブルンジ、ガーナ、ギニアビサウ、コンゴ共和国、ウガンダ）を報告する内容であり、新たな公衆衛生上の懸念や拡大リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は流行終息に関する良好なニュースであり、対象国のうちガーナが含まれるが既に流行終息が確認されている。記事中の『Republic of Congo』はコンゴ共和国（Congo-Brazzaville）であり、対象国リストのDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）とは異なる国のため除外した。マダガスカルでの再出現は再流入リスクを示すが対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : une structure sanitaire vandalisée et une ambulance incendiée à Aru (Médecin chef de zone de santé de Biringi) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a health facility vandalized and an ambulance set on fire in Aru (Chief Medical Officer of the Biringi Health Zone) - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 19 August 2026 in Kandoy, Aru territory, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, a health facility in the Biringi Health Zone was vandalized; an ambulance set on fire and two others pelted with stones, injuring several people, predominantly Ugandan nationals. Patients inside had to leave; those treated were relocated to the city. Dr. Cléopâtre Tumba, head of the Biringi health zone, decried the vandalism and noted three ambulances affected, one completely out of use. He cautioned that some youths were instrumentalized amid Ebola virus disease-related misinformation—mentioning two contact cases in a family—raising concerns about safety and hampering Ebola response. Authorities call for vigilance and better collaboration between communities and health teams to prevent violence from compromising patient care and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アル（イトゥリ州）で医療施設が破壊され救急車が放火される（ビリンギ保健地区医療責任者）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ対応において、誤情報に基づく暴力行為が医療施設・救急車を襲撃し対応活動を妨害しており、感染拡大リスクを高める重大な事象であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ国籍者が被害者として言及されているが、発生地はDRCイトゥリ州アル地域であり、ウガンダでの発生を示す記述はないため verified_locations には含めない。誤情報による地域社会の反発がエボラ対応を妨げている点が最大のリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : des femmes commerçantes sensibilisées aux mesures barrières par une mutuelle - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Market Women Sensitized to Barrier Measures by a Mutual Association - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease awareness campaign in Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, targets market women to reinforce barrier measures. On 19 August 2026, the mutual health association Ma Priorité conducted sensitization in local markets, underscoring that Ebola is real, transmission remains active, and prevention helps break transmission chains. Nana Sumbuso, coordinator, says social status or education should not block women's participation in the outbreak response. The campaign flags risky behaviors in trading spaces, notably physical contact between sellers and buyers, and calls for sustained preventive practices in commerce venues. She urges tailored trainings to equip market women with essential information on transmission and prevention, and asks women’s associations to strengthen advocacy with NGOs and the provincial government for support. Vendors should use their spaces as outreach venues, highlighting community-wide responsibility in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱：共済組合が市場の女性商人にバリア対策を啓発
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の感染継続と市場での啓発活動が報告されており、IHR基準複数（深刻性・異常性）およびWPRO基準（重症度・持続的曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行下での市場女性への啓発活動を報じており、新規発生ではないが、感染継続（transmission remains active）と地域コミュニティへの継続的リスクが明記されているため注視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Children Account For One-Third Of Reported Ebola Deaths In DR Congo: UNICEF
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) hits 5,021 confirmed cases across six provinces and 55 health zones, with a 47.4% case fatality rate. UNICEF reports children aged 17 and under make about 21% of confirmed cases but 33% of deaths, signaling a rising pediatric mortality burden. Treatment services are strained by delayed referrals, overcrowding, limited critical and pediatric care, resource constraints, and data gaps. Community surveillance and contact tracing must be accelerated to improve early detection and timely referrals. WHO confirms the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting this is the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever and spreading faster than previous ones; infection is centered in Ituri, which accounts for 84.8% of cumulative cases, with rising transmission in neighboring provinces. The seven-day moving average exceeded 90 new cases daily in early stages; the Africa CDC warns of roughly one death every 30 minutes, underscoring urgency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数の3分の1を子どもが占める：ユニセフ報告
triage.triage_reason: PHEICと宣言された大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率47.4%、症例数5,021人、複数州への拡大、国際的関心・支援の必要性が明確でIHR基準の複数該当が確認される。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC宣言済み、史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行で拡大速度も過去より速いとされる。Ituri州が累積症例の84.8%を占め、近隣州への感染拡大も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Megközelíti az ötven százalékot az ebola halálozási aránya Afrikában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola mortality rate in Africa is approaching fifty percent.
article.articleSummary: By 2026-08-19, Ebola mortality in Africa approaches 50%. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the outbreak remains far from contained, with efforts to involve motorbike-taxi drivers who transport patients in surveillance. Africa CDC warns nearly two‑thirds of deaths occur outside hospitals and isolation centers, usually from villages and small communities, underscoring the need to isolate symptomatic patients. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba notes initial symptoms are mild (headache and fever), causing people to continue daily activities and unknowingly spread the disease. Since May, 5,021 infections and 2,378 deaths (47.4% case fatality); more than a thousand recovered. Jean Kaseya, head of the DRC CDC, cautions the real numbers are likely higher; official outbreak began mid‑May, with possible cases dating to February; Feb–May data unavailable. Tom Fletcher says the outbreak kills someone every 30 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラの死亡率が50%に近づいている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが致死率47.4%、5000人超の感染者、地域社会への拡大が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長やAfrica CDC、DRC保健大臣らが公にコメントしており、地域コミュニティでの未報告死亡例が多いことから実際の被害規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。発生地域の『Africa』は大陸区分のため除外し、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 深圳男子因摳腳習慣引發丹毒 醫生解析皮膚感染風險 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shenzhen man develops erysipelas due to habit of picking his feet; doctors explain skin infection risks.
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, a 49-year-old obese man (1.80 m, 200 lb) developed erysipelas, an acute skin and subcutaneous lymphatic infection of the right leg, caused by Group A beta-hemolytic Streptococcus. Bacteria entered through micro-wounds from athlete’s foot cracks and nasal picking, illustrating how skin bacteria invade via minor injuries. Symptoms include fever, chills, and a sharply demarcated bright red plaque with burning pain; without prompt treatment, risks include sepsis or permanent leg edema. Obesity and diabetes are high-risk due to skin folds, poor circulation, and reduced immunity; diabetes can complicate with ketoacidosis in severe cases. Prevention emphasizes three don’ts: don’t break the skin and treat foot fungus promptly, and don’t pick the nose; diabetics should check feet daily, wash hands, keep skin dry, and change socks/shoes. Seek medical care immediately if redness, swelling, heat, or fever with pain develop.

triage.headline_ja: 深圳の男性、足の指をかく習慣が原因で丹毒発症 医師が皮膚感染リスクを解説
triage.triage_reason: 個人の一例に関する健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生ではないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 個人の症例報告に基づく健康情報記事であり、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: China Reports 1st Human Infection with Swine-Origin H1N2v | Sada Elbalad
article.articleSummary: China reports its first laboratory-confirmed human infection with swine-origin influenza A(H1N2)v in Yunnan Province. The patient is a previously healthy boy, 2 years 10 months old, who fell ill in January 2026 in a rural area with fever and coughing, progressing to bronchopneumonia and hospitalization at Kunming Children's Hospital. Initial tests showed influenza A; sputum culture found Haemophilus influenzae. Chest CT showed increased, blurred pulmonary markings. He received oseltamivir, antibiotics and supportive care and recovered. triage.headline_ja: 中国、豚由来H1N2v型インフルエンザのヒト感染第1例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 新型（豚由来）インフルエンザA(H1N2v)のヒトへの初感染例であり、IHR(2005)上、新型インフルエンザ亜型のヒト感染は原則通報対象となるため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 本症例は雲南省で発生し、患者は回復済み。新型豚由来インフルエンザ亜型のヒト感染はIHR(2005)附属書2の「常時通報対象疾病」に該当するため、追加情報（他症例の有無、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、動物側の状況）の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Congo cases surpass 5,000 as record-setting pace of spread continues
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Congo’s Ituri province, centered in Bunia, has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of Sunday, three months after the May 15 declaration, marking Congo’s 17th Ebola epidemic. The Bundibugyo species is involved and has no approved vaccines or treatments. The pace of transmission is described as the fastest on record, about three times the speed of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the risk of national and international spread remains high and that the epidemic is far from under control. Response efforts are hampered by safety concerns, as health workers are targeted; in Aru territory a mob attacked a health team after a suspected case, setting fire to an ambulance and damaging two vehicles. Insecurity, displacement and population movements fuel the crisis, with Ituri hardest hit.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染者数が5,000人を超え、記録的な速さで拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も全項目該当。WHO事務局長も国際的拡大リスクを警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリー中で言及がないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo species流行であり、致死率約47%と高く、医療従事者への攻撃など対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ 5,000ത്തിലധികം എബോള കേസുകൾ; ഇതുവരെ ജീവൻ നഷ്ടമായത് 2378 പേർക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 5,000 Ebola cases in Congo; 2,378 people have died so far.
article.articleSummary: August 19, 2026 update from the Congo’s Ministry of Health confirms 5,021 Ebola virus disease cases and 2,378 deaths, marking the largest outbreak on record. The current cluster is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no available vaccine or treatment, complicating containment. The World Health Organization states this is the largest Ebola outbreak to date, with the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 11,000 deaths) used as a benchmark that this outbreak may surpass. The absence of a vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo underscores the need for enhanced public health measures, rapid case finding, isolation, and infection-control strategies to curb transmission in the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染5,000例超、これまでに2,378人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス）流行が発生し、ワクチン・治療法がなく死亡者数も多いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国のみが主題であり、Angolaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOが史上最大のエボラ流行と位置付けており、国際的な支援・対応が必要とされる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia Ebola din Congo - risc "mare" de răspândire internațională, avertizează OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo — high risk of international spread, warns WHO.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in the north and east has infected nearly 5,000 people and killed over 2,300 across six provinces and 55 health zones, as of August 2026. The 17th Ebola epidemic in the country was declared on May 15, with WHO warning that national and international spread remains high. The outbreak is accelerating faster than all previous ones, second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, according to WHO. Transmission occurs via contact with body fluids, with initial symptoms of fever and headache that delay diagnosis. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo virus; clinical trials are ongoing. Response challenges include insecurity, population movement, distrust, vandalized ambulances, and an injured nurse. The EU provides €2.5 million in testing; WHO emphasizes a decentralized, community-engaged response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行 — WHOが国際的拡大の『高い』リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上17回目・過去最速規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で、感染者数約5000人・死者2300人超。WHOが国際的拡大の高リスクを公式警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが付与されているが、記事サマリー本文ではAngolaへの言及がなく、DRC国内（6州55保健地区）での流行として記載されているため、Angolaはverified_locationsに含めない。また、対象国リストにAngola自体は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi govt fully alert over Lumpy skin disease; vaccination campaign underway: Minister Kapil Mishra
article.articleSummary: Delhi is responding to Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in animals with a vigilant vaccination drive in the National Capital Region. As of August 19, 2026, Delhi reports only sporadic LSD cases this year. The Animal Husbandry unit under the Development Department and the Delhi Development Minister Kapil Mishra said the government is fully alert and following the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying guidelines. A vaccination campaign is underway, with efforts to ensure adequate LSD vaccine supplies across NCR veterinary hospitals and dispensaries so vaccination can proceed promptly. Cattle owners are urged to vaccinate their animals, cooperate with veterinary teams, monitor livestock health, and immediately seek government veterinary care if symptoms arise. If infection is suspected, isolate the animal and consult a veterinarian promptly. The objective is to safeguard livestock health and prevent spread through ongoing monitoring and required actions.

triage.headline_ja: デリー政府、ランピースキン病に対し完全警戒態勢、ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施中：カピル・ミシュラ大臣
triage.triage_reason: 動物(牛)のランピースキン病であり、散発的な発生にとどまり、行政が予防的なワクチン接種を実施している段階でヒトへの公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛の疾患でヒトに感染しない動物衛生イベント。デリー当局は散発例に対して予防的ワクチン接種を実施中で、状況は管理下にある。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana health dept fails to share swine flu data amid spike in viral cases - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Ludhiana's Health Department has not shared swine flu (H1N1) data amid a spike in cases in Delhi. Delhi reports a higher swine flu tally this season than last year, while Ludhiana, Punjab's industrial district, cannot furnish figures due to staff on strike and leave among key officials (Civil Surgeon, IDSP nodal officer, District Epidemiologist). At Dayanand Medical College and Hospital (DMCH), physicians report seasonal influenza patients in almost every Medicine OPD; about one to two admissions daily. Officials cited ongoing strike and absence of data collection capacity. DMCH experts note August–October typically see a rise in viral infections post-monsoon; respiratory infections peak in this period. Swine flu is identified as influenza A (H1N1).

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナ保健局、ウイルス性疾患の急増の最中に豚インフルエンザのデータ共有を怠る - The Tribune

triage.notes: 記事はルディアナ（パンジャブ州）とデリーにおける季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の増加、及び保健当局のストライキによるデータ未共有という行政的問題を報じている。8～10月は例年ウイルス性感染症が増加する時期とされ、異常性は低いが、データ不足のため経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo se convierte en el más letal con más de 2.300 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has become the deadliest, with more than 2,300 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases and 2,378 deaths, according to the Ministry of Health via AP. The total stood at 5,021 cases and 2,378 fatalities as of last Sunday. Response teams warn the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace in one of the country’s most remote regions. The World Health Organization estimates the current outbreak will likely surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed more than 11,000 people. Since the first case was detected in April this year, the outbreak has spread about three times faster than the deadliest on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、2,300人以上の死者を出し最も致死的な流行となる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5,000人超の患者・2,378人の死者を記録し、2014-16年の西アフリカ流行を上回る規模に拡大しているため、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が確認され、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC国内の流行についてのみ言及しており、Angolaでの発生は確認されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الأكبر في التاريخ... "إيبولا" يتفشى بشكل خطير
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The largest outbreak in history... Ebola is spreading dangerously.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-spreading on record, UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher said on Friday. He warned that the outbreak is claiming a death roughly every 30 minutes and risks wider spread unless the response is expanded. Fletcher urged the international community to step up and demonstrate greater solidarity to curb the epidemic, stressing that far more people are at risk as the virus continues to spread across affected areas. He noted that several countries have pledged approximately $300 million to a dedicated fund to combat the outbreak. The statements underscore an urgent call for scaled-up operations, resources, and coordinated action to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最大規模…エボラ出血熱が危険なほど拡大
triage.triage_reason: 国連高官がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を史上最速の拡大速度と表明し、多数の死亡と国際社会への支援要請があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 国連担当者による発言に基づく報道であり、感染者数・致死率などの具体的疫学データは記事中に明示されていない。続報でWHOやDRC保健省の公式データの確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الأكبر في التاريخ . إيبولا يتفشى بشكل خطير
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Largest in History. Ebola Is Spreading Dangerously.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding at a rapid pace, outpacing control and containment measures. As of August 19, 2026, the Ministry of Health tallies 5,021 reported cases and 2,378 deaths, marking the largest outbreak in history. International concern grows over widening geographic reach within the DRC and possible cross-border transmission to neighboring areas. The article’s title underscores that this is the largest outbreak on record, highlighting sustained transmission and the ongoing public health challenge posed by EVD, with authorities monitoring spread across districts and border regions. These figures come from the health ministry's records.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最大規模。エボラが危険なほど拡大している
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模とされるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、5,021例・2,378人死亡と報告され、国境を越えた拡大の懸念もあることからIHR基準に複数該当し、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約47%と非常に高く、史上最大規模との報道。国境を越えた伝播の可能性も指摘されており、早急な現地情報の確認とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza con fuerza: Congo rompe la barrera de 5.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances forcefully: Congo surpasses 5,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths (case fatality 47.4%) as of August 17, 2026, marking the second-worst and fastest-growing outbreak since its declaration. The epidemic spans eastern provinces including Ituri, Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé, with 782 patients in isolation or hospital, 1,091 recoveries, and 84.1% contact tracing. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Cross-border spread includes Uganda, which reported 20 infections (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths; Uganda later declared Ebola-free on July 28. The World Health Organization maintains the public health emergency of international concern. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡大加速：コンゴ、5,000例の壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,000例超・死者2,420人（致死率47.4%）に達し、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を維持しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは既にエボラ終息宣言済み（7月28日）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola sprids tre gånger snabbare: "Alarmerande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads three times faster: "Alarming."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the unusual Bundibugyo variant, has infected over 5,000 people and killed about 2,400 as of Sunday, yielding a case fatality around 48%. The outbreak is spreading three times faster than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, a pace attributed to weak resources, conflict, poverty, and diagnostic challenges specific to Bundibugyo. The virus, which causes hemorrhagic fever, presents with fever, headache, muscle aches, and diarrhea, often resembling malaria or typhoid, complicating early detection. Early cases circulated for months before confirmation in May. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for this variant yet, though two rapidly developed vaccines are being tested in humans. Ongoing insecurity in eastern DRC and population displacement hinder contact tracing and community engagement; global aid has fallen short, with WHO funding less than half of what’s needed as of July.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、3倍の速さで拡大：「警戒すべき事態」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で異常なブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱が拡大し、感染者5,000人超、致死率約48%、2014-16年流行の3倍の速度で拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文はDRC東部での発生のみを主題としているため除外。Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din Congo se extinde. OMS menține alerta internațională
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is spreading. WHO maintains the international alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared May 15 in north and east, has reached 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths across six provinces and 55 health zones. WHO maintains international alert; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns cross-border spread remains high. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second-largest on record; Africa CDC notes sevenfold more cases and fivefold more deaths in three months than the first three months of the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (11,300 deaths). Transmission is aided by insecurity, population movement, and transport routes toward mining areas; the virus spreads via contact with bodily fluids; early fever and headache can delay diagnosis. Authorities report distrust and logistical challenges; ambulances vandalized in Ituri and a nurse wounded. The EU is sending €2.5 million in tests; WHO emphasizes a community-centered response, including motorcycle-taxi transport. Bundibugyo strain lacks licensed vaccine or treatment; trials are underway.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が拡大。WHOは国際的な警戒を維持
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,000人感染・2,300人超死亡、6州55衛生地区に拡大し、WHOが国際的アラートを維持している大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 第17回目のDRCエボラ流行で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回るペースで拡大。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株であり、治安不安や住民の不信感が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry issues swine flu advisory amid changing weather - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: India's Health Ministry and Family Welfare issued a swine flu advisory on 19 August 2026, citing changing weather. Major symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny or blocked nose, headache, body and joint pain, breathing difficulty, weakness, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. People with fever, cough or sneezing are advised to avoid public places to curb transmission and to follow preventive guidelines: cover mouth and nose with a handkerchief when coughing or sneezing; wash hands with soap and water; maintain hydration, nutrition, and rest; avoid handshakes and other physical contact; refrain from spitting in public; avoid taking medicines without medical advice. If symptoms occur, consult a doctor and undergo testing and treatment. Emphasis on personal hygiene to prevent spread; no case counts reported.
