triage.notes: 記事は季節性の豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）に対する予防的な注意喚起であり、症例数や重症度に関する具体的データは報告されていない。定例的な公衆衛生広報と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Saradnik Faučija priznao krivicu: Krio državna dokumenta o istraživanjima i pandemiji koronavirusa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Fauci associate pleaded guilty: He hid government documents about the coronavirus investigations and the pandemic.
article.articleSummary: David Morens, 78, a former infectious-disease adviser to Anthony Fauci at NIAID, pleaded guilty in Greenbelt, Maryland, to conspiracy to evade the Freedom of Information Act and to concealing government documents related to NIH-funded research on bat coronaviruses and the COVID-19 pandemic. Prosecutors say Morens sought to help restore a coronavirus-bat virus grant and to oppose claims that COVID-19 leaked from a Wuhan, China lab. He and others allegedly communicated via Morens’s private email to avoid FOIA requests. The plea centers on NIH’s decision to suspend funding for the grant after assertions about a Wuhan lab origin; the Wuhan lab reportedly received funds through a subgrant linked to the original award. He faces up to five years in prison, with sentencing scheduled for November 12. Fauci’s Senate appearance and broader origin debates are referenced in context.

triage.headline_ja: ファウチ氏の元協力者が有罪答弁：コロナウイルス研究とパンデミックに関する政府文書を隠蔽
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生や公衆衛生上の脅威に関する情報ではなく、COVID-19起源調査に関連する文書隠蔽についての司法手続き（有罪答弁）を報じる記事であり、疫学的シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19起源に関する研究資金・文書隠蔽をめぐる米国内の司法手続き（有罪答弁）についての報道であり、実際の感染症発生事例を扱うものではない。武漢は文脈上言及されているが、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola dépasse les 5 000 cas et continue de s'étendre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak exceeds 5,000 cases and continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,000 cases, with 5,021 infections and 2,378 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health. The WHO notes unprecedented spread, with six provinces affected, including Ituri and North Kivu. Security concerns, population displacement, and poor road conditions severely hinder outbreak response. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for this form, and many patients are lost to follow-up or seek care late. Health workers face grueling conditions, with unpaid salaries and instances of violence; in Ituri an ambulance was set on fire during an attack on a response team. The WHO warns of potential international spread as the situation remains far from controlled.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行が5,000例を超え、拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、致死率も高く、WHOが国際的拡大の可能性を警告しているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が約47%と非常に高く、稀なBundibugyo株で承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点、治安不安・住民移動・医療従事者への暴力など対応を著しく妨げる要因が多数存在する。WHOは国際拡大の可能性を明言しており、緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avança em velocidade sem precedentes na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances at unprecedented speed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,000 cases and more than 2,300 deaths, according to the Ministry of Health. Authorities warn that transmission is spreading at an unprecedented speed and advancing faster than the response capacity. The World Health Organization says the outbreak remains far from controlled and could surpass the toll of the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which predominantly affected Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone and resulted in over 11,000 deaths. The situation highlights ongoing concerns about containment and the risk of further spread within the DRC and neighboring regions if transmission continues unchecked.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない速度で拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5,000例・2,300人超の死亡に達し、WHOも制御不能と警告しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確なため、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ）に言及しているが、これは過去の比較対象であり現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。現在の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño extremo eleva riscos de ondas de calor e doenças na América Latina | Com a Palavra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extreme El Niño raises the risks of heat waves and diseases in Latin America | Com a Palavra
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, extreme El Niño raises heat waves and mosquito-borne disease risk across Latin America, notably Brazil. Rio de Janeiro’s Riocentro hit 36.8°C, with July averages at 29.3°C. Atypical El Niño is 90% likely to persist into early 2027, increasing heat, drought, and wildfires, with dengue and Zika transmission projected to rise 10–20% over 30 years. Brazil has about 120,000 heat‑related deaths 2000–2019 (roughly 6,000 yearly; 80% elderly); responses include the Protocolo de Resposta ao Calor Extremo (alerts up to three days ahead), seven Health & Climate Information Centers, a national risk dashboard, and AESOP, which detected 86 outbreaks early. Elsewhere in Latin America, Colombia’s ICESI AI forecasts dengue 1–3 weeks ahead with ~93% accuracy; El Salvador and Guatemala’s La Isla program reduces heat stress injuries among sugarcane workers, cutting renal injury from 21% to 1% in 2025–26. COP30’s Belém plan supports expanded action.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョの極端化がラテンアメリカで熱波と感染症のリスクを高める｜Com a Palavra
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動（エルニーニョ）とデング熱・ジカ熱の将来的リスク増加に関する分析記事であり、現時点での急性アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動による長期的な感染症リスク（10〜20%増加/30年）の予測分析であり、既存の対策（早期警戒システム等）が紹介されている。ガテマラ・コロンビア・エルサルバドルも触れられるが対象国リスト外のため除外。急性の症例増加やアウトブレイク発生の報告はなく、DISMISS相当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the outbreak of a rare kind of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths as of Sunday, making it the largest Bundibugyo outbreak and the deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history. The Bundibugyo virus is a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccine or treatment; vaccines and antibody therapies for the Zaire Ebola virus are not approved for Bundibugyo, though clinical trials are underway and care remains largely supportive. Transmission occurs via contact with blood or bodily fluids; it is not airborne, and incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes bleeding. First symptoms appeared in late April; the patient died in Bunia, Ituri province, and the outbreak was declared May 15 after alerts around Mongbwalu. Most cases are in Ituri, with spread to North Kivu (70% fatality there). Cross-border transmission to Uganda occurred (Uganda stopped transmission); a June case in France involved a doctor returning from Congo. Compared with Congo’s 2018–2020 outbreak (~3,500 cases, >2,200 deaths) and the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (>28,000 cases, 11,000 deaths) caused by Zaire Ebola virus.

triage.headline_ja: まれな種類のエボラ出血熱の発生について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる過去最大・最も死亡率の高い流行が発生し、5,021人の確定患者・2,378人の死亡、ウガンダやフランスへの越境例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびフランスへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないため国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma mais duas mortes por gripe e soma 29 óbitos em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms two more deaths from influenza and brings the death toll to 29 in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports two additional influenza-related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) deaths, raising 2026 totals to 338 SRAG cases and 29 deaths. The new victims were women aged 95 and 76 with comorbidities; the 95-year-old was unvaccinated. Deaths occurred on August 2 and July 22, with the update released August 18, 2026. By August 4, the city had administered 337,480 flu vaccine doses since March 28, including 167,315 in the National Vaccination Calendar target groups: elderly 126,944 (56.75% coverage); children 33,931 (49.66%); pregnant 6,440 (74.89%). In 2025, Campinas recorded 561 SRAG cases and 69 deaths, 54 not vaccinated. Public health guidance emphasizes vaccination, hydration, well-ventilated spaces, hand hygiene, healthy diet, and masking when symptomatic. Flu symptoms include headache, fever, sore throat, cough, and body aches; children may have GI symptoms; elderly fever may be present but not high. Influenza types A and B drive seasonal epidemics; type A drives pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス市、インフルエンザによる死者がさらに2名確認され、2026年の死者数は29名に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナス市における季節性インフルエンザ（SRAG)の定例報告であり、前年（2025年）と比較して症例数・死亡数はむしろ減少している。異常性・国際的拡大リスクはなく、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（SRAG）による死亡者は高齢・基礎疾患ありの患者に限られ、ワクチン接種率も報告されており、地域の公衆衛生対応の範囲内の事例と考えられる。前年比で件数が減少していることからも、通常の季節性動向と判断。

article.articleHeadline: तेनकासी में श्रीलंकाई तमिल पुनर्वास कैंप में डेंगू से दो लोगों की मौत के बाद स्वास्थ्य को लेकर चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health concerns after two people died of dengue fever at the Sri Lankan Tamil Rehabilitation Camp in Tenkasi.
article.articleSummary: As of Aug 19, 2026, dengue has caused two deaths at the Sri Lankan Tamil Rehabilitation Camp near Kadayanallur in Tenkasi district, Tamil Nadu. A 27-year-old woman, Namrla, with laboratory-confirmed dengue, died after hospitalization at Tirunelveli Government Medical College Hospital; a second dengue death is Rehana Mary, daughter of Rajan and Sela Sri, who died while being treated for dengue at the same hospital. Earlier, a 13-year-old girl in the same settlement died from a mosquito-borne infection. Over the past four weeks, 50+ residents have fever; the camp shelters over 150 Sri Lankan Tamil refugee families for ~35 years. Health teams have increased surveillance and authorities intensified mosquito-control and sanitation efforts. Residents blame waste dumping/ burning near the camp for breeding mosquitos and demand prompt waste removal, regular fogging, standing-water cleanup, and sustained medical monitoring, especially for children.

triage.headline_ja: テンカシのスリランカ・タミル人リハビリキャンプでデング熱により2人死亡、健康への懸念が広がる
triage.triage_reason: 難民キャンプ内でデング熱による複数死亡（13歳少女含む）と50人以上の発熱者が発生し、衛生環境の悪さから感染拡大の懸念があり、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSri Lankaが含まれているが、これはインド・タミルナードゥ州テンカシ地区にあるスリランカ系タミル難民キャンプでの発生であり、実際の発生国はインドのみ。デング熱自体はインドで季節性に流行する疾患だが、難民キャンプという脆弱な集団での複数死亡例は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta para risco de disseminação do Ebola na República Democrática do Congo e países vizinhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the risk of Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading faster than previous epidemics, WHO warns. More than 2,300 deaths among 5,000 cases have been reported since 15 May 2026 declaration; this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Transmission likely began weeks before official recognition. Affected areas include northern and eastern DRC, with weak state presence, limited health infrastructure, and armed-group activity. Africa CDC data show sevenfold more cases and fivefold more deaths in the first three months than during West Africa’s 2013–2016 outbreak, which killed over 11,300 in Liberia, Sierra Leone and Guinea. Current outbreak spans six provinces along South Sudan border, with cases in Uganda. Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment yet; trials are ongoing. Deaths at home and outside treatment centers raise concerns about undetected transmission chains; response focuses on decentralization, community engagement, and protecting moto-taxi drivers to improve surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国および周辺国でのエボラ拡大リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中であり、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻でWHOが国際的拡大リスクを警告しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行拡大とその近隣国（ウガンダ等、対象国リスト外）への波及リスクを主題としている。スーダン、シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニアは過去の流行（西アフリカ2013-2016）との比較で言及されているのみで、現行流行の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Bronquiolitis en menores de 2 años: qué revela la suba de casos en esta temporada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bronchiolitis in children under 2 years old: what the rise in cases this season reveals
article.articleSummary: Argentina’s week 31 epidemiological bulletin reports a rise in bronchiolitis among children under 2, driven by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), which caused 284 positive inpatients. Highest RSV positivity is in ages 6–11 months, though overall bronchiolitis remains low compared with the past five years, placing the season in an expected “zone of success.” In ambulatory settings, influenza positivity fell to 10%, while RSV rose to 24 positives in the last four weeks; 65 influenza hospitalizations occurred, and SARS-CoV-2 remains low and stable with four severe cases. The Health Ministry added maternal RSV vaccination during weeks 32–36 of gestation to the National Immunization Schedule to protect infants in the first six months. Influenza A(H3N2) shows 5 new cases of subclade J.2.4.1, variant K (total 382/476 samples); Influenza B Victoria totals 78 positives (B now 60% of A(H3N2) in week 29). The 2026/2027 chikungunya and dengue season began: 20 suspected chikungunya (2 probable; 18 under study) in Salta; dengue: 77 suspects, 30 under study, none positive first week. Mpox reports 4 new cases (Córdoba, San Juan, Buenos Aires), 15 total for the year, clade Ib; two travel histories to Germany and France. OPS regional panorama notes mpox activity across the Americas (e.g., U.S. 677, Brazil 215, Chile 88, Mexico 69, Colombia 39, Canada 16, Bolivia 7, Ecuador 3, Peru 3).

triage.headline_ja: 2歳未満の細気管支炎：今シーズンの症例増加が示すもの
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はアルゼンチンの週次疫学速報であり、RSV・インフルエンザ・mpox等の症例数は例年並みまたは低水準で「成功ゾーン」と評価されている。対象国（ブラジル等）は地域比較データとして数値が挙げられているのみで、記事の主題はアルゼンチン国内の状況であるため対象国イベントとはみなせない。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチンの週31疫学速報が主題。mpoxの地域パノラマでブラジル等の症例数が言及されているが、これは比較統計データであり、ブラジル国内でのイベント発生を報じるものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: तेनकासी में श्रीलंकाई तमिल पुनर्वास कैंप में डेंगू से दो लोगों की मौत के बाद स्वास्थ्य को लेकर चिंता - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health concerns after two people die of dengue at a Sri Lankan Tamil rehabilitation camp in Tenkasi
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, dengue outbreaks are reported at a Sri Lankan Tamil rehabilitation camp near Kadayanallur in Tenkasi district, Tamil Nadu, India. A 27-year-old woman, Narmla, died after dengue was confirmed and she was hospitalized at Tirunelveli Government Medical College Hospital. The camp, home to about 150 Sri Lankan Tamil refugee families for ~35 years, has seen over 50 residents develop fever in the past four weeks. Earlier, a 13-year-old girl died from a mosquito-borne infection, and Rihanna Mary also died while receiving dengue treatment at Tirunelveli hospital. In response, health authorities intensified vector-control, cleaning drives, fogging, and medical surveillance, while residents demand rapid waste removal and sustained sanitation. They call for ongoing fever screening and permanent measures to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sites to prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: テンカーシーのスリランカ・タミル人再定住キャンプでデング熱により2人死亡、健康懸念が拡大
triage.triage_reason: スリランカ系タミル難民キャンプで複数の死亡例を伴うデング熱アウトブレイクが継続し、住民の間で不安が広がり当局が対策を強化しているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心もあることからフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで流行病として一般的だが、難民キャンプという脆弱な集団内で複数の死亡例と持続的な発熱症例（4週間で50人以上）が報告されており、衛生状態改善やベクター管理の継続的対応が必要な状況。国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、地域内での感染拡大リスクは残る。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo supera la barrera de los 5,000 casos de ébola confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo surpasses 5,000 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths as of August 17, 2026, with a case fatality rate of 47.4%. About 782 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,091 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 84.1%. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, marks the second-worst and fastest-growing Ebola epidemic since its declaration. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including fever, vomiting, diarrhea and hemorrhagic manifestations. The outbreak spans six provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé. It has crossed into Uganda, which declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. The WHO maintains the international public health emergency; evidence suggests circulation since February, with a Science report indicating possible January infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ確定患者数が5,000人の壁を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当（致死率47.4%、Bundibugyo株の異常な急速拡大、ウガンダへの越境、WHO国際的公衆衛生緊急事態継続中）し、フルRRAへ進めるべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境が報告されているが、既に7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCでは6州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Haut-Uélé、Tshopo、Bas-Uélé）にわたり流行中でWHOの国際的公衆衛生緊急事態が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: L'OMS sonne l'alarme face à l'épidémie d'Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: WHO Sounds the Alarm Over Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains uncontrolled and is the second-largest, fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date. Nearly 5,000 people are infected and over 2,300 have died across six provinces and 55 health zones. Ongoing transmission is underscored by deaths occurring at home and outside treatment centers, signaling hidden transmission chains. The outbreak risks crossing borders: Uganda has interrupted transmission, but a traveler recently introduced the virus to France. The response, led by the DRC government, WHO, CDC Africa, and partners, expands community surveillance, treatment capacity, safe and dignified burials, and vaccine and therapeutic trials. For the first time, two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in human trials; one shows cross-protection in animals and advances to Phase III. The PARTNERS trial includes 100 participants.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:WHOがブンディブギョ型エボラ流行に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で制御不能な大規模エボラ流行が発生し、5000人近くが感染・2300人以上が死亡、フランスへの越境例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは感染連鎖が遮断されたと記載されており対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。フランスは対象国リスト外のため除外。過去最大級・最速拡大のエボラ流行として国際的注目度が非常に高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Sieben weitere Regionen in der DR Kongo von Ebola-Epidemie betroffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven more regions in the DRC affected by Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Seven more regions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report first Ebola infections as the outbreak in the east widens. Gombari (Haut-Uélé), Lubero (Nord-Kivu), Bafwasende, Kabondo, Wanie-Rukula (both in Tshopo), and Buta (Bas-Uélé) mark new locations with initial cases. WHO situational updates show the outbreak spreading geographically, with Ituri still the hardest hit, accounting for more than 80% of confirmed infections and nearly 80% of deaths. Overall, there are more than 5,000 confirmed infections and 2,378 deaths; in the past week, almost 400 fatalities were reported. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus is responsible; there are no approved antivirals or a vaccine. Case detection and isolation are hampered by late reporting (about 60% of deaths outside treatment centers), weak health infrastructure, and ongoing conflict. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and the 17th since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でさらに7地域がエボラ出血熱の流行に見舞われる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部を中心に7つの新地域に拡大し、感染者数5000人超・死者2378人と極めて深刻な状況であり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる流行で、承認されたワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が存在しない。武力衝突や脆弱な医療体制が対応を妨げており、史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行として国際的注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite exige atenção aos primeiros sintomas e cuidados para prevenir a transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis Requires Attention to Early Symptoms and Precautions to Prevent Transmission.
article.articleSummary: João Pessoa, Brazil, faces ongoing meningitis surveillance in 2026, with 58 suspected cases, 13 laboratory-confirmed, and four deaths to date. The confirmed cases comprise meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis) in 2 patients, Haemophilus influenzae in 1, meningitis from other bacteria in 2, other etiologies in 2, and meningitis not specified in 6. Age distribution among the 13 confirmed: two under 1 year; two aged 1–9; two aged 10–19; three aged 20–49; and four aged 60 or older. The four fatalities occurred in the 10–19, 20–49, and 60+ groups (two deaths in 60+). Symptoms span fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, behavior changes, with seizures in some children. Transmission varies by agent; prevention stresses vaccination, hand hygiene, ventilation, and avoiding shared personal items. In schools, routine attendance can continue; populations should follow health guidelines and updates from epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎、初期症状への注意と感染予防のための対策が必要
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ジョアンペソアで髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎を含む複数病原体による髄膜炎の疑い例・死亡例が報告されているが、サーベイランスの一環としての通常報告であり、異常な増加や国際的拡大の兆候は明記されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 13確定例中、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は2例のみで、他はHaemophilus influenzae等の他病原体。4死亡例のうち2例は60歳以上。記事は一般向け予防啓発の内容が中心で、アウトブレイクの急激な拡大を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: तेनकासी में श्रीलंकाई तमिल पुनर्वास कैंप में डेंगू से दो लोगों की मौत के बाद स्वास्थ्य को लेकर चिंता | Two dengue deaths spark health concerns at Sri Lankan Tamil rehabilitation camp in Tenkasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health concerns after two dengue deaths at the Sri Lankan Tamil rehabilitation camp in Tenkasi.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreaks trigger grave concern at a Sri Lankan Tamil refugee rehabilitation camp near Kadayanallur in Tamil Nadu’s Tenkasi district. A 27-year-old woman, Narmla, died after dengue was confirmed; she had been admitted to Tirunelveli Government Medical College Hospital. Earlier, a 13-year-old girl in the same settlement died from a mosquito-borne infection, and Rihanna Mary, daughter of Rajan and Sela Sri, died while undergoing dengue treatment at the same Tirunelveli hospital. Over the past month, more than 50 residents developed fever, with the camp housing over 150 Sri Lankan Tamil refugee families for about 35 years. In response, health workers intensified vector control and sanitation, including fogging and removal of stagnant water. Residents blame nearby waste management practices and urge immediate litter removal, ongoing cleaning, and enhanced medical surveillance, especially for children and vulnerable individuals, to curb further cases and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: テンカシのスリランカ系タミル人リハビリキャンプでデング熱による2人の死亡が発生し、健康への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による複数死亡（3例）と50人以上の発熱例が難民キャンプで発生し、媒介動物対策・衛生対策が継続的に必要な状況であり、住民・保健当局の関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: スリランカ系タミル難民キャンプはインド・タミルナードゥ州テンカシ県内に存在するため、発生地はインドのみと判断。スリランカ自体での発生は記載なし。デング熱はインドで季節的に流行する疾病であり異常性は低いが、限定的集団内での複数死亡・多数発熱例は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite: alerta sobre primeiros sintomas e cuidados para prevenir a transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis: Warning about Early Symptoms and Precautions to Prevent Transmission.
article.articleSummary: Meningitis vigilance in João Pessoa, Brazil: as of 2026, 58 suspected meningitis cases among residents; 13 confirmed and 4 deaths. Confirmed etiologies include meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis) with 2 cases, Haemophilus influenzae with 1, 2 cases due to other bacteria, 2 due to other etiologies, and 6 unspecified meningitis cases. Age distribution among confirmed cases spans <1 year (2), 1–9 years (2), 10–19 years (2), 20–49 years (3), and 60+ years (4). The four fatalities occurred in the 10–19, 20–49, and 60+ age groups (two deaths in 60+), with none among confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases. No outbreak is currently identified; ongoing surveillance, laboratory evaluation, and risk-based measures including chemoprophylaxis for contacts when indicated. Precautions emphasize vaccination, hand hygiene, avoiding shared personal items, and well-ventilated environments. One school case did not require class suspension. Vaccination in the SUS calendar protects against multiple meningitis agents.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎：初期症状の警告と感染予防のための注意点
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ジョアンペソアで髄膜炎（髄膜炎菌性含む）の疑い58例・確定13例・死亡4例が報告されているが、記事内で「アウトブレイクは確認されていない」と明記され、通常のサーベイランス活動の一環と位置付けられている。重症度はあるが規模は限定的で国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 確定髄膜炎菌性症例（Neisseria meningitidis）は2例のみで死亡例はなし。地域の公衆衛生当局は既にサーベイランス・接触者への化学予防・ワクチン接種推奨などの対応を行っており、外部支援の必要性は示されていない。続報でアウトブレイク認定の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Satna News: डेंगू से मृत महिला की बहू और नातिन भी पॉजिटिव, 11 लोगों के लिए गए थे सैंपल | Daughter-in-law and granddaughter of woman who died of dengue also test positive; samples were collected from 11 people.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satna News: Daughter-in-law and granddaughter of the woman who died of dengue also test positive; samples were collected from 11 people.
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, in Satna, Madhya Pradesh's Jeevan Jyoti Colony, a 60-year-old woman, Ramdulari Chakravarti, died of dengue. Her daughter-in-law Kavita and granddaughter Ankita Chakravarti tested dengue-positive by ELISA, and Ramdulari’s younger sister-in-law Baby Chakravarti also tested dengue-positive using an RD Kit at a private Nagpur hospital and is admitted; Kavita and Ankita were discharged after treatment. After the death, the Malaria Department conducted a larval survey around the house; no dengue larvae were found due to heavy rain. About 40 nearby residents were tested for malaria, all negative. Blood samples from 11 family members were collected and sent to the district hospital for ELISA testing; tests were performed on Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: サトナ:デングで死亡した女性の義理の娘と孫娘も陽性、11人からサンプル採取
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州の一家族内で発生したデング熱クラスター事例であり、季節性流行の範囲内で異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は見られない。地域保健当局が既に調査・対応を実施している。
triage.notes: デング熱は南アジアで季節性に頻発する感染症であり、本事例は一家族内での感染クラスター（死亡1名、陽性複数名）に限定される。近隣住民へのマラリア検査は全員陰性、幼虫調査でも陽性は確認されず、地域的拡大の証拠はない。地方保健当局（マラリア局）が既に調査・検査対応を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: Servidores recebem vacinas contra gripe e chikungunya no Paço
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public servants receive vaccines against influenza and chikungunya at City Hall
article.articleSummary: Municipal workers in São José do Rio Preto can receive free vaccines against influenza and chikungunya on Monday, 24 August, at City Hall. Vaccinations will be offered in the Auditório Juan Bérgua, ground floor, starting at 8:30 a.m., during the morning period with no appointment required. Employees who bring their vaccination booklet should do so to help verify prior doses and record new ones. The effort aims to provide individual protection and strengthen herd immunity in the workplace, reducing virus circulation among colleagues, families, and public service users. The chikungunya vaccine targets a disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti, causing high fever and severe joint pain; the influenza vaccine protects against seasonal flu. The initiative supports UN Sustainable Development Goals: Health and Well-Being (3), Decent Work and Economic Growth (8), and Sustainable Cities and Communities (11).

triage.headline_ja: 市庁舎で公務員がインフルエンザとチクングニア熱のワクチン接種を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 通常のワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する記事であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの案内であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。ブラジルでの一般的な予防接種活動のため、対象国リストに合致するイベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Tanzania donates Sh220 million medical supplies to DRC to fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 19 Aug 2026, Tanzania donated medical supplies worth about Sh220 million to the Democratic Republic of Congo to bolster its Ebola response and protect frontline health workers. Speaking after the fourth Regional Steering Committee of African Health Ministers (ReSCO) meeting in Dar es Salaam, Health Minister Mohamed Mchengerwa said the aid, ordered by President Samia Suluhu Hassan, aims to strengthen the DRC's capacity to contain Ebola in affected areas and safeguard health workers and communities. Tanzania emphasized regional cooperation, noting that diseases do not respect borders and that outbreaks in one country threaten neighbours. Supplies will be delivered once receiving procedures are completed. ReSCO discussions, ahead of the September 9–11, 2026 international summit in Arusha, focused on strengthening health security and cross-border responses to outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: タンザニア、エボラ対策のためDRCに2.2億シリング相当の医療物資を寄贈
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行に関する記事であり、深刻性・国際的拡大リスクの両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はタンザニアからDRCへの医療物資寄贈という支援活動が主題であり、新規のエボラ発生情報ではないが、DRC国内で進行中のエボラ流行対応の一環として国際的関心・支援ニーズが確認できる。タンザニア自体では感染事例の発生は報告されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Bianca Andrade divulga diagnóstico após infecção e faz alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bianca Andrade Reveals Diagnosis After Infection and Issues a Warning.
article.articleSummary: Bi Bianca Andrade, 31, was hospitalized in Brazil with pyelonephritis, a kidney infection that followed a urinary tract infection. There were no typical urinary symptoms early on, delaying diagnosis and allowing bacteria to ascend to the kidneys. Worsening back pain, persistent high fever, and imaging and blood tests confirmed pyelonephritis. Andrade warns that atypical infections can spread to the bloodstream and cause sepsis with multi-organ complications, underscoring the need for prompt medical evaluation with persistent symptoms. She cites conversations with friend Juliette and notes that actress Carolina Dieckmann was diagnosed with pyelonephritis in June, reporting ~39°C fever and back pain without classic urinary signs. Pyelonephritis is commonly caused by bacteria such as Escherichia coli; treatment involves antibiotics and hydration. This highlights importance of recognizing atypical presentations and seeking care in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ビアンカ・アンドラーデ、感染後の診断を公表し注意を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: 個人の腎盂腎炎（E.コリ感染）に関する著名人の健康報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 著名人個人の医療事例であり、感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。E. coliによる尿路感染・腎盂腎炎は一般的な散発性疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Китай из-за вспышки африканской чумы запретил ввоз свинины из одной страны - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China bans pork imports from one country due to an outbreak of African swine fever - News on Vesti.ru.
article.articleSummary: China’s General Administration of Customs bans direct or indirect imports of pork, pork products, and wild boar meat, along with related goods, from Finland due to an outbreak of African swine fever (ASF). Helsinki notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) about the ASF outbreak, which prompted Finland to close its eastern border to game animals after reporting the first case this August. The import ban will also apply to any intercepted consignments, which will be destroyed. ASF is a viral disease of pigs characterized by fever, cyanosis, and extensive hemorrhages in internal organs; the article notes no transmission to humans. No case counts are provided. The measure is reported as of 2026-08-19.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、アフリカ豚熱の発生を受けてある国からの豚肉輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱はフィンランドで発生した動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染は報告されていない。発生国フィンランドおよび対応国中国は対象国リストに含まれず、公衆衛生上の懸念も低いため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 本事案はブタの動物疾病（ASF）であり、ヒトへの感染性はないと明記されている。発生国フィンランドは対象国リストに該当せず、中国は輸入禁止措置を取った側であり発生国ではないため、対象国は該当なし。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 on the rise, docs urge parents to keep sick children out of school
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (influenza A) is rising among Bengaluru children, prompting doctors to urge parents to keep sick kids at home and practice good hygiene. Influenza A is the predominant infection, and some cases have progressed to pneumonia and respiratory distress; at least four ANEC cases have been seen in recent weeks. Most affected are children aged 3–5; those with asthma, cardiac conditions, allergies or compromised immunity are at higher risk. Symptoms include high fever, myalgia, dehydration, respiratory distress, and GI symptoms. Admissions are largely due to influenza A; Delhi reports more severe outcomes, including multi-organ failure. Factors include high-density schools and travel in Bengaluru’s large migrant population. Preventive steps: keep ill children home, ensure hand hygiene, avoid close contact, and consider annual flu vaccination, especially for under-fives. Clarence High School suspended offline classes after two confirmed H1N1 cases.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1が増加、医師は保護者に病気の子どもを学校に行かせないよう促す
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の増加により小児の重症化（肺炎・多臓器不全）や学校閉鎖が報告され、社会的関心も高まっているため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心ありでフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の増加はインド国内（バンガロール、デリー）で報告されており、学校閉鎖や重症例（多臓器不全）が確認されている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の情報はなく、季節性の流行拡大という位置づけ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola escapa ao controle, mata 2,3 mil e pode superar pior epidemia da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Escapes Control, Kills 2,300 and Could Surpass the Worst Epidemic in History.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5,000 cases, with 5,021 infections and 2,378 deaths reported as of Sunday, August 16, 2026. The outbreak, centered in Bunia, capital of Ituri province, is spreading at unprecedented speed, driven by insecurity, internal displacement, and high population mobility. The Bundibugyo virus is the pathogen, and there is a critical shortage of vaccines or approved treatments. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned on August 18, 2026 that the outbreak is not under control and could outpace the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which caused over 11,000 fatalities. Frontline workers report fatigue and payroll delays; strikes risk hindering response. Many new cases are not in the monitoring system, indicating accelerated transmission and surveillance challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が制御不能に、2,300人が死亡し、史上最悪の流行を超える可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州で発生したエボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス）が5,000例超・死者2,378人に達し、WHO事務局長も制御不能と警告。IHR基準複数・WPRO基準すべてに該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文では言及がないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬の不足、治安不安、人口移動が拡大要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Seoni News: बालाघाट के बिरसा क्षेत्र में अज्ञात बीमारी से हो रही बच्चों की मौत को लेकर स्वास्थ्य विभाग हरकत में आया | The Health Department has swung into action following the deaths of children due to an unidentified illness in the Birsa area of ââBalaghat.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seoni News: In the Birsa area of Balaghat, deaths of children due to an unidentified illness have prompted the Health Department to swing into action.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Balaghat district’s Birsa area reports deaths of children due to an unidentified illness, prompting Health Department action. An alert covers Ugli and nearby border regions. A Seoni–Balaghat inter-district malaria coordination meeting was held to synchronize response and share investigation reports, with a plan to accelerate malaria elimination in border areas. In Seoni, a dengue patient was recorded in Bhairoganj; this season has yielded ten dengue cases and twelve malaria cases year-to-date. Discussions covered active fever surveillance, follow-up of positives, larval surveillance and control, IHIP reporting, vector control, and inter-district coordination. EMBED regional coordinator Ramkrsna Jat urged stronger larval surveys, identification of breeding sites, regular source elimination monitoring, and enhanced documentation. Malaria technical supervisor Manisha Bagade and Mahendra Thakur contributed. PHC Ugli meeting included CHOs, ANMs, ASHAs, MPWs, supervisors, malaria staff, and EMBED reps.

triage.headline_ja: スィオニ―ニュース：バラガート県ビルサ地区で原因不明の疾患による子どもの死亡が発生し、保健当局が対応に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: バラガート県ビルサ地区で原因不明の疾患による小児死亡が報告され保健当局が対応しているが、症例数・病原体・重症度等の詳細情報が不足しており続報の確認が必要。併記されているマラリア・デング熱は例年規模の定例監視事案であり特段の異常はみられない。
triage.notes: 原因不明の小児死亡事例は詳細（症例数、死亡数、病原体、発症時期等）が記事内で明らかでなく、続報を要する。マラリア・デング熱に関する情報は定例のサーベイランス活動報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ബാധിതർ 5,000 കടന്നു; പ്രതിരോധ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങൾ പാളുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, Ebola patients cross 5,000; containment measures falter.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has crossed 5,000 confirmed infections, reaching 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of August 19, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain is circulating, for which no licensed vaccines or proven targeted treatments exist, making control more challenging. About 60–70% of new cases are outside the existing contact-tracing lists, signaling widespread community transmission. The outbreak has spread to six provinces in the DRC, with neighboring Uganda reporting cases. Health workers face attacks amid domestic unrest and local mistrust, including an incident in Ituri province involving assault on responders and gunfire at an ambulance. The World Health Organization has declared a global health emergency and urged an urgent international response and strengthened community engagement to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が5,000人を超え、防疫対策が機能不全に陥っている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染者が5,000人を超え、地域社会内感染や近隣国への拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Ituriは州レベルの情報のため国レベルの評価に統合。

article.articleHeadline: Se registraron 4 nuevos casos de Mpox y ya suman 15 en el año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four new Mpox cases have been reported, bringing the total to 15 so far this year.
article.articleSummary: Four new Mpox cases in Argentina, all in clade Ib; two cases reported travel history to Germany and France. The year’s total confirmed Mpox cases rises to 15. Of these, 8 are in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires (CABA), 3 in Córdoba, 2 in Buenos Aires Province (PBA), 1 in San Juan, and 1 in Río Negro. All patients recovered without hospitalization and are in home isolation. Regionally, OPS data for weeks 1–26 show Mpox counts in the United States (677), Brazil (215), Chile (88), Mexico (69), Colombia (39), Canada (35), Bolivia (16), Ecuador (7), and Peru (3). The Ministry of Health calls for sustained, high-quality surveillance to enable early case identification; clinicians should suspect Mpox, provide appropriate care, and implement isolation and contact tracing, including collecting travel history and recent sexual exposures.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxの新規4例が確認され、年間累計は15例に達した
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでクレードIbのMpox症例（欧州渡航歴あり）が継続的に確認され、複数州にわたり拡大しており、国際的拡散リスクと異常性（従来と異なるクレード）が認められるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンにおけるMpoxクレードIb症例の増加であり、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル・米国等はOPSの地域統計として言及されているのみで、記事の主題国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma 2ª morte por febre maculosa em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms second death from Brazilian spotted fever in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian spotted fever (Rickettsia rickettsii) deaths rise in the Campinas region. Campinas confirms its second fatal case in 2026: a 29-year-old man who likely contracted the infection during a visit to a pesqueiro (fishing site) in a nearby city; symptoms began June 21 and he died June 26 in hospital. The preceding Campinas death occurred April 21 in a 74-year-old man. Sumaré reports its first 2026 death: a 37-year-old man who died July 30 after admission to UPA Macarenko. By Aug 18, Sumaré had 85 notifications (38 awaiting results, 47 discarded). The Campinas region is a transmission area; risk runs through November, with ticks. Symptoms usually appear 2–14 days after a tick bite and include fever, headache, severe body pain, malaise, nausea, and vomiting. Public health guidance urges avoiding vegetation, wearing light clothing, checking the body after outdoors, and proper tick removal; authorities will reinforce guidance at pesqueiros near city limits.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス、2026年の紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）による2人目の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナス地域で毎年発生するダニ媒介性の地方病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡例が増加しており地域内での継続的な感染リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル紅斑熱（Rickettsia rickettsii）はカンピーナス地域で毎年発生する地方病。ヒト-ヒト感染はなくダニ媒介性。2026年に複数の死亡例が報告されているが、これは既知の季節的流行パターンの範囲内であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: Leptospirosis medicines sufficient
article.articleSummary: DOH-run facilities remain operational and stocked against leptospirosis amid flooding. Code White Alert is active in affected Centers for Health Development, with coordination with the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council. The DOH has 3.1 million doxycycline capsules on standby at the central office and 17 CHDs, with nearly 3,000 PhilHealth-accredited YAKAP providers allowed to prescribe doxycycline. The zero-balance billing program and expanded PhilHealth benefits cover severe cases; July 15 increased hospitalization coverage from P21,450 to P63,000, with potential rises to P170,000–P411,000 for intensive treatment. As of Aug. 8, 3,440 cases nationwide, 35% lower than last year, though 348 occurred July 12–25 (up 27% from June 28–July 11). Public advised to avoid floodwaters; fever, headache, chills, back/leg pain, or red eyes should seek medical consultation at DOH fast lanes. In Manila, 44 health centers distribute doxycycline to flood-affected residents, per Mayor Isko Moreno.

triage.headline_ja: DOH：レプトスピラ症治療薬は十分に確保
triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴う季節性のレプトスピラ症流行で、症例数は前年比35%減少し、DOHが十分な医薬品と医療体制を確保していると報告する内容。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 洪水シーズンに伴う毎年恒例のレプトスピラ症対応報道。DOHが医薬品・医療体制の充実を強調し、前年より症例数が少ないことを報告する内容で、危機的な公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo enfrenta su peor epidemia de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its worst Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches its deadliest phase with about 5,000 infections and over 2,300 deaths since it began on May 17, 2026. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, urging urgent funding and international support to sustain containment over the coming months. Worries center on community deaths and transmission chains outside formal medical monitoring, indicating undetected spread. Uganda reports no recent imported cases; France has detected a linked case in a traveler from the DRC, highlighting cross-border transmission risk. The emergency declaration underscores coordinated international action to bolster surveillance, outbreak response, and cross-border collaboration to halt ongoing transmission during one of the Congo’s worst Ebola crises.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最悪のエボラ出血熱流行に直面

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : pourquoi l'OMS croit encore à un contrôle sous trois mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Why the WHO Still Believes It Will Be Under Control Within Three Months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to spread. As of Aug 12, 2026, 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths. By Aug 14, transmission reached 54 health zones across six provinces, making it the DRC’s deadliest Ebola outbreak and second deadliest globally since the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. The WHO maintains a cautious outlook that, with sufficient resources, the outbreak could be controlled within three months, a plan reiterated Aug 18 by Thierno Balde. Response capacity has grown with 400 beds added and more epidemiologists deployed to trace contacts. Yet, as of Aug 4, only 75% of contacts were followed daily (goal >=95%), and North Kivu hospitals ran at 139% occupancy. The Bundibugyo strain lacks licensed vaccines or treatments; 70–80% of new cases have unknown links, signaling undetected transmission chains. Africa CDC estimates ~$319 million for a six-month continental plan to support DRC, Uganda, and high-risk countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOが3か月以内の制御に自信を持つ理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最も死者数の多いエボラ流行が拡大しており、致死率・症例数ともに高く、感染連鎖の追跡も不十分で国際的懸念が強いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行拡大が主題。ウガンダ・アンゴラは高リスク国として言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が承認されておらず、感染連鎖の70-80%が未特定であることから、さらなる拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: गांधीनगर में लगेगा स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञों का महाकुंभ, 20 अगस्त से शुरू होगा CIDSCON 2026; जुटेंगे देश-विदेश के 950 प्रतिनिधि - cidscon 2026 infectious disease experts meet in gandhinagar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gandhinagar to host a grand conclave of health experts; CIDSCON 2026 to begin on August 20; 950 delegates from India and abroad will gather.
article.articleSummary: On 20-23 August 2026, Gandhinagar hosts CIDSCON 2026, the 16th annual conference of the Clinical Infectious Diseases Society, at Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre. Health State Minister Praful Panasheriya will inaugurate the event and unveil a book on antimicrobial resistance and antimicrobial stewardship. Over 950 delegates from India and abroad, including infectious disease physicians, researchers, microbiologists, and public-health professionals, will attend, with international faculties from the United States and Singapore. The four-day agenda covers antimicrobial resistance (AMR), antimicrobial stewardship, tropical infections, tuberculosis, HIV, fungal infections, virology, infection control, and emerging technologies such as next-generation sequencing, phage therapy, and AI-based clinical practice. An AI-focused workshop will explore AI deployment and practical medical decision-making. A 22 August session will review Gujarat’s AMR containment efforts (GUJSAR-N), stewardship monitoring, and AMR-dashboard surveillance. The conference ends with a valedictory session on 23 August.

triage.headline_ja: ガンディーナガルで保健専門家の大会合開催、CIDSCON 2026が8月20日開幕；国内外から950人の代表団が集結

article.articleHeadline: Expectativas positivas de la OMS frente al brote por Ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Positive expectations from WHO regarding the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, WHO Emergency Response Coordinator Thierno Baldé said the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be controlled within the next three months, provided the necessary resources are available. He noted that in the past two weeks response capacity has been expanded to 400 beds, representing the largest care capacity deployed in the country’s worst Ebola outbreak to date. The crisis has already claimed more than 2,300 lives. Baldé emphasized that containment hinges on sustained, well-resourced response including treatment facilities, surveillance, and field operations. The report highlights the ongoing international concern and the critical need for funding and logistics to maintain progress against the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に関するWHOの前向きな見通し
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で死者2300人超、国際的な資金・物資支援が必要とされているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: RaillyNews - Ebola Outbreak in Congo Escalates with 5,000 Cases Reported as Vaccinations Continue
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases with more than 2,378 deaths. Vaccination efforts continue, with over 169,000 doses administered in high-risk zones. The epidemic has accelerated across several provinces, notably Ituri, driven by instability, displacement, and weak health infrastructure, complicating containment and raising cross-border transmission risk. Compared with the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, current spread is about threefold faster but geographically more contained so far; nonetheless international spread remains a concern amid security challenges. WHO, MSF and regional health ministries deploy contact tracing, rapid vaccination campaigns, and community engagement. Major hurdles include attacks on health facilities, hindered aid delivery, and mass displacement. Response priorities: enhanced surveillance, expedited vaccination, community partnerships, security cooperation, and cross-border data sharing to curb transmission and protect health workers.

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | أرقام صادمة.. إيبولا يتفشى بسرعة هي الأكبر في التاريخ

article.articleHeadline: Alerta en el Congo: brote de ébola ha superado los 5 mil casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Congo: Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths as of August 19, 2026. The epidemic involves the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist, hindering containment. Ituri province (Bunia) and North Kivu are hardest hit, with Mongbwalu identified as a possible origin and transmission ongoing since February; officials declared the outbreak on May 15. The World Health Organization warns it could become the largest Ebola outbreak on record, noting the virus is spreading roughly three times faster than the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak. The case fatality rate is 47.4% overall, rising to about 70% in North Kivu. Violence and insecurity impede response: attacks on health teams in Aru, rebel threats, poor roads, and community distrust; healthcare workers report fatigue and late-pay strikes, delaying care and increasing fatalities.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : déploiement d'une nouvelle équipe de communicateurs pour renforcer la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: deployment of a new team of communicators to strengthen the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is being addressed in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the deployment of a new team of community communicators and sensitizers trained by the Central Office of the Beni Health Zone (BCZS) in collaboration with FHI 360/Family Health International. The team will support communities using a community-based surveillance approach, carrying out door-to-door, neighborhood, church, and parking-lot outreach to intensify awareness across Beni. Engagement will include youth leaders, civil groups, political leaders, women, and other community opinion leaders to reduce resistance to the response. A two-day training began on August 19 at CAP Beni (Centre d'accueil protestant de Beni), organized by BCZS and Civil Protection with FHI 360, to strengthen local communication capacities. The aim remains eradication of Ebola in Beni as soon as possible.

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviar en El Salvador, ¿es peligroso comer pollo? infectólogo aclara dudas y advierte sobre riesgos para trabajadores agrícolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza in El Salvador: Is it dangerous to eat chicken? An infectious disease specialist clarifies doubts and warns about risks for agricultural workers.
article.articleSummary: El Salvador has issued a sanitary alert for Avian influenza, warning that while the disease mainly affects birds, it can pose health risks for people in contact with infected poultry. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (MAG) declared the alert amid rising outbreaks across the Americas and prior human infections in neighboring countries. Avian influenza is caused by Influenza A viruses circulating among wild and domestic birds. The World Health Organization notes that humans can be infected through direct contact with ill animals during handling, slaughter, or processing, or via contaminated environments; indirect contact with contaminated surfaces also poses risk. Infectious disease specialist Jorge Panameño says there is no direct threat to El Salvador's public health at present, but poultry workers face real exposure risk. Symptoms range from fever and myalgia to cough and acute respiratory illness, with some asymptomatic cases; sustained human-to-human transmission has not been demonstrated. Since Oct 2025, outbreaks have been reported in the United States, Canada, Argentina, Brazil, Honduras, Costa Rica, and Colombia. El Salvador has strengthened surveillance in farms, markets, and border controls, and authorities urge vigilance.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases In Congo Surpass 5,000 As Outbreak Continues To Spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have surpassed 5,000, with 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths reported as of Sunday, marking the 17th Congo Ebola outbreak—the largest by case count. The Bundibugyo strain drives the current epicenter; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for this variant. Ongoing transmission unfolds amid insecurity, population displacement, and large movements, complicating containment efforts. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which killed over 11,000, as the number of infections rises faster than previous episodes. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described transmission in some locations as showing chains that remain unidentified, forecasting continued spread until all chains are found. The response is hampered by conflict, distrust of health workers, and information gaps in the public.

article.articleHeadline: Expanded Response Capacity Keeps WHO's Three-Month Ebola Control Scenario Alive
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) remains deadly, with 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths as of Aug 12, and transmission has expanded to 54 health zones by Aug 14, spanning six provinces and making this the deadliest Congo outbreak to date and second-deadliest worldwide behind 2014-16 West Africa. The WHO maintains a three-month control objective if response capacity and funding improve. About 400 additional treatment beds have been added in two weeks, and more epidemiologists are being deployed to strengthen contact tracing to interrupt transmission chains. However, the outlook is fragile: 70-80% of new cases have no known link to previous patients, signaling undetected chains; funding covers ~60% of the $115 million requirement. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, though candidates are being tested. Africa CDC estimates a $319 million six-month continental plan to support Congo, Uganda, and 10 other high-risk countries.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la résistance brisée dans certaines structures sanitaires et familles de Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Resistance broken in some healthcare facilities and families in Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of August 19, 2026, Ebola virus disease resistance has been broken in several health facilities and a household in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. At ART Polyclinic, 14 identified contacts were sensitized; the number of contacts at Rosange health center was not disclosed. In a household with a positive Ebola case and at Nehema health center that hosted a positive case, the mixed CREC-surveillance team conducted decontamination-focused awareness sessions to cleanse these premises. Ongoing resistance and misperceptions persist in Tshopo, with some residents doubting Ebola’s existence or alleging the outbreak is a business. The risk-communication for community engagement and surveillance teams coordinate to advance containment in the province.

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 5 000 cas d'Ebola recensés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: More than 5,000 Ebola cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded over 5,000 Ebola cases (5,021 confirmed) and 2,378 deaths in the ongoing outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo virus in northern and eastern regions. Africa CDC warns the outbreak is far from contained and has already surpassed the 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreak in three months (2,299 deaths among 3,381 cases). There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, though clinical trials are underway. The response has faced criticism for slowness and community resistance, including screening refusals that hinder surveillance and control efforts. WHO warns of a high risk of national and international spread, with responses being intensified and decentralized to reach communities, including motorcycle taxi drivers transporting patients. The European Union announced €2.5 million in diagnostic tests to support the effort.

article.articleHeadline: شیوع ابولا در کنگو هنوز یک وضعیت اضطراری بهداشتی در سطح جهانی است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a global public health emergency.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, according to WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. WHO’s latest assessment shows the outbreak has caused 2,325 deaths—the highest Ebola mortality recorded in the DRC—and over 5,000 confirmed cases, with a case fatality ratio of about 46%. The international community remains concerned, emphasizing coordinated action to curb transmission and reinforce public health responses.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak surpasses 5,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak surpasses 5,000 cases: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak has reached 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths as of 19 August 2026, according to Africa CDC. Declared May 15, the outbreak spreads across northern and eastern DRC amid weak health infrastructure and insecurity, complicating containment. The Bundibugyo virus strain is involved; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, with clinical trials underway. The previous worst outbreak (2018–2020) caused 2,299 deaths among 3,381 cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the epidemic remains far from under control and that national and international spread risk remains high. article.articleHeadline: На востоке ДР Конго на фоне вспышки Эболы почти удвоилась материнская смертность
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, maternal mortality nearly doubled amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) remains the deadliest in the nation’s history, with cumulative infections surpassing 5,000 and deaths over 2,300. The outbreak coincides with a surge in maternal mortality in the same region, where weekly maternal deaths rose from 3.1 to 5.8 between May 25 and July 19, according to UNFPA, as pregnant women avoid medical facilities over infection fears. Health workers in Bunia report many pregnant women missing routine antenatal visits, delaying detection of fetal problems and contributing to more complications, including stillbirths and preterm births. The difficulties in controlling transmission—late case detection, strained epidemiological surveillance—compound the public health burden. The report underscores the intertwined impact of Ebola on general health services and maternal outcomes in the eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部、エボラ流行の中で妊産婦死亡率がほぼ倍増
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ流行は同国史上最悪規模（感染5000人超、死者2300人超）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が明確に認められるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 本流行はDRC史上最悪のエボラ流行とされ、医療忌避による妊産婦死亡率の急増など二次的健康被害も報告されている。国境を越えた拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内で明示されていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Tubarão confirma 666 focos do mosquito da dengue na cidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tubarão Confirms 666 Dengue Mosquito Hotspots in the City.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, dengue in Tubarão, Brazil, remains under active control as epidemiological surveillance confirms 666 Aedes aegypti breeding hotspots citywide. In the latest bulletin, 128 dengue cases have been notified in Tubarão, including 9 autochthonous (locally transmitted) cases; 118 suspected cases have been discarded, and 1 remains under investigation. There are no imported (allochthonous) cases recorded. Hotspots are heavily concentrated in Centro (73), Humaitá de Cima (60), Revoredo (56), Vila Moema (53), and Oficinas (48), with additional activity in Humaitá, Recife, Dehon, and Morrotes. Control efforts combine Intradomiciliary Residual Spraying (BRI) and neighborhood spraying in high-incidence districts, plus doorstep visits to educate residents and eliminate standing water and other breeding sites. Community participation is essential to interrupt transmission and reduce future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: トゥバランで666件のデング熱媒介蚊の発生地点を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・トゥバランでのデング熱は地域レベルの通常監視報告であり、重症例や死亡の報告はないが、媒介蚊の繁殖地点が多数確認されており今後の拡大を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地方紙による定例のデング熱サーベイランス報告。128例（自国内感染9例）、死亡・重症例の記載なし。市当局による防除活動（残留噴霧・訪問啓発）が進行中で、現時点では管理可能な規模と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 5.000 casos de ébola confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses 5,000 confirmed Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) exceeds 5,000 confirmed cases as of August 17, with a 47.4% case fatality rate. About 782 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,091 have recovered; contact tracing is 84.1% effective. It is the second-worst outbreak by cases, behind the 2018–2020 RDC outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,481 cases), yet far from the 2014–2016 West Africa epicenter (11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). The epidemic is the fastest-growing since declaration; WHO maintains the public health emergency of international concern. Transmission began in eastern DRC (February; some analyses suggest January). Six provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Bas-Uélé (where the first death was confirmed last week). It spread to Uganda, which declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from the DRC) and two deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, with about 30–50% fatality and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal hemorrhaging.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定患者数が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、WHOがPHEICを維持している大規模エボラ流行であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。7月28日にウガンダはエボラ終息を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Bianca Andrade diz ter quase morrido por infecção: 'Bactéria danadona'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bianca Andrade says she almost died from an infection: 'Danadona bacterium'.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian influencer Bianca Andrade, known as Boca Rosa, was hospitalized for several days with a serious bacterial infection described as the Danadona bacterium. The infection began in the bladder and ascended to the kidney, creating the risk of spread to the bloodstream if untreated. Andrade said she would be discharged on Tuesday, August 18, 2026. The report notes that urinary tract infections can rise from the bladder to the kidneys and, if not treated, reach the bloodstream. No case counts or fatalities are provided, and there is no mention of a broader outbreak. The story emphasizes that rapid hospital care helped avert a worse outcome and underscores the dangers of untreated urinary infections and the importance of timely medical treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ビアンカ・アンドラーデ、感染症でほぼ死にかけたと語る:「凶悪な細菌」
triage.triage_reason: 個人の尿路感染症による入院事例であり、公衆衛生上の広がりや異常性は認められず、単発の個人健康問題として社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 著名人個人の尿路感染症（膀胱炎から腎臓への感染拡大）の入院事例であり、集団感染や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's itinerant gold miners complicate efforts to track and contain Ebola's spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province is driven by a fast-spreading Bundibugyo virus, with more than 2,300 deaths among over 5,000 cases. The surge complicates containment because hundreds of artisanal gold miners—many children, including an 11-year-old named Isaac Batisa—are highly mobile, traveling between villages and mining sites such as Iga-BarriEre. Officials say new infections and deaths are often reported among groups not monitored, and there is no reliable register of mine workers or tracking of movements. Although there are no known confirmed cases at mines yet, mobility hampers contact tracing and isolation. The sites lack basic protections—handwashing facilities and distancing—while many operate illegally. There are no specific treatments or vaccines. About two million people work in artisanal mining in Congo; UNICEF estimates 15% of children aged 5-17 are in child labor.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの移動性金採掘者たちがエボラの追跡・封じ込め努力を複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は5000例以上・死者2300人超と極めて高い致死率を示し、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 移動性の高い違法金採掘労働者（未登録・追跡不能）による接触追跡の困難さが強調されており、ワクチン・特効薬の不足も指摘されている。感染拡大リスクが高く、外部支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo supera los 5.000 casos y es el más mortal de su historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 5,000 cases and is the deadliest in its history.
article.articleSummary: 5,021 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,378 deaths reported by the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Health, marking the deadliest outbreak attributed to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare strain with no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; it is not airborne. Symptoms begin with fever, headache, and muscle pain, followed by vomiting and diarrhea, with possible internal or external bleeding. Infected individuals become contagious once symptomatic. Overall case-fatality rate is 47.4%, rising to about 70% in areas such as North Kivu. The outbreak began in late April in Bunia and was officially declared on May 15 in Mongbwalu. It has crossed borders to Uganda, where transmission has been controlled, and a doctor returning from Congo was reported in France. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, urging a coordinated response and advising against travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが5,000例を超え、史上最悪の致死的流行に
triage.triage_reason: 5,000例超・致死率47.4%（最大70%）のエボラ流行で、WHOがPHEICを宣言し国境を越えてウガンダ・フランスにも波及しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの伝播は制御済み、フランスは帰国医師の症例で発生国ではないため対象国リストに含まれず除外。ウガンダ・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。
