article.articleHeadline: इंदौर में मचा हड़कप, स्वाइन फ्लू से हुई महिला की मौत, स्वास्थ विभाग ने नहीं कराई परिवार की स्क्रीनिंग panic in indore woman dies of swine flu health department fails to scr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic in Indore as a woman dies of swine flu; health department fails to screen the family.
article.articleSummary: Indore, Madhya Pradesh reports the season’s first death from swine flu (Influenza A, 2009 H1N1). A 60-year-old woman, Saroj Nagar of Ujjain’s Rishi Nagar, died after treatment at Kokilaben Hospital in Indore; swabs from July 30 confirmed Influenza A and the 2009 H1N1 strain. Tests for Influenza B and SARS-CoV-2 were negative. Illness began July 31; confirmation came August 3, and she had been hospitalized for about 16 days before death. The family alleges lack of screening for close contacts; Anganwadi workers compiled a list of household members, but no tests were conducted and no contact tracing reported. Health authorities are gathering transmission and contact information, with central H1N1 management guidelines prompting early testing, treatment, and heightened surveillance during the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: インドールでパニック発生、女性が豚インフルエンザで死亡、保健当局は家族のスクリーニングを実施せず
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1インフルエンザによる単発死亡例であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、接触者追跡が未実施である点や監視強化が求められている点から続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(2009 H1N1)による単発死亡例。モンスーン期における通常の季節性流行の一部と考えられるが、接触者への検査未実施という行政対応の不備が報じられており、地域の対応状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Debinna Bonnerjee suffers from 103° Viral fever, says 'Take care Mumbaikars'
article.articleSummary: Mumbai actress Debina Bonnerjee reports a persistent viral fever peaking at 103°F, with symptoms including body ache, chills, blocked nose, cough, and loss of taste. In a 2026-08-19 social post, she says the fever recurs after treatment and that her daughter now exhibits similar symptoms, though she does not specify which daughter. She adds a public message, 'Take care, Mumbaikars.' The article provides no laboratory confirmation or identified infection source and does not mention broader outbreaks or containment measures. It centers on a personal health update and family experience, with Mumbai as the primary location referenced and no other diseases or locales emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: デビナ・ボネルジー、103度のウイルス性発熱に悩まされる「ムンバイ市民の皆さん、気をつけて」と発言
triage.triage_reason: 個人の芸能人の健康状態に関する記事であり、検査結果や感染源、集団発生の情報がなく、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての根拠が乏しい。
triage.notes: 有名人個人の体調報告であり、検査確定診断や集団感染の証拠なし。公衆衛生イベントとしての実体は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू मरीज मिलने के बाद आलमपुर गेरिया की बढ़ी निगरानी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monitoring in Alampur Geriya Increased After Dengue Patients Were Found
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, in Fatehpur district's Dhata Block, Alampur Geriya village reported a dengue patient, triggering intensified public health surveillance. Health teams are surveying potential larval habitats and advising residents on mosquito-borne disease prevention. District Malarial Officer Kirti Ranjan said the case indicates that dengue larvae may be present in surrounding areas, prompting ongoing surveillance. Field teams have been instructed to inspect water-logging sites around homes, including containers such as coolers, flower pots, drains, and other receptacles. The response aims to curb transmission through source reduction and community awareness. No broader outbreak details are provided, but authorities emphasize continued monitoring and surveys to rapidly detect additional cases and limit mosquito breeding in the area.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者発見後、アラムプル・ゲリヤ村の監視強化
triage.triage_reason: 単一村落における単発のデング熱患者確認に対する日常的な公衆衛生監視活動であり、広域的な流行やIHR基準に該当する重大性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方の保健当局による通常の媒介動物対策・監視活動の報道であり、季節性デング熱の一環と考えられる。他地域への拡大や重症例に関する情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolacentrum in Beni ontvangt eerste patiënt: 'Ze bleek zwanger te zijn: ik wist meteen dat het kind het niet gaat redden als het ebola is'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola center in Beni receives first patient: 'She turned out to be pregnant; I immediately knew the baby would not survive if it were Ebola'.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-19, the Ebola Center in Beni opened and received its first patient: a 23-year-old woman who is 20 weeks pregnant and arrived with severe shortness of breath. The clinical team immediately donned PPE and carried her from the ambulance, recognizing that the fetus would likely not survive if Ebola were confirmed. Soon after, additional patients appeared, including an 18-year-old man in triage who was frightened but cooperative; psychologists provide short welcome discussions for patients. A colleague named Marius and another staff member entered the highest contamination zone in PPE, sharing a rare moment of contact within safety rules. The team had trained together in Brussels and is now operating the center; the opening day had been delayed earlier. The article does not mention laboratory confirmation or exact case counts.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラセンターが最初の患者を受け入れ：『妊娠していることが分かった。もしエボラなら赤ちゃんは助からないとすぐに分かった』
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニのエボラ治療センターが開設され、疑い患者の受け入れが始まった。エボラは重篤で人道的・公衆衛生上のリスクが高く、過去の同地域での大規模流行歴からIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 患者はエボラ疑いであり、検査確定や症例数は記事内で明示されていない。ベニはDRCにおける過去のエボラ流行の中心地であり、続報の確認が必要。ブリュッセル・ベルギーはスタッフの訓練地であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Chilling Eye-Bleeding Virus Warning Issued
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, has surpassed 5,000 infections with a 47% case fatality rate. Congo's Ministry of Health data show 2,378 deaths since Sunday. The World Health Organization estimates the outbreak could spread more rapidly than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed about 11,000 people, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who warned the epidemic remains far from under control. Ongoing transmission is complicated by inadequate response capacity and dangerous living conditions in affected communities. Frontline health workers report mounting fatigue and stressed systems as containment efforts struggle, prompting renewed calls for serious management and resources to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 戦慄の「眼から出血するウイルス」警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で感染者5,000人超・致死率47%のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、WHOが2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を上回る拡大の可能性を警告しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリー内で言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: जौनपुर वालों के पीछे पड़ा ऐसा मच्छर, दिन में हमला ज्यादा, मुंह से फेंक देगा खून
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Such a mosquito is after the people of Jaunpur; attacks more during the day; will spit blood from its mouth.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk rises in Jaunpur during the monsoon as Aedes mosquitoes—active in daytime—spread dengue. Dr. Rishabh Yadav of DR Memorial Hospital notes dengue is a viral illness primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, which bite by day. Prevention focuses on eliminating breeding sites: remove standing water around homes, promptly discard water-collecting containers, and keep water pots covered; use mosquito nets and wear full-body clothing during daytime. Common symptoms include high fever and muscle and joint pains; red-flag signs include persistent vomiting (sometimes with blood), blood in urine or stool, and small red spots (petechiae) on the skin, with breathing difficulties requiring urgent care. Do not self-medicate with NSAIDs such as aceclofenac or diclofenac during dengue due to bleeding risk. The article emphasizes that daytime protection is essential and that hygiene and mosquito control remain the most effective preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ジャウンプルの人々を悩ませる蚊、日中に多く攻撃し、口から血を吐かせる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱予防に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な発生や重大な公衆衛生イベントを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性のデング熱に関する予防啓発記事で、具体的な患者数・アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo top 5,000: Africa health agency
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 5,000 cases, marking its 17th outbreak. Declared on May 15, the epidemic is believed to have been spreading for weeks. As of Aug 19, 2026, Africa CDC reports 5,021 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths. The northern and eastern regions, where state presence is weak and health infrastructure scarce, are hardest hit amid years of armed conflict. The Bundibugyo virus drives the surge; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though clinical trials are under way. The WHO has warned the epidemic remains far from controlled and the risk of further national or international spread remains high. Criticism targets slow and poorly organized response and mistrust in communities, with refusals of testing hampering surveillance. EU has allocated 2.5 million euros for testing kits, while WHO intensifies response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱感染者数が5,000人を超える：アフリカ保健機関
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例5,021人・死亡2,378人に達する大規模エボラ流行で、WHOが国内外への拡大リスクを警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによる第17回流行で、承認ワクチン・特効薬が存在しない点、武力紛争地域での医療インフラ脆弱性、地域社会の不信感による検査拒否が拡大要因として指摘されている。EUが検査キット費用2.5百万ユーロを支援、WHOが対応強化中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : fuir l'hôpital, mourir en couches -- le calvaire silencieux des femmes enceintes de Bunia - Cameroun24.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Flee the hospital, die in childbirth — the silent ordeal of Bunia's pregnant women.
article.articleSummary: Maternal deaths in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, rose from 3.1 to 5.8 per week between 25 May and 19 July 2026 amid the Ebola outbreak centered in Bunia. Pregnant women fear contracting Ebola at health facilities, leading many to skip prenatal care and present only after complications, resulting in preventable haemorrhage, pre-eclampsia, and prolonged labour. Bunia is the outbreak epicenter; several health facilities temporarily paused services to curb transmission, including Elikya Hospital, which was closed 21 days for staff quarantine and disinfection. Since reopening, clinicians urge expectant mothers not to delay care and to seek timely obstetric support, arguing that fear of Ebola can be deadlier than the virus itself. UNFPA data underpin the counts, highlighting indirect mortality from disrupted access to maternal health services in Ituri. The situation underscores the need to rebuild trust and maintain essential care during outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:病院から逃げ、出産で死ぬ ― ブニアの妊婦たちの静かな苦難
triage.triage_reason: 既知のイツリ州エボラアウトブレイクに関連し、妊産婦死亡率の上昇という新たな公衆衛生上の影響が報告されており、医療アクセス崩壊による間接的被害の拡大が懸念されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ流行そのものではなく、流行に伴う医療アクセス低下による妊産婦死亡増加（間接的影響）に焦点を当てている。UNFPAデータに基づく報告であり、既存アウトブレイクの継続的な影響評価として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia Ebola din Congo scapă de sub control. OMS avertizează asupra riscului de răspândire internațională
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control. The WHO warns of the risk of international spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains far from under control, with a high risk of national and international spread according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. By 19 August 2026, almost 5,000 people are infected and over 2,300 have died across six provinces and 55 health zones in the north and east, including Ituri. The 17th DRC Ebola outbreak began with a declaration on 15 May, and the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. It is the second-largest Ebola epidemic ever, progressing faster than prior outbreaks; comparisons reference 2018–2020 (2,299 deaths of 3,381 cases) and 2014–2016 West Africa (over 11,300 deaths). Transmission via bodily fluids, with initial symptoms such as fever and headache, complicates recognition. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; trials are ongoing. Response faces insecurity, population movement, vandalized ambulances, and a wounded nurse; EU provides 2.5 million euros for testing, while WHO emphasizes intensified, decentralized measures, including motorcycle taxis for patient transport.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が制御不能に。WHOが国際的拡大リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し国際的拡大リスクを警告する大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、既に第17次DRCエボラ流行として史上2番目の規模。治安不安・人口移動・医療体制への攻撃等が対応を複雑化。フルRRAへ進めるべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: No unsafe water sample found in Nanded rail division, says South Central Railway after CAG report flags bacterial contamination in water
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, South Central Railway’s Nanded division said all drinking water samples across 80 stations met safety standards, countering a CAG report that flagged E. coli and coliforms in railway water nationwide. Over seven months, 1,029 water samples were analyzed bacteriologically, 22,365 for residual chlorine, and 112 chemically, with none unsatisfactory. A nine-inspector health team, deployed across stations and colonies under the railway medical department, conducts routine water quality and food hygiene checks as part of ongoing surveillance. Following the CAG findings, the division has tightened monitoring: regular sampling schedules, timely lab dispatch, and intensified drinking-water and food quality surveillance at railway premises. Additionally, canteen, pantry car, catering unit and raw-material samples, including packed foods, are periodically tested and sent to accredited laboratories.

triage.headline_ja: ナンデッド鉄道管区で安全基準を満たさない水サンプルは検出されず、南中央鉄道がCAG報告書の細菌汚染指摘に反論
triage.triage_reason: CAG報告書が指摘した水質汚染について、鉄道当局が独自検査で汚染なしと反論した内容であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の懸念は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Rentrée scolaire: les établissements de Bunia renforcent les mesures barrières contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back to School: Bunia's Schools Strengthen Barrier Measures Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 19 August 2026, Ebola prevention measures have been strengthened in Bunia, the Ituri capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as schools prepare for 2026-2027. Daily classroom disinfection, mandatory handwashing, and temperature checks on arrival and after recess are planned, with each pupil possessing personal hand sanitizer. Class sizes will be reduced to promote physical distancing and limit transmission. At the Nelson Mandela 1 Complex, the prevention suite includes handwashing and temperature checks, and a borehole is being drilled to secure handwashing water independent of Regideso. The maximum class size is 35 students, with individual materials and no shared items. Recesses will be organized by level to minimize movement. In orange zones, classes continue with strengthened hygiene and kits; red zones will use distance learning, already in force since February 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期開始:ブニアの学校がエボラ対策の防疫措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアでの既存エボラ流行に対する学校の予防措置強化に関する記事であり、新規感染者数や流行拡大の具体的情報がなく、既知のアウトブレイクへの対応の一環と見られるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行下における学校の防疫対策強化に焦点を当てており、レッドゾーンでは2025年2月から遠隔学習が既に実施されている旨の記述から、既知の継続的アウトブレイクであることが示唆される。新規感染者数や地理的拡大等の詳細情報がないため、フルRRAへの移行は現時点では見送り、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: CIDSCON 2026: 950+ infectious disease experts gather in Gujarat
article.articleSummary: CIDSCON 2026 brings 950+ infectious disease experts to Gandhinagar, Gujarat, Aug 20–23, at the Mahatma Mandir Convention Centre. Inaugurated by Health Minister Praful Pansheriya, the four-day conference focuses on antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and antimicrobial stewardship (AMS), with workshops on AI in clinical practice, infection control, and diagnostics. The main program covers AMR, tropical infections, tuberculosis, HIV, fungal infections, virology, and infections in immunocompromised patients, alongside emerging technologies such as next-generation sequencing, phage therapy, and AI-enabled practice. A special Aug 22 session highlights Gujarat’s AMR containment efforts, including GUJSAR-N, antimicrobial stewardship monitoring, and lab-data-based surveillance via an AMR dashboard. International faculty from the United States and Singapore join national experts. Activities include challenging case discussions, poster rounds, postgraduate sessions, and a valedictory on Aug 23; a book on AMR and AMS will be released at the opening.

triage.headline_ja: CIDSCON 2026：950人以上の感染症専門家がグジャラート州に集結
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の学術会議に関する記事であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ICN highlights nurses' response to conflicts and disease outbreaks
article.articleSummary: ICN highlights nurses’ response to conflicts, disasters and disease outbreaks through its #NursesforPeace initiative, on World Humanitarian Day. A new impact bulletin notes Ebola infection prevention training in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, safe insulin administration for children in South Sudan, and nursing leadership development in Ukraine. Since its 2022 launch amid the Ukraine war, #NursesforPeace now operates in 13 countries and territories, delivering emergency assistance, training, equipment, medical supplies, mental health and psychosocial support, and leadership development. ICN president Dr José Luis Cobos Serrano emphasizes paying and protecting nurses, as the council calls for action to end attacks on health workers and facilities. Intensive care nurse Karen Ruts discussed Bundibugyo Ebola response work in the DRC and Uganda. Safeguarding Health in Conflict Coalition reports 2,546 attacks on health care in 2025, with 455 health workers killed.

triage.headline_ja: ICN、紛争や感染症流行への看護師の対応を強調
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は看護師の人道支援団体(ICN)の活動紹介であり、エボラは過去の予防訓練の文脈で言及されているに過ぎず、新規の感染症発生報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はICNの人道支援活動（#NursesforPeace）に関する内容で、DRCでのエボラ感染予防訓練は過去の支援活動の一例として言及されているのみ。新規のアウトブレイク発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: حصيلة وباء إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | Masrawy
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 5,000 confirmed infections, with 2,378 deaths (case fatality about 47.4%, reaching ~70% in North Kivu). Six eastern provinces are affected amid ongoing conflict and mass displacement, hindering health services. The World Health Organization states the situation remains a public health emergency of international concern with a high risk of spread to additional regional countries. Authorities say the outbreak began spreading from the mining town of Mongbalo in early February, months before its formal recognition on May 15. The current outbreak is spreading roughly three times faster than the deadliest prior epidemics, underscoring substantial containment challenges in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数が発表される
triage.triage_reason: 感染者5,000人超・死亡2,378人・致死率約47%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHOがPHEICとして継続中と表明し国際的拡大リスクも高いため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC継続を表明し、拡大速度が過去の主要流行の約3倍とされる点、紛争・大規模避難民により対応が困難な点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la mobilité, un casse-tête pour la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Mobility, a headache for the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where population mobility is a major obstacle to outbreak control. In Ituri and North Kivu, daily movement of traders and residents—centered on Mungbwalu, a mining hub that draws people from Nord-Kivu and beyond—drives transmission and hampers case tracing. Medair warns that suspected and confirmed Ebola patients have vanished from surveillance as they travel between Ituri and North Kivu, illustrating the difficulty of following exposed individuals. Movement also extends to Haut-Uele and Kisangani, underscoring the complexity of routes used by people seeking livelihoods amid the outbreak. Experts call for reinforced screening at key entry points of large towns, such as Bunia to Beni, though many routes bypass main roads. No laboratory-confirmed case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：人の移動がエボラ対策の課題に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、人口移動により症例追跡が困難となっている。IHR基準複数（重大性・異常性）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はIturi・North Kivu・Haut-Uele・Kisangani間の人の移動がエボラ症例の追跡を妨げていることを報告。確定症例数の記載はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する明確な言及はないため『不明』とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 5 mil casos de ebola registrados na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 5,000 Ebola cases recorded in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: More than 5,000 Ebola virus disease cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of August 19, 2026, per Africa CDC. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, centered in northern and eastern regions where state presence is fragile, health infrastructure weak, and case surges overwhelmed the response. The outbreak is far from controlled, with a high risk of international spread highlighted by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Current figures show 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths. In just three months, the death toll has surpassed the 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,381 cases). Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; the disease has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past 50 years. The article notes unprecedented pace and record mortality for the country.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱の症例が5,000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行（5,021症例、2,378死亡）でIHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WHOも国際拡大リスクを指摘しているためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が過去の2018-2020年東部DRC流行を上回るペースであり、脆弱な保健インフラと国家統治力の低さが対応を困難にしている。WHOが国際的拡大リスクを明言している点は特に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says DRC Ebola outbreak remains far from control
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak remains far from control, with nearly 5,000 infected and over 2,300 deaths across six provinces and 55 health zones. The World Health Organization flags it as the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, with spread fueled by insecurity, displacement, and intense population movement along roads, rivers, and mining routes. Many deaths occur at home or in communities outside treatment centres and on known contact lists, signaling unidentified transmission chains that must be traced to end the epidemic. A Public Health Emergency of International Concern was declared three months ago; international spread risk remains high, including a traveller who carried the virus to France. Uganda has stopped transmission after a spillover. The response emphasizes intensified surveillance, safe burials, community engagement, and clinical trials under DRC leadership. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in human trials; one shows cross-protection in animals; the PARTNERS trial enrolled 100 patients, with calls for faster data sharing, financing, security, and regional coordination while preserving essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ出血熱流行は依然として制御下にないと発表
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC宣言済みで死者2,300人超、フランスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準複数該当、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは伝播が停止したと記載されているため主要発生国から除外。フランスは輸入例で対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo outpaces efforts to contain it
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 5,000 confirmed cases and about 2,500 deaths. The rapidly spreading crisis is outpacing containment measures, with authorities reporting growing fear and mistrust among communities, including attacks on health workers and ambulances. There is currently no approved vaccine for this strain, leaving isolation and intensive supportive care as the primary tools to curb transmission. Response efforts are hampered by security and community resistance, while aid groups warn the outbreak is moving faster than prior Ebola crises. Experts fear potential cross-border transmission to neighboring countries, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance, safe isolation, and public health messaging to restore trust and protect responders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、対策の努力を上回るペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が発生し、5000人超の確定例、約2500人の死亡が報告されており、承認済みワクチンがなく国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認の株（ブンディブギョ株）による流行で、致死率が高く（約50%）、医療従事者への攻撃や地域社会の不信感が対応を妨げているため、国際的な支援と監視強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo top 5,000: Africa health agency
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak reaches over 5,000 cases, the Africa Union’s health agency said, marking the country’s 17th outbreak and its worst in history. Declared on May 15, the outbreak has likely been spreading for weeks in regions in the north and east where state oversight is weak and health infrastructure is scarce amid widespread armed-group activity. As of 19 August 2026, Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention reports 5,021 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths. A 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC caused 2,299 deaths among 3,381 confirmed cases, illustrating the current surge’s gravity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the epidemic remains far from under control and that the risk of further national and international spread remains high.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ感染者数が5,000人を超える：アフリカ保健機関
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（5,021人感染・2,378人死亡）が進行中で、WHOも国際的拡大リスクを警告しているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率約47%と極めて高く、17回目のアウトブレイクかつ史上最悪規模。武装勢力の活動により保健インフラが脆弱な地域での拡大が続いており、WHO事務局長も国内外への拡大リスクを警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола в ДР Конго: Потвърдените случаи надхвърлиха 5000, жертвите са близо 2400
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: The confirmed cases surpassed 5,000, the deaths are nearly 2,400.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpasses 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths since mid-May, spanning 55 health zones across six provinces: Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Lower Uele, and Chopo. Ituri remains the epicenter with ongoing transmission. Authorities have launched a public-information campaign to counter rumors and strengthen consistent communication to prevent further spread. To deter spread toward Kinshasa, surveillance along the Congo River basin has been intensified about 65 kilometers (40 miles) from Kinshasa, with a health post monitoring boats from affected areas, per Health Minister Samuel R. Kamba. The World Health Organization previously stated the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This represents the deadliest ongoing outbreak in the country to date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DR コンゴで拡大：確定患者5,000人超、死者は2,400人近くに
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ出血熱がPHEICとされ、確定患者5,000人超・死者2,400人近くと重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEIC継続中とされ、キンシャサへの拡大防止のためコンゴ川流域での監視強化が実施されている。同国史上最も死亡者数の多い流行とされる。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat's effective efforts against mosquito-borne diseases, a 45% reduction in malaria and a 39% reduction in dengue | ????? ?? ???? ???? ????????? ?? ????? ?????? ?? ?????? ???, ??????? ??? 45 ?? ????? ??? 39 ??????? ?? ???.
article.articleSummary: Gujarat reports sharp declines in malaria, dengue, and chikungunya through expanded surveillance, diagnostics, treatment, and vector control. By week 33 of 2026, malaria cases fell 45.0% (1,407 → 774), dengue 39.1% (1,293 → 788), and chikungunya 48.1% (154 → 80), with no deaths from malaria or dengue in this period. Testing exceeded 1.11 crore blood samples in 2026 (vs 1.09 crore in 2025 to week 33); dengue and chikungunya serology surpassed 83,000 and 12,000 tests across 42 diagnostic centers linked to medical colleges. Door-to-door surveillance achieved 89% coverage in Phase 1 (April 27–May 6) and Phase 2 (July 1–10) mobilized 19,558 teams to cover over 6.51 crore people, yielding 257,000+ samples and 28 malaria cases treated. Vector control included spraying in 24 districts (116 villages), 497 teams, ~2.96 million breeding-site removals, 3.21 lakh houses fogged, and larvivorous fish in 5,024 water bodies. Stockpiles and ongoing monitoring maintained.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介性疾患に対するグジャラート州の効果的な取り組み、マラリアが45%、デングが39%減少
triage.triage_reason: 記事はマラリア・デング・チクングニヤの症例数が大幅に減少したという成功報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新たな脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の減少・対策成功を報告する内容であり、シグナルとして識別する必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the outbreak of a rare kind of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo virus Ebola in Congo (Ituri province, centered in Bunia and Mongbwalu) has reached 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths as of Sunday, making it the largest Bundibugyo outbreak and the deadliest Ebola event in Congo’s history. WHO warns it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak if transmission continues. Bundibugyo virus is rarer than Ebola Zaire; there is no approved vaccine or treatment, with care focused on supportive measures. The first symptomatic case surfaced in late April, with death in Bunia; Congo declared the outbreak on May 15. Most cases are in Ituri, with spread to other areas; Uganda reported a cross-border case (transmission later stopped), and a June case occurred in France in a doctor returning from Congo. Overall case fatality is about 47.4%, higher in North Kivu (≈70%); 60–70% of new cases are detected among unmonitored contacts. Transmission requires contact with infected blood or bodily fluids, not airborne, and diagnosis relies on laboratory testing.

triage.headline_ja: まれな種類のエボラ出血熱の流行について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が5,021例・死亡2,378例に達し、史上最大規模かつ最も致死的なエボラ流行となっており、国境を越えた感染例（ウガンダ、フランス）も報告されているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびフランスでの症例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは西アフリカ2014-2016流行を超える可能性を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: " Si on abandonne les malades, qui s'en occupera ? " : au Congo, avec les femmes en première ligne contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If we abandon the sick, who will take care of them? In Congo, with women on the front line against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease persists in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with fatalities continuing at high levels as of August 2026. A video report notes that the virus remains exceptionally deadly in the region. Women are portrayed as bearing the brunt, reflecting their prominent frontline roles in care and community response within Congolese society. Despite their critical work, the piece argues that this reality has not translated into targeted public health policy or protective measures for women. The report emphasizes the absence of focused interventions to address gender-specific vulnerabilities, even as health workers and family caregivers confront ongoing transmission, stigma, and loss. No specific case or death counts are provided in the excerpt, and there is no discussion of lab confirmation or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: 「病人を見捨てたら、誰が世話をするのか？」コンゴにて、エボラと闘う女性たちが最前線に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の感染・死亡が継続しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）が複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は医療従事者・家族介護者、特に女性へのケア負担とジェンダー特化した公衆衛生政策の欠如に焦点を当てており、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数、感染源、検査確定状況は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 新皇崗口岸舉行跨部門公共衞生演習 強化高傳染病旅客應對流程 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Huanggang Port Holds Inter-Departmental Public Health Drill to Strengthen Response Procedures for Travellers with Highly Contagious Diseases
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-19, Hong Kong's new Huanggang Port port area conducted a large inter-departmental public health drill to strengthen response to travellers with highly contagious diseases. Agencies involved included the Department of Health, Fire Services Department, Immigration Department, Customs, and the Government Property Agency. The exercise simulated a traveller detected with fever by a collective infrared thermal-imaging system; upon re-checking, fever was confirmed and the person was moved to a negative-pressure isolation facility for a detailed infectious-disease risk assessment. Because a highly contagious infection was suspected, Health Department staff immediately notified Fire Services to transfer the individual to a hospital for further testing. Director of Health Dr. Lam Man-kin emphasized ongoing testing of the infrared system, quarantine facilities, patient transfer, and information-collection mechanisms to refine controls and keep cross-border operations at the southern gateway efficient and safe.

triage.headline_ja: 新皇崗口岸で部門連携の公衆衛生演習実施、高感染性疾患を持つ旅行者への対応手順を強化
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生ではなく、感染症対応能力を確認するための訓練（演習）に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の実害や異常事態は発生していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、香港の新皇崗口岸における公衆衛生対応能力強化のための模擬演習報道である。疾病名も「Unknown Illness」として分類されているが、実際の患者・症例情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: The Guardian view on the Ebola outbreak in the DRC: a case study in why international aid matters
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached at least 2,325 deaths, the deadliest of the country’s 17 outbreaks and the fastest-growing in history. The Bundibugyo strain has no effective vaccine and has spread amid armed conflict, mass displacement, and insecurity that hamper surveillance. Treatment centers have been attacked amid misinformation and distrust. The piece blames Western aid cuts for weakening health infrastructure, citing the dismantling of USAID and the U.S. withdrawal from WHO, with Britain, Germany and France cutting aid too. It contrasts this with Obama’s 2014 mobilization to fund contact tracing and vaccination programs. UK aid is set to fall from 0.5% to 0.3% of GDP from 2027. The Guardian calls for belated global mobilisation and lessons on why international aid matters.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 5,021, Africa CDC says
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths, attributed to the Bundibugyo virus strain. Declared May 15, this is the Democratic Republic of Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak and the deadliest by confirmed cases to date. Affected regions are in the north and east, where limited state presence, weak health infrastructure, and armed-group activity hinder containment. Africa CDC reports ongoing transmission with refusals to test and community mistrust complicating surveillance and control efforts. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; clinical trials are ongoing. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the epidemic remains far from under control and the risk of national and international spread remains high. The previous deadliest outbreak (2018–2020) had 3,381 cases and 2,299 deaths. The EU has provided €2.5 million (about $2.9 million) in testing kits to support response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が5,021人に増加、アフリカCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最多の感染者・死者数を記録するエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）が継続中で、WHO事務局長も国内的・国際的拡大リスクを警告しており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行で、検査拒否やコミュニティの不信感が制御を困難にしている。EUが検査キット提供による支援を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: 40 students hospitalised after lunch in Himachal's Kullu, water contamination suspected - India TV News
article.articleSummary: On 19 August 2026, about 40 students at Government Primary School Bari in Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh, fell ill after lunch, with water contamination suspected as the cause. Roughly 13 children remain under treatment, seven have been referred to Civil Hospital in Kullu, and 20 have been discharged. A hospital visit by Chief Medical Officer Dr Ranjeet Thakur and the local MLA Bhuveneshwar Gaur occurred as the situation unfolded. A probe panel headed by Manali Sub-divisional Magistrate has been formed to determine the circumstances leading to the incident. Health and Jal Shakti departments have collected water samples from the source to test for contamination and confirm the infection source. The incident underscores concerns about school water safety and prompt medical response to potential waterborne exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマチャル州クルーで昼食後に児童40人が入院、水質汚染の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単一校での局所的な水質汚染疑いの集団発症であり、病原体・国際的拡大の情報はないが、続報（水質検査結果）を要するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未特定（水質汚染が疑われる食中毒様事案）。地方当局が調査中で、感染症としての国際的関心は低い。

article.articleHeadline: صحة قنا تنظم دورة تدريبية لرفع كفاءة فنيي المعامل في تشخيص البلهارسيا (صور)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Qena Health Directorate organizes a training course to enhance the capabilities of laboratory technicians in diagnosing schistosomiasis (photos).
article.articleSummary: Schistosomiasis training course in Qena, Egypt, trained 17 laboratory technicians from Nag Hammadi, Qous, and Nagda health administrations to enhance diagnostic skills for analyzing urine and stool samples, counting eggs, and distinguishing helminth eggs to enable accurate laboratory diagnosis. Organized under Dr. Essam Nabil Mohammed, with oversight by Dr. Magid Rimon and Dr. Abdul Rahman Mohammed of the Schistosomiasis Department, the program covered life cycles of the parasite's larval forms, standard methods for analyzing urine and stool, and proper sample collection, handling, and infection-control procedures to ensure precise results. Participants learned data recording and the importance of promptly notifying suspected cases to support surveillance, plus integration with schistosomiasis teams and healthcare units for ongoing detection and follow-up. The course aligns with Egypt's national plan to eliminate schistosomiasis and maintain a disease-free status.

triage.headline_ja: ケナ保健局、住血吸虫症診断のための検査技師能力向上トレーニングコースを開催（写真）
triage.triage_reason: エジプト・ケナ県での住血吸虫症診断技術に関する研修活動の報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の発生を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はエジプト（対象国リスト外）における住血吸虫症の検査技師向け研修活動を報じたもので、疾病発生や流行を示すものではない。発生地域にIndiaが含まれるが、記事本文はエジプト・ケナ県の内容のみでインドについての記述はないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: Health Dept issues warning on dengue in Chandigarh - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Chandigarh Union Territory's Health Department warned of an elevated risk of vector-borne diseases, especially dengue, amid frequent rain and waterlogging. Accumulation and stagnation of rainwater in man-made and natural sources near homes create ideal breeding grounds for mosquitoes, potentially accelerating transmission. So far in 2026, Chandigarh has reported 10 swine flu and 3 dengue cases. The advisory urged residents to curb mosquito breeding by removing standing water after every rainfall, covering all water-storage containers, and cleaning and drying desert coolers and other water-holding appliances at least once a week. Suman Singh, Director of Health Services, UT, noted that while numbers are relatively low, current conditions could worsen spread without preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局がチャンディーガルでデング熱に関する警告を発令 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の雨季に伴う蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・豚インフルエンザ）への予防的注意喚起であり、症例数も少なく（デング3例、豚インフル10例）、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年の雨季に伴う蚊媒介感染症への通常の予防的注意喚起であり、症例数も低水準。地域の保健当局による定例的な公衆衛生アドバイザリーと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Controle da estreptococose exige mais que vacinação na produção de tilápias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcosis control requires more than vaccination in tilapia production.
article.articleSummary: 520 tilapia vaccinated survey shows low detection of Streptococcus agalactiae serotype Ib, yet outcomes hinge on diagnosis, water quality, stress, and matching vaccine to serotype. In Western Paraná, S. agalactiae Ib is a major mortality driver, linked to septicemia and meningioencephalitis. Affected fish exhibit anorexia, lethargy, darkening, corneal opacity, exophthalmia, ascites, and disoriented or circular swimming; internal inflammation of heart and brain explains erratic movement and eye protrusion. Survivors may harbor lesions affecting processing quality. High disease recurrence after treatment complicates production. Francisella orientalis becomes more relevant in colder water (<24°C), reducing metabolism and feed intake and challenging oral treatments. Serotype Ib remains widely disseminated in the country; serotype III has re-emerged in the Southeast, including Triângulo Mineiro. Vaccination should be integrated with diagnostic effort, water quality management, and a sanitation calendar guided by water temperature, as discussed at SIMPOP in Toledo, Paraná.

triage.headline_ja: ティラピア養殖におけるレンサ球菌症対策にはワクチン接種以上の対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは魚類（ティラピア）養殖における動物疾病であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響が示唆されておらず、IHR・WPRO基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 対象はティラピア（魚類）のStreptococcus agalactiae感染症であり、動物衛生・水産養殖分野の話題でヒト感染症ではない。人獣共通感染症としての言及もないため公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ заявили о высоком риске дальнейшего распространения лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO says there is a high risk of further spread of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled with high risk of further spread domestically and internationally, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Three months after the outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, about 5,000 people have been infected across six provinces and 55 health zones, with more than 2,300 deaths. The epidemic is the second-largest in history and spreading at an unprecedented pace, driven by instability, population movement, and extensive travel along roads, rivers, and mining routes. Ghebreyesus cautioned that many deaths occur at home or in communities outside treatment centers among people not listed as contacts. Until transmission chains are identified and broken, the outbreak will continue to pose a long-lasting public health challenge.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱のさらなる拡大リスクが高いと発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行(感染約5000人、死者2300人超)で、国内外への拡大リスクが高いと明言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みの大規模流行であり、フルリスク評価（RRA）継続対象として明確にPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din RD Congo este departe de a ținută sub control, avertizează șeful OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the DRC is far from being under control, warns the WHO chief.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains uncontrolled, warns WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Three months after declaring the Bundibugyo virus outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, the crisis has spread rapidly. About 5,000 people have been infected and over 2,300 have died across six provinces and 55 health zones. The northern and eastern regions—where authorities are fragile and health infrastructure is inadequate—remain overwhelmed as case numbers rise. The WHO Emergency Committee has convened for the second time since the May 17 PHEIC declaration; it is unclear when its recommendations will be issued, though a lifting of the alert seems unlikely. Current risk levels: very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and other nearby countries, and low for the rest of Africa and the world.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は制御下にはほど遠い、とWHO事務局長が警告
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC対象のエボラ流行で感染者約5000人・死者2300人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、WHOも制御不能と警告しているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ等周辺国はリスク評価対象として言及されているが、記事本文では実際の発生国はDRCのみと確認される。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DOH monitors possible rise in leptospirosis cases amid widespread flooding
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises after widespread flooding in Metro Manila and other parts of the Philippines, prompting the Department of Health to raise Code White Alert and monitor potential case increases. Code White Alert signals hospital readiness across specialties, including general and orthopedic surgeons, anesthesiologists, internists, operating room nurses, and ophthalmologists and otorhinolaryngologists to respond to emergencies at any time. Presidential Communications Office Undersecretary Claire Castro said DOH is coordinating with the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council under President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s directive. Health facilities remain operational with adequate supplies to respond to health emergencies. The DOH notes sufficient medicine stocks for hospitals and local governments, with the Central Office holding about 3.1 million doxycycline capsules on standby and 17 CHDs reporting adequate supplies."

triage.headline_ja: DOH、広範な洪水の中でレプトスピラ症患者の増加可能性を監視
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症リスク増加に対する政府の警戒・準備態勢が報じられているが、実際の患者数増加や重症例の具体的データはなく、続報を注視する段階と判断される。
triage.notes: 洪水によるレプトスピラ症の季節的・環境要因によるリスク増加であり、フィリピン国内で毎年発生する既知の疾病パターン。政府は十分な医薬品供給と病院の準備態勢を確保しており、現時点で管理可能とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : les leaders communautaires sensibilisés à la prévention d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Community leaders sensitized to Ebola prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 19 August 2026, in Lubero Health Zone, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, community leaders were sensitized to Ebola prevention and response. Led by Dr. Charles Kambale Kaviri, the Medical Chief, the session aimed to inform leaders about the disease’s existence and involve them in the outbreak response. Authorities stressed that Ebola is deadly and requires collective action from the population and health workers, urging strict adherence to standard protective measures and outbreak-specific precautions for suspected cases. The program seeks to make leaders effective relay points to promote preventive behaviors, strengthen vigilance, and help stop the spread of Ebola within Lubero’s health zone.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:コミュニティリーダーがエボラ予防について啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ルベロ保健地域において進行中のエボラアウトブレイク対応活動（疑い例への言及あり）が確認され、IHR基準で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発セッションの報告だが、「outbreak response」「suspected cases」という表現から、当該地域で既にエボラのアウトブレイクが進行中であることが示唆される。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・症例数等の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vacinação chega ao Shopping Granja Vianna neste sábado com doses contra sarampo e influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination arrives at Shopping Granja Vianna this Saturday with doses against measles and influenza.
article.articleSummary: Shopping Granja Vianna in Cotia hosts Day D of the National Multivaccination Campaign on Saturday, August 22, offering free measles and influenza vaccines and vaccination record updates to improve access. At Shopping Granja Vianna (Rodovia Raposo Tavares, km 23.5, Loja Social, Piso L1), service runs 9:00–17:00 for individuals 6 months to 59 years, who must bring their vaccination booklet, ID, CPF, and SUS card. Four nearby Basic Health Units (UBSs) – Atalaia, Caucaia, Portão, and Assa – also provide vaccination 9:00–16:00. About 20 vaccines from the National Immunization Program will be available, including poliomyelitis, rotavirus, meningitis, influenza, COVID-19, yellow fever, measles, mumps, rubella, varicella, hepatitis A and B, and HPV. Measles vaccination is offered regardless of prior history during Day D. Cotia has had no measles cases since Nov 2020; as of 2026, no confirmed or suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 8月22日（土）、ショッピング・グランジャ・ヴィアナで麻疹・インフルエンザワクチン接種を含む予防接種デーが開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの案内であり、実際の感染症発生や流行を示す内容ではない。Cotiaでは2020年以降麻疹症例なく、現時点で確認・疑い例もない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの広報であり、疾病発生イベントではないため対象国リストに該当する感染症発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: India News | CIDSCON 2026 to Bring Infectious Disease Experts to Gandhinagar from August 20 to 23
article.articleSummary: CIDSCON 2026, the 16th Annual Conference of the Clinical Infectious Diseases Society, will be held in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, at the Mahatma Mandir Convention and Exhibition Centre from August 20–23, 2026. Health Minister Prafull Pansheriya will inaugurate the event and unveil a book on AMR and AMS by an eminent Infectious Diseases Specialist. Over 950 delegates from India and abroad, including the United States and Singapore, will participate. The four-day program opens with workshops on ID basics, diagnostics and infection control, immunocompromised ID, AI in ID practice, and surgical-ID issues, with hands-on learning. The main program covers antimicrobial resistance, tropical infections, tuberculosis, HIV, fungal infections, virology, infection control, stewardship, and infections in immunocompromised patients, alongside next-generation sequencing, phage therapy, and AI-enabled practice. A special August 22 session focuses on strengthening Gujarat AMR containment via GUJSAR-N and an AMR dashboard; the conference concludes August 23 with a valedictory.

triage.headline_ja: インド:CIDSCON 2026、8月20日から23日までガンディナガルに感染症専門家が集結
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは学術会議に関する告知であり、実際の疾病発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報ではないため、トリアージ対象とはならない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術会議（CIDSCON 2026）の開催案内であり、結核・HIV等の疾患は会議テーマとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生・流行を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les alertes communautaires non prises en compte alimentent la frustration (Société civile) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Community alerts not taken into account, fueling frustration (Civil Society) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, Ebola outbreaks in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, are hampered by community alerts not being acted upon, fueling public frustration and distrust. In Bunia, Dieudonné Lossa, provincial coordinator of civil society in Ituri, said residents who alerted authorities sometimes received no response, with some cases resulting in deaths before aid arrived. He warned that unaddressed alerts may erode confidence in the Ebola response and deepen rejection of intervention teams. Lossa urged stronger community-based surveillance and quicker, more accountable responses to alerts, arguing that trust between communities and the response teams is a critical factor in controlling Ebola virus disease in the region.

triage.headline_ja: イチュリ州のエボラ出血熱：地域からの警告が無視され、住民の不満が高まる（市民社会）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイチュリ州でエボラ出血熱の発生が継続中であり、地域コミュニティからの警告が対応されず死亡例も発生していることから、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ発生に対する地域コミュニティの対応不備・不信感を主題としており、新規発生の詳細（患者数・死亡者数等）は明記されていない。既知のアウトブレイクの継続状況として要監視だが、対応体制の不備と死亡例発生の報告があるためPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 【禁聞】中國疫情升溫 殯葬業者爆遺體接送量翻倍 | 新冠疫情 | 南海 | 羚羊礁
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Censored News: China's COVID-19 outbreak heats up; funeral industry operators report corpse-transport volume has doubled | COVID-19 pandemic | South China Sea | Antelope Reef
article.articleSummary: As of July 2026, China reports 522,000 newly diagnosed COVID-19 infections nationwide, up 5.6-fold from June, with 487 severe cases and 1 death officially recorded. A Hebei health commission staffer says the national figure reflects hospital-presentations only, and true infections are higher as many do not seek hospital care. Hospitals are described as overwhelmed and cremation queues growing across regions. In the funeral industry, a Dalian company reports daily corpse transports doubling from about 7–8 to as many as 30, signaling intensified transmission risk for mortuary workers and rising illness among frontline staff. The report highlights a sharp domestic wave of COVID-19 and strain on health services and related sectors, with limited official disclosure on overall mortality and community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 【禁聞】中国の疫情が過熱、葬儀業者が遺体搬送量倍増を訴え | 新型コロナウイルス感染症 | 南海 | 羚羊礁
triage.triage_reason: 中国国内で新型コロナ新規診断数が前月比5.6倍(52.2万人)に急増し、病院の逼迫や葬儀業者の遺体搬送量倍増が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と情報開示の不透明さ（異常性）が同時に確認されるためフルリスク評価への移行が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は新唐人テレビ（NTDTV、法輪功系メディア）による報道であり、政府公式発表よりも葬儀業者や河北省衛生当局職員の証言に基づく内容が中心。公式死亡者数(1名)と重症者数(487名)に対し、感染規模(52.2万人、前月比5.6倍)や遺体搬送量倍増との整合性に疑問があり、実際の感染・死亡規模は過小報告の可能性が指摘されている。情報の独立した裏付けが確認できないため、続報や他ソースでの検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo: Über 5.000 Infizierte gemeldet | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Over 5,000 infected reported | Heute.at
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,021 confirmed infections and 2,378 deaths, per Africa CDC on August 19, 2026, making it the worst in the country’s history. The epidemic spans multiple northern and eastern provinces where health systems are severely strained by ongoing conflict. It is driven by the Bundibugyo virus strain; there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, though clinical trials involve a vaccine intended for another variant. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak remains far from under control, with a high risk of wider national and international spread. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with body fluids, and patients typically experience fever, muscle pain, diarrhea, internal bleeding, and potentially organ failure. Over the last 50 years in Africa, more than 15,000 people have died from Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱流行：感染者5,000人超と報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率が高く国際的拡大リスクもWHOが警告しているため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が国際的拡大リスクを警告しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認、紛争による医療体制の脆弱性も懸念材料。致死率約47%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго от Эболы умерли 2 420 человек, летальность достигла 47,4%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 2,420 people died from Ebola; the fatality rate reached 47.4%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths (case fatality rate 47.4%) as of August 17. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the epidemic now spans six provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, Lower Uele, and Chopo. 782 patients remain in isolation or hospital; 1,091 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 84.1%. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history and the deadliest in DRC, having surpassed 4,000 cases within two weeks; still smaller than the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The virus began circulating in eastern Congo by February, with earliest cases possibly in January. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain carries about 30–50% fatality; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda reported linked cases and declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases (15 imported from DRC; two deaths). By July 23, 2,536 cases and over 1,000 deaths; two-week growth ~67%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラにより2,420人が死亡、致死率は47.4%に達した
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行で致死率47.4%、複数州に拡大しウガンダにも越境例があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの関連症例が報告されたが7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRC国内の複数州（Ituri、South Kivu等）はADM1レベルのため国単位でまとめて記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ahmedabad: Vector-borne diseases dip in 2026 | Ahmedabad News
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad saw a dip in vector-borne diseases in 2026 despite conducive humidity. By Aug 16, 2026, the city reported 48 malaria and 68 dengue cases, with the monsoon not yet concluded. Across January–August 2026, counts include 223 malaria, 25 falciparum malaria, 295 dengue, and 4 chikungunya. Dengue cases remain more common than malaria this year, and chikungunya admissions are few this monsoon. Aedes aegypti breeding thrives in open fields and construction sites between SG Highway and SP Ring Road, aided by intermittent rainfall and heat. Public health experts note hospitalizations for vector-borne diseases are lower than last year, though community transmission persists. Residents are urged to prevent water accumulation and use repellents/ointments to curb mosquito bites. The August 2025 figures were higher (malaria 223, dengue 428) for context.

triage.headline_ja: アーメダバード：2026年、蚊媒介感染症が減少
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2026年にアーメダバードで蚊媒介感染症（マラリア・デング・チクングニア）が前年比で減少していることを報じており、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年発生する季節性の蚊媒介感染症の定例報告であり、2026年は前年より件数が減少している。地域限定的な通常のサーベイランス記事でシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Seu gato sai na rua? Surto de esporotricose, doença transmissível para humanos, é confirmado em Cascavel; veja cuidados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Does your cat go outside? An outbreak of sporotrichosis, a disease transmissible to humans, confirmed in Cascavel; see precautions.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed outbreak of sporotrichosis in cats in Cascavel, Paraná, Brazil, announced by the Cascavel Health Secretariat on August 19, 2026, with human transmission. Sporotrichosis is a fungal disease causing severe lesions in felines and can be fatal; human infection occurs through contact with wound secretions or bites or scratches from infected animals. First feline cases appeared in 2022, likely introduced by a roaming infected animal. The health division collects diagnostic samples, monitors treatment, and the city provides medications while conducting active searches for new foci. Residents are advised to seek medical evaluation for suspected infections. Veterinarians note the disease is treatable; do not abandon infected pets, isolate them, wear gloves and masks when handling wounds, and maintain hygiene with soap, water, and disinfectant. The Cascavel Hemocenter requests pet blood donors (phone 45 99132-4236). Donor criteria: cats 1–7 years, >4 kg, vaccinated, indoors; dogs 1–7 years, >25 kg, healthy, vaccinated, non-medicated, docile.

triage.headline_ja: あなたの猫は外に出ますか？人にも感染するスポロトリコシス（皮膜真菌症）の集団発生がカスカベルで確認—注意点を確認
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的な動物由来真菌感染症で、既に2022年から発生し行政が対応中。国際的拡大や重篤な公衆衛生危機の要素は見られず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: スポロトリコシスは動物由来（主に猫）の真菌感染症で、地域の保健当局が既に監視・対応中。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、動物との直接接触による散発的感染が中心。

article.articleHeadline: OMS sobre el brote de ébola que deja más de 2,000 muertos: "Ya es el segundo más grande jamás registrado"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "WHO on the Ebola outbreak that has left more than 2,000 dead: 'It is already the second-largest ever recorded'"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 2,378 people out of 5,021 confirmed cases, according to Africa CDC, as of August 19, 2026. This is the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in the country’s history, surpassing 2018–2020 (2,299 deaths/3,381 cases) within about three months. Declared May 15 in northern and eastern regions with weak state presence and fragile health systems, the outbreak is driven by insecurity and population movement along roads, rivers and mining corridors. Transmission remains high in communities, including funerals, with many deaths occurring at home or away from treatment centers, indicating ongoing, untraced transmission chains. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain; Ervebo (Zaire strain) is recommended for trials, as preliminary animal data show some cross-protection and is the only licensed vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのエボラ出血熱流行に関する発表：死者2,000人超「史上2番目の規模」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例5,021件・死者2,378人に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速の拡大速度を示すエボラ流行であり、治療薬・ワクチンが存在しない株であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療法が存在せず、Ervebo（Zaire株用）の交差防御効果に関する予備的動物データのみ。治安不安・人口移動・葬儀慣習等により追跡不能な感染連鎖が継続中で、WHO・Africa CDCが強い関心を示している。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra 10.041 casos confirmados de chikungunya - Agência de Noticias do Governo de Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MS records 10,041 confirmed chikungunya cases - Government News Agency of Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul registered 12,663 probable chikungunya cases, with 10,041 confirmed. Thirty chikungunya deaths have occurred across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Ponta Porã, Nioaque and Corumbá; one death is under investigation. There are 114 confirmed chikungunya cases in pregnant women. For dengue, the state reports 4,667 probable cases, 1,978 confirmed, and one dengue death in Bonito, with two investigations ongoing. In the last 14 days, low dengue incidence was recorded in Inocência, Santa Rita do Pardo, Sidrolândia, Amambai, Jardim, Itaporã, Paranhos, Maracaju, Nova Alvorada do Sul, Bataguassu, Bonito, Coxim, Três Lagoas and Dourados. Dengue vaccination: 241,030 doses received, 223,322 administered, 201,349 to target population. The immunization schedule consists of two doses three months apart, recommended for children and adolescents 10–14 years, 11 months and 29 days. Authorities advise seeking health services if symptomatic and eliminating standing water to curb Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: MS州、チクングニア熱の確定症例10,041件を記録 - マットグロッソ・ド・スル州政府通信社
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱・デング熱ともに大量の確定症例と死亡例（チクングニア30名、デング1名）が報告されており重症度・流行継続性の基準に該当するが、ブラジルでは季節性・地域流行的なアウトブレイクであり異常性や国際的拡大の証拠はなく、社会的・国際的関心の高まりも記事からは確認できないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 州政府による定期的な症例統計発表であり、チクングニア熱・デング熱はブラジルで季節的に流行する既知の疾患。死亡例や妊婦感染例など重症度指標はあるが、国際的な異常性や渡航制限の必要性は示されていない。ワクチン接種など地域での対応が進行中で、外部支援の必要性は明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго від Еболи померли 2 420 людей, летальність сягнула 47,4%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2,420 people died from Ebola, and the fatality rate reached 47.4%.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has 5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 deaths, a case-fatality rate of 47.4%. As of August 17, 782 patients remain in isolation or hospital, 1,091 have recovered, and contact tracing is 84.1%. Declared May 15 in Ituri, the outbreak is the second-worst in the DRC and has spread to Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Lower Uele. Uganda reported 20 Ebola cases (15 imported from DRC) and was declared Ebola-free on July 28. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a fatality around 30–50%; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. By July 23, 2,536 cases and over 1,000 deaths, up about 67% in two weeks. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, and WHO maintains the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラにより2,420人が死亡、致死率47.4%に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、致死率47.4%、5,105例確認、WHOがPHEICを維持しており、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの輸出）も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは輸入例のみでEbola-freeを宣言済み（7月28日）。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。WHOはPHEICを維持しており、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pune tuberculosis survey finds disease returning in some within just six months of treatment
article.articleSummary: Recurrent tuberculosis (TB) in Pune, India, is highlighted by the TB Aftermath (TBAM) study, published in Lancet Global Health. Among 1,076 TB survivors followed 18 months after treatment completion (Jan 2021–Sept 2023) across six government clinics in rural and urban Pune, 75 survivors (7%) were diagnosed with recurrent TB and 30 of 3,309 household contacts (1%) were newly diagnosed. Median time to recurrence was under six months post-treatment, signaling a critical window for post-treatment surveillance. Home-based screening detected recurrences more effectively than telephone-based screening, underscoring the value of active, locally delivered monitoring. The findings advocate policy changes to extend surveillance beyond treatment completion in high-incidence settings, noting that TB is airborne among close contacts. The study involved 4,385 participants; India’s incidence declined 21% (237 to 187 per lakh, 2015–2024) and mortality from 28 to 21 per lakh. Also, prior extrapulmonary TB contributed to recurrences.

triage.headline_ja: プネーの結核調査で、治療完了からわずか6か月以内に一部で再発が判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はTB再発に関する学術研究（Lancet Global Health掲載）の報告であり、急性の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる根拠が乏しい。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核（既知の流行病）の治療後再発に関する疫学研究結果の報道であり、新規の異常発生事象ではないため対象国リストへの登録は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat: 'Buzz' scanner instantly detects mosquito species, disease risks
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad-based researchers from the University of Wollongong's GIFT City campus unveiled a buzz-scanning device that identifies mosquito species from wingbeat sounds. Developed by Prof Kiran Trivedi and student Harsh Shroff, the portable, AI-powered system analyzes wingbeat signatures and compares them to known species; trained on public mosquito audio data, it achieved 88.3% accuracy. The platform, which integrates a microphone and display and requires no internet or laboratory infrastructure, can distinguish Aedes aegypti (dengue, yellow fever, Zika), Anopheles (malaria), and Culex (encephalitis, filariasis)—vectors of major diseases. A network of such devices could monitor mosquito activity in real time and reveal emerging disease hotspots. The device was showcased at the UN AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva. World Mosquito Day is August 20, commemorating Anopheles' role in malaria transmission.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：『ブンブン』スキャナーが蚊の種類と疾病リスクを即時検知
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生や集団発生の報告ではなく、蚊の種類を音で識別する新技術の紹介記事であるため、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は技術開発・研究成果の紹介であり、疾病の実際の発生・流行を報じるものではないため、地域の疾病発生地としては特定しない。

article.articleHeadline: Do país livre do sarampo ao alerta de novos casos: avanço da doença reacende defesa da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From a measles-free country to warnings of new cases: the spread of the disease rekindles advocacy for vaccination
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 24 confirmed measles cases in 2026, while the United States exceeds 2,500 cases that year, underscoring renewed outbreak risks after Brazil had regained measles endemic-transmission–free status two years earlier. The Health Ministry is intensifying vaccination campaigns, with a national Dia D vaccination mobilization planned for August 22. Mauricio Rands, a lawyer and professor, advocates fighting misinformation and strengthening vaccination as a collective public policy that has saved millions of lives. The article notes a wider Americas concern about rising cases. It also mentions U.S. policy changes under President Donald Trump reducing universally recommended childhood vaccines from 17 to 11 and endorsing separation of the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella), a move medical groups warn could fuel vaccine hesitancy and leave children vulnerable.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹排除国から新規感染警戒へ：疾病の拡大がワクチン接種推進論を再燃させる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは2年前に麻疹の排除状態を達成していたにもかかわらず今年24例の確認例が報告され、これは異常・予想外の事態であり、麻疹の高い伝播性から国際的拡大のリスクも認められるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 米国・スペイン（カナリア諸島）の情報も含まれるが、いずれもBluedot対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主題は主にブラジルの麻疹再流行とワクチン接種推進に関するものである。米国のワクチン政策変更（MMR分離推奨等）も言及されているが、これは国際的な懸念文脈として記載されており、直接的な発生国情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le ministre de la Santé fait état de plus de 5 000 cas et environ 2 370 décès au 18 août, au-delà du dernier bilan consolidé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the health minister reports more than 5,000 cases and about 2,370 deaths as of August 18, exceeding the latest consolidated tally.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: Health Minister Roger Kamba reports over 5,000 confirmed Ebola cases and about 2,370 deaths in three months as of August 18, 2026; official figures are not consolidated. The latest SitRep N°093 (Aug 16) counted 4,945 confirmed cases and 2,325 deaths through Aug 15 (case fatality around 47% across 55 of 151 health zones). The minister cites five affected provinces; WHO records six. On Aug 18, WHO’s Emergency Committee classified the international risk as 'very high' for DRC, 'high' for Uganda and neighbors, and 'low' globally. The outbreak is the deadliest in DRC history. There is no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral for Bundibugyo; Ervebo targets Zaïre strain only. Response includes 100 epidemiologists, 500 community health workers, and 400 new beds added in two weeks, with about 60% of $115 million mobilized. Attacks occurred in Kandoy; Bunia center sees 40 daily patients (vs 200). Kinshasa case ruled out; remote learning planned in 18 high-risk zones from Sep 1.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：保健大臣が8月18日時点で5,000人以上の感染者と約2,370人の死者を報告、最新の統合集計を上回る
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最も死者数の多いエボラ流行で、WHOが国際リスクを『非常に高い』（DRC）『高い』（ウガンダ及び近隣国）と分類しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ及び近隣国はWHOによる国際リスク評価（『高い』）の対象として言及されているが、実際の感染確認事例は記載されていないため verified_locations には含めない。キンシャサでの疑い例は除外（ruled out）と記載。Bundibugyo株には既存ワクチン・特効薬がなく、対応能力の観点でも懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le Bas-Uélé devient la sixième province touchée, pour 4 665 cas et 2 184 décès au 12 août
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Bas-Uélé becomes the sixth province to be affected, with 4,665 cases and 2,184 deaths as of August 12.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo marks Bas-Uélé as the sixth province affected in the seventeenth outbreak. As of August 12, there are 4,665 confirmed cases and 2,184 deaths with 965 recoveries (case fatality 46.8%), 634 patients in isolation or treatment centers, and 84.2% contact follow-up. Bas-Uélé adds 11 health zones, bringing the total to 54 of 151 zones nationwide. A new zone, Buta, reports a case diagnosed post-mortem; the patient was a young man who developed symptoms August 1 and originated from Haut-Uele. Haut-Uele totals 119 cases and 55 deaths. Ituri remains the epicenter with 3,979 cases and 1,726 deaths (85.7% of cumulative). In the last 24 hours, 100 new cases: 67 Ituri, 25 North Kivu, 6 Haut-Uele, 1 Bas-Uélé; 53 deaths (28 community, 25 in centers). No vaccine against Bundibugyo strain; Ervebo targets Zaïre; WHO notes the outbreak remains ahead, with staffing gaps and a aim for 3,000 beds in 12 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：バ・ウエレ州が第6の被害州に、8月12日時点で4,665例、2,184死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が拡大し、致死率46.8%、6州・54保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対するワクチンが存在せず、Ervebo（Zaïre株用）が使用不可であることが特筆される。新州バ・ウエレへの拡大、隔離施設不足など管理上の課題が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: اكتشاف أول حالة إنفلونزا الخنازير بين الأطفال.. تفاصيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of the first case of swine flu among children... Details.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-19, China reports its first human infection with swine-origin influenza A(H1N2)v in a 2-year-10-month-old boy with fever, recurrent cough, and pneumonia; hospitalized, with Haemophilus influenzae coinfection. He improved after cefoperazone-sulbactam, oseltamivir, ambroxol, and budesonide and was discharged. Initial RT-PCR on stored samples was negative, but next-generation sequencing revealed a full genome of a reassortant A(H1N2)v with gene segments related to H1N1, H1N2, and H3N2; 95.17–98.53% similarity to swine influenza strains circulating in China. The findings highlight the role of genomic sequencing when RT-PCR is negative and ongoing clinical suspicion remains. The child resided in a rural area where pigs, chickens, and pigeons are raised near homes; a pigpen linked to the case housed pigs with respiratory illness. Among 91 human-animal-environment samples, influenza A was detected in bronchial lavage fluid and in a pig lung; one pig lung carried N2. No secondary human cases; 30 close contacts remained asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 子供の間で初の豚インフルエンザ症例を発見…詳細
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規リアソートメント型豚インフルエンザA(H1N2)vのヒト感染症例が初めて確認された。重症度は低く二次感染もないが、新規インフルエンザ亜型のヒト感染はIHR上常に評価対象となるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 新規リアソートメント型H1N2v豚インフルエンザの初のヒト感染例。患児は回復し二次感染なし（近接接触者30名も無症状）。ただし新規インフルエンザ亜型のヒト感染はIHR Annex2上常に評価対象となるため、パンデミック潜在性の観点からフルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Branco quer imunizar 40 mil cães e gatos contra a raiva

triage.triage_reason: 動物への定期的な狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す情報はないため見送りと判断する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola bùng phát: Congo báo động đỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Congo on red alert
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 5,021 cases and 2,378 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. WHO warns the outbreak remains far from controllable. The epidemic, confirmed since May 2026, has spread to six provinces and 55 health zones, with Ituri as the epicenter. Case fatality rate has risen to about 46% in mid-August, though experts caution this reflects late presentation rather than increased virulence. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccine or specific treatment yet; vaccines and therapies are under investigation. Early detection, patient isolation, contact tracing, and supportive care are emphasized to reduce mortality and limit spread. Factors driving transmission include armed conflict, displacement, poor infrastructure, mobile gold miners, and safety concerns for healthcare workers, with over 70% of deaths occurring outside hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：コンゴ、レッドアラート発令
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最悪規模（5,021例、死亡2,378例）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、6州55保健地区に拡大し、WHOも制御困難と警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認、武装対立や避難民、医療従事者の安全確保困難など制御を阻む複合要因があり、WHOも制御困難と明言。フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Лихоманка Ебола: У Конго кількість випадків захворювання перевищила 5 000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever: In Congo, the number of cases has exceeded 5,000.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 August 2026, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease cases exceed 5,000, with 5,021 confirmed infections and 2,378 deaths. This marks the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, the 17th outbreak, and the second-worst globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or therapies. The figures reflect ongoing transmission and rising fatalities, underscoring the absence of strain-specific medical countermeasures and the continuing public health challenge in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで感染者数が5,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行(5,021例、死亡2,378例)で、Bundibugyo株に承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCのみを主題としているため除外。Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれない。
